Translations.translation: They would surely say (in the evening): "Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched."

16.verse: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders.

17.verse: وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have guarded it (near heaven) from every outcast Shaytan (devil).

18.verse: إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except him (devil) who steals the hearing, then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire.

19.verse: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have spread out the earth, and have placed firm mountains in it, and caused all kinds of things to grow in it, in due proportion.

20.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in it We have provided means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not.

21.verse: وَإِن مِّن شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there is not a thing, but the supplies for it are with Us, and We do not send it down but in a known measure.

22.verse: وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We send the winds fertilizing, then We cause the water to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its supply.

23.verse: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And certainly We! It is We Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.

24.verse: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We know the first generations of you who have passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards.

25.verse: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is Most Wise, (and) Knowing.

26.verse: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.

27.verse: وَالْجَانَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ السَّمُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Jinn, We created earlier from the smokeless flame of fire.

28.verse: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud. "

29.verse: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) of My spirit (the soul which I created for him,) then fall down, prostrating yourselves before him."

30.verse: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together.

31.verse: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except Iblis (Shaytan) - he refused to be among the prostrate.

32.verse: قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What is your reason for not being among the prostrate"

33.verse: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Iblis] said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to a human, whom You created from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud."

34.verse: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "Then leave, for verily, you are an outcast. "

35.verse: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And verily, the curse shall be upon you until the Day of Recompense."

36.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Iblis] said: "O my Lord! Then give me respite until the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."

37.verse: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah said: "Then verily, you are of those reprieved,"

38.verse: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Until the Day of the time appointed."

39.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Iblis] said: "O my Lord! Because You misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all."

40.verse: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Except Your chosen (guided) servants among them."

41.verse: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "This is the way which will lead straight to Me."

42.verse: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My servants, except those of the astray who follow you."

43.verse: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And surely, Hell is the place promised for them all.

44.verse: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It has seven gates, for each of those gates is a class assigned.

45.verse: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, those who have Taqwa, will dwell in Gardens and water springs.

46.verse: ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ آمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said to them): "Enter it in peace and security."

47.verse: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَانًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We shall remove any deep feeling of bitterness from their breasts. (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones.

48.verse: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they be asked to leave it.

49.verse: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Declare to My servants that I am truly the Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

50.verse: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that My torment is indeed the most painful torment.

51.verse: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And tell them about the guests (i.e., the angels) of Ibrahim.

52.verse: إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When they entered upon him, and said: "Salaman (peace!)." He said: "Indeed we are frightened of you."

53.verse: قَالُوا لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Do not be afraid! We bring you the good news of a boy possessing much knowledge and wisdom."

54.verse: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَىٰ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Do you give me this good news while old age has overtaken me Of what then is your news about"

55.verse: قَالُوا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ الْقَانِطِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We give you good news in truth. So do not be of those who despair."

56.verse: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except those who are astray"

57.verse: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "What then is the business for which you have come, O messengers"

58.verse: قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We have been sent to a guilty people."

59.verse: إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "(All) except the family of Lut, all of whom we are to save (from the destruction)."

60.verse: إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Except for his wife, of whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind."

61.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ آلَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when the messengers (the angels) came to the family of Lut

62.verse: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Lut) said: "Verily, you are people unknown to me."

63.verse: قَالُوا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting."

64.verse: وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And we have brought you the truth and certainly we tell the truth."

65.verse: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then travel for a portion of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered."

66.verse: وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We made this decree known to him that those (sinners) would be rooted out in the early morning.

67.verse: وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing.

68.verse: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Lut] said: "Verily, these are my guests, so do not shame me."

69.verse: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And have Taqwa of Allah, and do not disgrace me."

70.verse: قَالُوا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Did we not forbid you from entertaining any of the `Alamin"

71.verse: قَالَ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِن كُنتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Lut] said: "These are my daughters, if you must act (so)."

72.verse: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, by your life, in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly.

73.verse: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So the Sayhah overtook them at the time of sunrise.

74.verse: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We turned them upside down and rained stones of baked clay upon them.

75.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Surely, in this are signs for those who see.

76.verse: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, they were right on the highroad.

77.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Surely, there is indeed a sign in that for the believers.

78.verse: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, were also wrongdoers.

79.verse: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open route, plain to see.

80.verse: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, the Dwellers of Al-Hijr denied the Messengers.

81.verse: وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتِنَا فَكَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We gave them Our signs, but they were averse to them.

82.verse: وَكَانُوا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا آمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains, (feeling) secure.

83.verse: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But the Sayhah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in the early morning.

84.verse: فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And all that they used to earn availed them not.

85.verse: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ ۖ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with the truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook their faults with gracious forgiveness.

86.verse: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your Lord is the Knowing Creator.

87.verse: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of the Mathani, and the Grand Qur'an.

88.verse: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have given to certain classes of them, nor grieve over them. And lower your wings to the believers.

89.verse: وَقُلْ إِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And say (O Muhammad): "I am indeed a plain warner."

90.verse: كَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As We have sent down on the Muqtasimin (conspiring confederates),

91.verse: الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who have made the Qur'an into parts.

92.verse: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, by your Lord, We shall certainly call all of them to account.

93.verse: عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For all that they used to do.

94.verse: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore openly proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the idolators.

95.verse: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, We will suffice you against the mockers,

96.verse: الَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who make another god along with Allah; but they will come to know.

97.verse: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed, We know that your breast becomes tight because of what they say.

98.verse: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ السَّاجِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him).

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And worship your Lord until the certainty (i.e. death) comes to you.

1.verse: أَتَىٰ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ata amru Allahi fala tastaAAjiloohu subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Event ordained by Allah has indeed come, so do not seek to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate as partners with Him.

2.verse: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرُوا أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاتَّقُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yunazzilu almalaikata bialrroohi min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi an anthiroo annahu la ilaha illa ana faittaqooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He sends down the angels with the Ruh (revelation) of His command to those servants of His whom He wills (saying): "Warn mankind that none has the right to be worshipped but I, so have Taqwa of Me."

3.verse: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi taAAala AAamma yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High is He, Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him.

4.verse: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has created man from a Nutfah, then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent.

5.verse: وَالْأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalanAAama khalaqaha lakum feeha difon wamanafiAAu waminha takuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and you eat from them.

6.verse: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walakum feeha jamalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture (in the morning).

7.verse: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا بَالِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watahmilu athqalakum ila baladin lam takoonoo baligheehi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach yourselves except with great trouble. Truly, your Lord is full of kindness, Most Merciful.

8.verse: وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalkhayla waalbighala waalhameera litarkabooha wazeenatan wayakhluqu ma la taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride, and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge.

9.verse: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAala Allahi qasdu alssabeeli waminha jairun walaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is up to Allah to show the right way. But there are ways that stray. And had He willed, He would have guided you all.

10.verse: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan lakum minhu sharabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He it is Who sends water down from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture.

11.verse: يُنبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْأَعْنَابَ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yunbitu lakum bihi alzzarAAa waalzzaytoona waalnnakheela waalaAAnaba wamin kulli alththamarati inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With it He causes crops to grow for you, the olives, the date palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily, in this there is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for people who give thought.

12.verse: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujoomu musakhkharatun biamrihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He has subjected the night and the day for you, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His command. Surely, in this are proofs for people who understand.

13.verse: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tharaa lakum fee alardi mukhtalifan alwanuhu inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaththakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And all He has created of varying colors on the earth for you. Verily, in this is a sign for people who reflect.

14.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee sakhkhara albahra litakuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka mawakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He it is Who subjected the sea (to you), that you may eat from the fresh tender meat, and that you bring forth out of it ornaments to wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, that you may seek from His bounty and that you may perhaps be grateful.

15.verse: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَارًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum waanharan wasubulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He has driven firm standing mountains into the earth, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves.

16.verse: وَعَلَامَاتٍ ۚ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAalamatin wabialnnajmi hum yahtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (by the) landmarks; and by the stars, they guide themselves.

17.verse: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaman yakhluqu kaman la yakhluqu afala tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is then He Who creates the same as one who creates, not Will you not then reflect

18.verse: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna Allaha laghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if you would try to count the favors of Allah, you would never be able to count them. Truly, Allah is Forgiving, Most Merciful.

19.verse: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu yaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

20.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those whom they invoke besides Allah have not created anything, but are themselves created.

21.verse: أَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَاءٍ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amwatun ghayru ahyain wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They are) dead, not alive; and they do not know when they will be resurrected.

22.verse: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ilahukum ilahun wahidun faallatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Your god is one God. But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are proud.

23.verse: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La jarama anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona innahu la yuhibbu almustakbireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Certainly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Truly, He does not like the proud.

24.verse: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha qeela lahum matha anzala rabbukum qaloo asateeru alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when it is said to them: "What is it that your Lord has revealed" They say: "Tales of the men of old!"

25.verse: لِيَحْمِلُوا أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyahmiloo awzarahum kamilatan yawma alqiyamati wamin awzari allatheena yudilloonahum bighayri AAilmin ala saa ma yaziroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection, and also the burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge. Evil indeed is that which they shall bear!

26.verse: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى اللَّهُ بُنْيَانَهُم مِّنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad makara allatheena min qablihim faata Allahu bunyanahum mina alqawaAAidi fakharra AAalayhimu alssaqfu min fawqihim waatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those before them indeed plotted, but Allah struck at the foundation of their building, the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive.

27.verse: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma yawma alqiyamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tushaqqoona feehim qala allatheena ootoo alAAilma inna alkhizya alyawma waalssooa AAala alkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say: "Where are My (so-called) partners, those over which you caused so much discord" Those who have been given the knowledge will say: "Indeed it is a Day of disgrace and misery for the disbelievers."

28.verse: الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوءٍ ۚ بَلَىٰ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu thalimee anfusihim faalqawoo alssalama ma kunna naAAmalu min sooin bala inna Allaha AAaleemun bima kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those whose lives the angels take while they are doing wrong to themselves. Then, they will (falsely) submit (saying): "We did not do any evil." (The angels will reply): "Yes! Truly, Allah is Most Knowing of what you did."

29.verse: فَادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faodkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha falabisa mathwa almutakabbireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and indeed, what an evil abode there is for the arrogant."

30.verse: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqeela lillatheena ittaqaw matha anzala rabbukum qaloo khayran lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waladaru alakhirati khayrun walaniAAma daru almuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (when) it is said to those who had Taqwa (piety and righteousness), "What is it that your Lord has revealed" They say: "That which is good." For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of those who have Taqwa.

31.verse: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِي اللَّهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahum feeha ma yashaoona kathalika yajzee Allahu almuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity) which they will enter, under which rivers flow, in it they will have all that they wish. Thus Allah rewards those who have Taqwa.

32.verse: الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salamun AAalaykumu odkhuloo aljannata bima kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those whose lives the angels take while they are in a pious state saying (to them) "Salamun `Alaikum (peace be on you!). Enter Paradise because of what (good) you used to do (in the world)."

33.verse: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal yanthuroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim wama thalamahumu Allahu walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Are they but waiting for the angels to come to them, or there comes the command of your Lord Thus did those before them. And Allah did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves.

34.verse: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, they were afflicted by their evil deeds, and they were surrounded by that which they used to mock.

35.verse: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَيْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَا آبَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma AAabadna min doonihi min shayin nahnu wala abaona wala harramna min doonihi min shayin kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim fahal AAala alrrusuli illa albalaghu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who worshipped others with Allah said: "If Allah had so willed, neither we nor our fathers would have worshipped any but Him nor would we have forbidden anything without (a command from) Him." Those before them did the same. Then! Are the Messengers charged with anything but to clearly convey the Message

36.verse: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى اللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلَالَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad baAAathna fee kulli ommatin rasoolan ani oAAbudoo Allaha waijtaniboo alttaghoota faminhum man hada Allahu waminhum man haqqat AAalayhi alddalalatu faseeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have indeed sent a Messenger to every Ummah (community, nation) (saying): "Worship Allah (Alone), and shun the Taghut (all false deities). " Then among them were some whom Allah guided, and among them were some who deserved to be left to stray. So travel through the land and see the end of those who denied (the truth).

37.verse: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَاهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In tahris AAala hudahum fainna Allaha la yahdee man yudillu wama lahum min nasireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Even] if you desire that they be guided, then verily, Allah does not guide those whom He allowed to stray, and they will have no helpers.

38.verse: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim la yabAAathu Allahu man yamootu bala waAAdan AAalayhi haqqan walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they swear by Allah with their strongest oaths, that Allah will not raise up one who dies. Yes, (He will raise them up), a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not.

39.verse: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كَاذِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyubayyina lahumu allathee yakhtalifoona feehi waliyaAAlama allatheena kafaroo annahum kanoo kathibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In order that He may make clear to them what they differed over, and so that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars.

40.verse: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ إِذَا أَرَدْنَاهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama qawluna lishayin itha aradnahu an naqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Our Word to a thing when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: "Be!" - and it is.

41.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا فِي اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hajaroo fee Allahi min baAAdi ma thulimoo lanubawwiannahum fee alddunya hasanatan walaajru alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And as for those who emigrated for the cause of Allah, after they had been wronged, We will certainly give them good residence in this world, but indeed the reward of the Hereafter will be greater; if they but knew!

42.verse: الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena sabaroo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They are) those who remained patient, and put their trust in their Lord.

43.verse: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We sent not (as Our Messengers) before you (O Muhammad) any but men, whom We sent revelation. So ask Ahl Adh-Dhikr, if you know not.

44.verse: بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bialbayyinati waalzzuburi waanzalna ilayka alththikra litubayyina lilnnasi ma nuzzila ilayhim walaAAallahum yatafakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With clear signs and Books (We sent the Messengers). And We have also revealed the Dhikr to you so that you may clearly explain to men what was revealed to them, and that perhaps they may reflect.

45.verse: أَفَأَمِنَ الَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaamina allatheena makaroo alssayyiati an yakhsifa Allahu bihimu alarda aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do then those who devise evil plots feel secure that Allah will not cause them to sink into the earth, or that torment will not seize them from where they do not perceive it

46.verse: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yakhuthahum fee taqallubihim fama hum bimuAAjizeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or that He may punish them in the midst of their going to and fro (in their livelihood), so that there be no escape for them (from Allah's punishment)

47.verse: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yakhuthahum AAala takhawwufin fainna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or that He may punish them where they fear it most Indeed, Your Lord is full of kindness, Most Merciful.

48.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيْءٍ يَتَفَيَّأُ ظِلَالُهُ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَائِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَاخِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awa lam yaraw ila ma khalaqa Allahu min shayin yatafayyao thilaluhu AAani alyameeni waalshshamaili sujjadan lillahi wahum dakhiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have they not observed things that Allah has created: (how) their shadows shift from right to left, prostrating to Allah while they are humble

49.verse: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِن دَابَّةٍ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walillahi yasjudu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi min dabbatin waalmalaikatu wahum la yastakbiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to Allah prostrate all that are in the heavens and all that are in the earth, the moving creatures and the angels, and they are not proud [i.e. they worship their Lord (Allah) with humility].

50.verse: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yakhafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

51.verse: ۞ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَـٰهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ فَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala Allahu la tattakhithoo ilahayni ithnayni innama huwa ilahun wahidun faiyyaya fairhabooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah said "Do not worship two gods. Indeed, He (Allah) is only One God. Then fear Me Alone.

52.verse: وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi walahu alddeenu wasiban afaghayra Allahi tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth and the religion. Will you then fear any other than Allah

53.verse: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْأَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama bikum min niAAmatin famina Allahi thumma itha massakumu alddurru failayhi tajaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whatever of blessings and good things you have, it is from Allah. Then, when harm touches you, unto Him you cry aloud for help.

54.verse: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma itha kashafa alddurra AAankum itha fareequn minkum birabbihim yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, when He has removed the harm from you, behold! some of you associate others in worship with their Lord (Allah).

55.verse: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum fatamattaAAoo fasawfa taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So they are ungrateful for that which We have given them! Then enjoy yourselves but you will soon come to know.

56.verse: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ ۗ تَاللَّهِ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayajAAaloona lima la yaAAlamoona naseeban mimma razaqnahum taAllahi latusalunna AAamma kuntum taftaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they assign a portion of that which We have provided them with, to what they have no knowledge of (false deities). By Allah, you shall certainly be questioned about (all) that you used to fabricate.

57.verse: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ الْبَنَاتِ سُبْحَانَهُ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayajAAaloona lillahi albanati subhanahu walahum ma yashtahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they assign daughters to Allah! Glorified (and Exalted) is He (above all that they associate with Him!). And for themselves (they assign) what they desire;

58.verse: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِالْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bialontha thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the news of (the birth of) a female (child) is brought to any of them, his face becomes dark, and he is filled with inner grief!

59.verse: يَتَوَارَىٰ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِن سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِي التُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yatawara mina alqawmi min sooi ma bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu AAala hoonin am yadussuhu fee altturabi ala saa ma yahkumoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He hides himself from the people because of the evil of what he has been informed. Shall he keep her with dishonor or bury her in the earth Certainly, evil is their decision.

60.verse: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lillatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati mathalu alssawi walillahi almathalu alaAAla wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is an evil description, and for Allah is the highest description. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

61.verse: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَابَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bithulmihim ma taraka AAalayha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if Allah were to punish (all) mankind for their wrongdoing, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving creature, but He defers them to an appointed term; and when their term comes, they can neither delay nor advance it an hour (or a moment).

62.verse: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayajAAaloona lillahi ma yakrahoona watasifu alsinatuhumu alkathiba anna lahumu alhusna la jarama anna lahumu alnnara waannahum mufratoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They assign to Allah that which they dislike (for themselves), and their tongues assert the lie that the better things will be theirs. No doubt the Fire is for them, and they will be forsaken.

63.verse: تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TaAllahi laqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu alyawma walahum AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By Allah, We indeed sent (Messengers) to the nations before you, but Shaytan made their deeds seeming fair to them. So today he is their helper, and theirs will be a painful torment.

64.verse: وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama anzalna AAalayka alkitaba illa litubayyina lahumu allathee ikhtalafoo feehi wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have not revealed the Book to you, except that you may clearly explain to them those things in which they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.

65.verse: وَاللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu anzala mina alssamai maan faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yasmaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah sends water down from the sky, then He revives the earth with it after its death. Surely that is a sign for people who listen.

66.verse: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ مِن بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِّلشَّارِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butoonihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khalisan saighan lilshsharibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there is indeed a lesson for you in the An'am (cattle). We have made a drink for you out of what is in its belly, from between excretions and blood, pure milk; palatable to the drinkers.

67.verse: وَمِن ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin thamarati alnnakheeli waalaAAnabi tattakhithoona minhu sakaran warizqan hasanan inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes, you derive strong drink and a goodly provision. There is indeed a sign in this for those of reason.

68.verse: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waawha rabbuka ila alnnahli ani ittakhithee mina aljibali buyootan wamina alshshajari wamimma yaAArishoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And your Lord inspired the bee, saying: "Take you habitations in the mountains and in the trees and in what they (humans) erect."

69.verse: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma kulee min kulli alththamarati faoslukee subula rabbiki thululan yakhruju min butooniha sharabun mukhtalifun alwanuhu feehi shifaon lilnnasi inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then, eat of all fruits, and follow the routes that your Lord made easy (for you)." There comes forth from their bellies, a drink of varying colors, in which there is a cure for men. There is indeed a sign in that for people who reflect.

70.verse: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffakum waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likay la yaAAlama baAAda AAilmin shayan inna Allaha AAaleemun qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah created you and then He will cause you to die; and among you there are some who are sent back to senility, so that they know nothing after having known (much). Truly, Allah is Knowing, capable of all things.

71.verse: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا بِرَادِّي رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu faddala baAAdakum AAala baAAdin fee alrrizqi fama allatheena fuddiloo biraddee rizqihim AAala ma malakat aymanuhum fahum feehi sawaon afabiniAAmati Allahi yajhadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah honored some of you over others with wealth and properties. Then, those who are so honored will by no means hand over their wealth and properties to those (captives of war) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in that. Do they then deny the favor of Allah

72.verse: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ۚ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wajaAAala lakum min azwajikum baneena wahafadatan warazaqakum mina alttayyibati afabialbatili yuminoona wabiniAAmati Allahi hum yakfuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah has made for you mates of your own kind, and has made for you, from your mates, sons and grandsons, and has granted you good provisions. Do they then believe in false deities and deny favor of Allah

73.verse: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina alssamawati waalardi shayan wala yastateeAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they worship others besides Allah such as do not have power to grant them any provision from the heavens or the earth nor the ability to do so.

74.verse: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا لِلَّهِ الْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala tadriboo lillahi alamthala inna Allaha yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So do not give examples on behalf of Allah. Truly, Allah knows and you know not.

75.verse: ۞ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُونَ ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Daraba Allahu mathalan AAabdan mamlookan la yaqdiru AAala shayin waman razaqnahu minna rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawoona alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah gives the example of a servant under the possession of another, he has no power of any sort, and a man on whom We have bestowed good provisions from Us, and he spends from that secretly and openly. Can they be equal (By no means). All the praises and thanks are to Allah. Nay! (But) most of them know not.

76.verse: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَاهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan rajulayni ahaduhuma abkamu la yaqdiru AAala shayin wahuwa kallun AAala mawlahu aynama yuwajjihhu la yati bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa waman yamuru bialAAadli wahuwa AAala siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah gives an example of two men, one of them dumb, who has no power over anything, and he is a burden on his master; whichever way he directs him, he brings no good. Is such a man equal to one who commands justice, and is himself on the straight path

77.verse: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَا أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walillahi ghaybu alssamawati waalardi wama amru alssaAAati illa kalamhi albasari aw huwa aqrabu inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And the matter of the Hour is not but as a twinkling of the eye, or even nearer. Truly, Allah is able to do all things.

78.verse: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّن بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu akhrajakum min butooni ommahatikum la taAAlamoona shayan wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata laAAallakum tashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah has brought you out from the wombs of your mothers while you knew nothing. And He gave you hearing, sight, and hearts, that you might give thanks.

79.verse: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yaraw ila alttayri musakhkharatin fee jawwi alssamai ma yumsikuhunna illa Allahu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not see the birds held (flying) in the midst of the sky None holds them up but Allah. Verily, in this are clear signs for people who believe.

80.verse: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ الْأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا أَثَاثًا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min buyootikum sakanan wajaAAala lakum min juloodi alanAAami buyootan tastakhiffoonaha yawma thaAAnikum wayawma iqamatikum wamin aswafiha waawbariha waashAAariha athathan wamataAAan ila heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah had made your homes a place of rest for you, and made dwellings for you out of the hides of the cattle which you find so light when you travel and when you camp; and furnishings and articles of convenience out of their wool, fur, and hair - comfort for a while.

81.verse: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَالًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ أَكْنَانًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum mimma khalaqa thilalan wajaAAala lakum mina aljibali aknanan wajaAAala lakum sarabeela taqeekumu alharra wasarabeela taqeekum basakum kathalika yutimmu niAAmatahu AAalaykum laAAallakum tuslimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah has made shade for you out of that which He has created, and He has made places of refuge in the mountains for you, and He has made garments for you to protect you from the heat, and coats of mail to protect you from your violence. Thus does He perfect His favor for you, that you may submit yourselves to His will.

82.verse: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayka albalaghu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, if they turn away, your duty (O Muhammad) is only to convey (the Message) in a clear way.

83.verse: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YaAArifoona niAAmata Allahi thumma yunkiroonaha waaktharuhumu alkafiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They recognize the grace of Allah, yet they deny it (by worshipping others besides Allah) and most of them are disbelievers.

84.verse: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma nabAAathu min kulli ommatin shaheedan thumma la yuthanu lillatheena kafaroo wala hum yustaAAtaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on the Day when We resurrect a witness from each nation, then those who disbelieve will not be given leave, nor will they be allowed (to return to the world) to repent and ask for Allah's forgiveness.

85.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha raa allatheena thalamoo alAAathaba fala yukhaffafu AAanhum wala hum yuntharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And once those who did wrong see the torment, it will not decrease for them, nor will they be given respite.

86.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا هَـٰؤُلَاءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُو مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha raa allatheena ashrakoo shurakaahum qaloo rabbana haolai shurakaona allatheena kunna nadAAoo min doonika faalqaw ilayhimu alqawla innakum lakathiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when those who associated partners with Allah see their partners, they will say: "Our Lord! These are our partners whom we used to call upon besides you." But they will throw back their statement at them (saying): "You indeed are liars!"

87.verse: وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqaw ila Allahi yawmaithin alssalama wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will offer (their full) submission to Allah on that Day, and what they falsely invented will wander away from them.

88.verse: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ زِدْنَاهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا يُفْسِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi zidnahum AAathaban fawqa alAAathabi bima kanoo yufsidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who disbelieved and tried to obstruct the path of Allah, for them We will add torment on top of the torment because of the corruption they spread.

89.verse: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma nabAAathu fee kulli ommatin shaheedan AAalayhim min anfusihim wajina bika shaheedan AAala haolai wanazzalna AAalayka alkitaba tibyanan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan wabushra lilmuslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on the Day when We resurrect a witness from each nation from among themselves, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We have revealed the Book (the Qur'an) to you as an explanation of everything, a guidance, a mercy, and good news for the Muslims.

90.verse: ۞ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna Allaha yamuru bialAAadli waalihsani waeetai thee alqurba wayanha AAani alfahshai waalmunkari waalbaghyi yaAAithukum laAAallakum tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Allah orders justice and kindness, and giving (help) to the relatives, and He forbids immoral sins, and evil and tyranny. He admonishes you, so that perhaps you may take heed.

91.verse: وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waawfoo biAAahdi Allahi itha AAahadtum wala tanqudoo alaymana baAAda tawkeediha waqad jaAAaltumu Allaha AAalaykum kafeelan inna Allaha yaAAlamu ma tafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And fulfill the covenants (taken in the Name of) Allah when you have taken them, and do not break the oaths after you have confirmed them - and indeed you have appointed Allah as your guarantor. Verily, Allah knows what you do.

92.verse: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِن بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala takoonoo kaallatee naqadat ghazlaha min baAAdi quwwatin ankathan tattakhithoona aymanakum dakhalan baynakum an takoona ommatun hiya arba min ommatin innama yablookumu Allahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma alqiyamati ma kuntum feehi takhtalifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And do not be like the one who undoes the thread which she has spun, after it has become strong, by taking your oaths as a means of deception among yourselves when one group is more numerous than another group. Allah only tests you by this, and on the Day of Resurrection, He will certainly clarify that which used to differ over.

93.verse: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalakum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao walatusalunna AAamma kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And had Allah willed, He would have made you (all) one nation, but He allows whom He wills to stray and He guides whom He wills. But you shall certainly be called to account for what you used to do.

94.verse: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا السُّوءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tattakhithoo aymanakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baAAda thubootiha watathooqoo alssooa bima sadadtum AAan sabeeli Allahi walakum AAathabun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And do not make your oaths a means of deception among yourselves, resulting in the slip of a foot after it was firmly planted, and you taste the evil of having hindered from the path of Allah, and you will suffer a terrible punishment.

95.verse: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
