Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness. Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught.

61.verse: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They will enter) `Adn Gardens which the Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the unseen. Verily, His promise must come to pass.

62.verse: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They shall not hear therein any Laghw, but only Salam. And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon.

63.verse: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who had Taqwa.

64.verse: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And we descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two; and your Lord is never forgetful.

65.verse: رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him and abide patiently in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him

66.verse: وَيَقُولُ الْإِنسَانُ أَإِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And man says: "When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive"

67.verse: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing

68.verse: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So by your Lord, surely We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayatin, then We shall bring them round Hell, Jithyya.

69.verse: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Gracious.

70.verse: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein.

71.verse: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell); this is with your Lord, a decree which must be accomplished.

72.verse: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We shall save those who had Taqwa. And We shall leave the wrongdoers in it, Jithiyya.

73.verse: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when Our clear Ayat are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Which of the two groups has the best dwellings and the finest Nadiyyan"

74.verse: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِئْيًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance

75.verse: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: whoever is in error, the Most Gracious will extend [circumstances] for him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst in position, and who is weaker in forces.

76.verse: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى ۗ وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah increases in guidance those who walk aright. And the righteous good deeds that last are better with your Lord for reward and better for resort.

77.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayat and said: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children [if I live again]."

78.verse: أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious

79.verse: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment;

80.verse: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of, and he shall come to Us alone.

81.verse: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they have taken gods besides Allah, that they might give them honor, power and glory.

82.verse: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and will become their adversaries.

83.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not that We have sent the Shayatin against the disbelievers to push them to do evil.

84.verse: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number.

85.verse: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day We shall gather those with Taqwa unto the Most Gracious (Allah), like a delegation.

86.verse: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We shall drive the criminals to Hell, in a thirsty state.

87.verse: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Gracious (Allah).

88.verse: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allah) has begotten a son."

89.verse: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad jitum shayan iddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed you have brought forth (said) a thing Idda.

90.verse: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains Hadda.

91.verse: أَن دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That they ascribe a son to the Most Gracious.

92.verse: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But it is not suitable for the Most Gracious that He should beget a son.

93.verse: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا آتِي الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious as a slave.

94.verse: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting.

95.verse: وَكُلُّهُمْ آتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection.

96.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious will bestow love for them.

97.verse: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We have made this easy in your own tongue, only that you may give glad tidings to those who have Taqwa, and warn with it the people that are Ludda.

98.verse: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Taha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ta Ha.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We have not sent down the Qur'an unto you to cause you distress,

3.verse: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But only as a Reminder to those who fear (Allah).

4.verse: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and high heavens.

5.verse: الرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Most Gracious Istawa the Throne.

6.verse: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and all that is between them, and all that is under the soil.

7.verse: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if you speak aloud, then verily, He knows the secret and that which is yet more hidden.

8.verse: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah! There is no God but Him! To Him belong the Best Names.

9.verse: وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And has there come to you the story of Musa

10.verse: إِذْ رَأَىٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوا إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّي آتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When he saw a fire, he said to his family: "Wait! Verily, I have seen a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."

11.verse: فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when he came to it (the fire), he was called by name: "O Musa!"

12.verse: إِنِّي أَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, I am your Lord! So take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwa."

13.verse: وَأَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And I have chosen you. So listen to that which will be revealed (to you)"

14.verse: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, I am Allah! There is no God but Me, so worship Me, and perform Salah for My remembrance."

15.verse: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, the Hour is coming -- and I am almost hiding it -- that every person may be rewarded for that which he strives."

16.verse: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Therefore, let not the one who believes not therein, but follows his own lusts, divert you therefrom, lest you perish."

17.verse: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And what is that in your right hand, O Musa"

18.verse: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَآرِبُ أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "This is my stick, whereon I lean, and wherewith I beat down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses."

19.verse: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala alqiha ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "Cast it down, O Musa!"

20.verse: فَأَلْقَاهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He cast it down, and behold! It was a snake, moving quickly.

21.verse: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah said: "Grasp it and fear not; We shall return it to its former state."

22.verse: وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ آيَةً أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And press your (right) hand to your (left) side: it will come forth white (and shining), without any disease as another sign,"

23.verse: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا الْكُبْرَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That We may show you (some) of Our greater signs."

24.verse: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Go to Fir`awn! Verily, he has transgressed."

25.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "O my Lord! Open for me my chest."

26.verse: وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayassir lee amree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And ease my task for me;"

27.verse: وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And loosen the knot from my tongue,"

28.verse: يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yafqahoo qawlee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That they understand my speech."

29.verse: وَاجْعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And appoint for me a helper from my family,"

30.verse: هَارُونَ أَخِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Haroona akhee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Harun, my brother."

31.verse: اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Oshdud bihi azree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Increase my strength with him,"

32.verse: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waashrikhu fee amree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And let him share my task,"

33.verse: كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That we may glorify You much,"

34.verse: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanathkuraka katheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And remember You much,"

35.verse: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaka kunta bina baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, You are ever seeing us."

36.verse: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "You are granted your request, O Musa!"

37.verse: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And indeed We conferred a favor on you another time (before)."

38.verse: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "When We inspired your mother with that which We inspired."

39.verse: أَنِ اقْذِفِيهِ فِي التَّابُوتِ فَاقْذِفِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ الْيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّي وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّي وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Saying: `Put him (the child) into the Tabut and put it into the river; then the river shall cast it up on the bank, and there, an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his shall take him.' And I endued you with love from Me, in order that you may be brought up under My Eye."

40.verse: إِذْ تَمْشِي أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَاكَ إِلَىٰ أُمِّكَ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَاكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُونًا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِي أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "When your sister went and said: `Shall I show you one who will nurse him' So We restored you to your mother, that she might cool her eyes and she should not grieve. Then you did kill a man, but We saved you from great distress and tried you with a heavy trial." Then you stayed a number of years with the people of Madyan. Then you came here according to the fixed term which I ordained (for you), O Musa!

41.verse: وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And I have chosen you for Myself.

42.verse: اذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِآيَاتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Go you and your brother with My Ayat, and do not, you both, slacken and become weak in My remembrance.

43.verse: اذْهَبَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Go both of you to Fir`awn, verily, he has transgressed.

44.verse: فَقُولَا لَهُ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And speak to him mildly, perhaps he may accept admonition or fear (Allah).

45.verse: قَالَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Both of them said: "Our Lord! Verily, we fear lest he should hasten to punish us or lest he should transgress."

46.verse: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا ۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Allah) said: "Fear not, verily, I am with you both, hearing and seeing."

47.verse: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَاكَ بِآيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So go you both to him, and say: 'Verily, we are both Messengers of your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and torment them not; indeed, we have come with a sign from your Lord! And peace will be upon him who follows the guidance!"

48.verse: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْنَا أَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Truly, it has been revealed to us that the torment will be for him who denies, and turns away.`"

49.verse: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Fir`awn said: "Who then, O Musa, is the Lord of you two"

50.verse: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Musa] said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each thing its form and nature, then guided it aright."

51.verse: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Fir`awn] said: "What about the generations of old"

52.verse: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Musa] said: "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord, in a Record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

53.verse: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has made earth for you like a bed; and has opened ways for you therein, and has sent down water (rain) from the sky. And We have brought forth with it various kinds of vegetation.

54.verse: كُلُوا وَارْعَوْا أَنْعَامَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي النُّهَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Eat and pasture your cattle; verily, in this are Ayat for men of understanding.

55.verse: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thereof We created you, and into it We shall return you, and from it We shall bring you out once again.

56.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَاهُ آيَاتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We showed him (Fir`awn) all Our Ayat, but he denied and refused.

57.verse: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Fir`awn) said: "Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Musa"

58.verse: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِ فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلَا أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then verily, we can produce magic the like thereof; so appoint a meeting between us and you, which neither we nor you shall fail to keep, in an open place where both shall have a just and equal chance."

59.verse: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "Your appointed meeting is the day of the festival, and let the people assemble when the sun has risen (forenoon)."

60.verse: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So Fir`awn withdrew, devised his plot and then came back.

61.verse: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Musa said to them: "Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He should destroy you completely by a torment. And surely, he who invents a lie (against Allah) will fail miserably."

62.verse: فَتَنَازَعُوا أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their talk secret.

63.verse: قَالُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Verily, these are two magicians. Their object is to drive you out from your land with magic, and to take you away from your exemplary way."

64.verse: فَأَجْمِعُوا كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ائْتُوا صَفًّا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْيَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So devise your plot, and then assemble in line. And whoever overcomes this day will be indeed successful."

65.verse: قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "O Musa! Either you throw first or we be the first to throw"

66.verse: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Musa] said: "Nay, throw you (first)!" Then behold! their ropes and their sticks, by their magic, appeared to him as though they moved fast.

67.verse: فَأَوْجَسَ فِي نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So Musa conceived fear in himself.

68.verse: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْأَعْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We (Allah) said: "Fear not! Surely, you will have the upper hand."

69.verse: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوا ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And throw that which is in your right hand! It will swallow up that which they have made. That which they have made is only a magician's trick, and the magician will never be successful, to whatever amount (of skill) he may attain."

70.verse: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَارُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So the magicians fell down prostrate. They said: "We believe in the Lord of Harun and Musa."

71.verse: قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِي جُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَا أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Fir`awn) said: "Believe you in him before I give you permission Verily, he is your chief who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you on the trunks of date palms, and you shall surely know which of us can give the severe and more lasting torment. "

72.verse: قَالُوا لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَاءَنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالَّذِي فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَاقْضِ مَا أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِي هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We prefer you not over what have come to us of the clear signs and to Him (Allah) Who created us. So, decree whatever you desire to decree, for you can only' decree (regarding) this life of the world."

73.verse: إِنَّا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَايَانَا وَمَا أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, we have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our faults, and the magic to which you did compel us. And Allah is better as regards reward in comparison to your reward, and more lasting."

74.verse: إِنَّهُ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal, then surely, for him is Hell, wherein he will neither die nor live.

75.verse: وَمَن يَأْتِهِ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصَّالِحَاتِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجَاتُ الْعُلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, and has done righteous good deeds, for such are the high ranks,

76.verse: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Adn Gardens, under which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, and such is the reward of those who purify themselves.

77.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِي الْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَافُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We revealed to Musa: "Travel by night with My servants and strike a dry path for them in the sea, fearing neither to be overtaken nor being afraid."

78.verse: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ الْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Fir`awn pursued them with his hosts, but the sea [Al-Yamm] completely overwhelmed them and covered them up.

79.verse: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُ وَمَا هَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Fir`awn led his people astray, and he did not guide them.

80.verse: يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَاكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَاعَدْنَاكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We made a covenant with you on the right side of the Mount, and We sent down to you manna and quail,

81.verse: كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِي ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Saying) eat of the Tayyibat wherewith We have provided you, and commit no transgression or oppression therein, lest My anger should justly descend on you. And he on whom My anger descends, he is indeed perished.

82.verse: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, I am indeed forgiving to him who repents, believes and does righteous deeds, and then Ihtada.

83.verse: ۞ وَمَا أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And what made you hasten from your people, O Musa

84.verse: قَالَ هُمْ أُولَاءِ عَلَىٰ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "They are close on my footsteps, and I hastened to You, O my Lord, that You might be pleased."

85.verse: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِن بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "Verily, We have tried your people in your absence, and As-Samiri has led them astray."

86.verse: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Musa returned to his people in a state of anger and sorrow [Asif]. He said: "O my people! Did not your Lord promise you a fair promise Did then the promise seem to you long in coming Or did you desire that wrath should descend from your Lord on you, that you broke your promise to me"

87.verse: قَالُوا مَا أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَا أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَاهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى السَّامِرِيُّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We broke not the promise to you, of our own will, but we were made to carry the weight of the ornaments of the people, then we cast them, and that was what As-Samiri suggested."

88.verse: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوا هَـٰذَا إِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he took out for them a calf which was mooing. They said: "This is your god, and the god of Musa," but he had forgotten.

89.verse: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Did they not see that it could not return them a word (for answer), and that it had no power either to harm them or to do them good

90.verse: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَارُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوا أَمْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Harun indeed had said to them beforehand: "O my people! You are being tried in this, and verily, your Lord is (Allah) the Most Gracious, so follow me and obey my order."

91.verse: قَالُوا لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We will not stop worshipping it, until Musa returns to us."

92.verse: قَالَ يَا هَارُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "O Harun! What prevented you when you saw them going astray;"

93.verse: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That you followed me not (according to my advice to you) Have you then disobeyed my order"

94.verse: قَالَ يَا ابْنَ أُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأْسِي ۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Harun) said: "O son of my mother! Seize (me) not by my beard, nor by my head! Verily, I feared lest you should say: `You have caused a division among the Children of Israel, and you have not respected my word!"'

95.verse: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَا سَامِرِيُّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "And what is the matter with you. O Samiri"

96.verse: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا بِهِ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ الرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِي نَفْسِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Samiri) said: "I saw what they saw not, so I took a (Qabdah) handful (of dust) from the (hoof) print of the messenger and threw it. Thus my inner self suggested to me."

97.verse: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ إِلَـٰهِكَ الَّذِي ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُ فِي الْيَمِّ نَسْفًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Musa said: "Then go away! And verily, your (punishment) in this life will be that you will say: `Touch me not;' and verily, you have a promise that will not fail. And look at your god to which you have been devoted. We will certainly burn it, and scatter its particles in the sea."

98.verse: إِنَّمَا إِلَـٰهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Your God is only Allah, there is no God but Him. He has full knowledge of all things.

99.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus We relate to you some information of what happened before. And indeed We have given you from Us a Reminder.

100.verse: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وِزْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whoever turns away from it, verily, they will bear a heavy burden on the Day of Resurrection.

101.verse: خَالِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَاءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حِمْلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will abide in that -- and evil indeed will it be that load for them on the Day of Resurrection.

102.verse: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when the Sur will be blown: that Day, We shall gather the criminals blue-eyed.

103.verse: يَتَخَافَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will speak in a very low voice to each other (saying): "You stayed not longer than ten."

104.verse: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We know very well what they will say, when the best among them in knowledge and wisdom will say: "You stayed no longer than a day!"

105.verse: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسْفًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they ask you concerning the mountains. Say: "My Lord will blast them and scatter them as particles of dust."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then He shall leave it as a level smooth plain."

107.verse: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You will see therein no crookedness nor curve."

108.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ الْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On that Day mankind will follow strictly (the voice of) Allah's caller, no crookedness (that is without going to the right or left of that voice) will they show him (Allah's caller). And all voices will be humbled for the Most Gracious (Allah), and nothing shall you hear except Hamsa.

109.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُ قَوْلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On that day no intercession shall avail, except the one for whom the Most Gracious has given permission and whose word is acceptable to Him.

110.verse: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He knows what happens to them, and what will happen to them, but they will never encompass anything of His knowledge.

111.verse: ۞ وَعَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (all) faces shall be humbled before the Ever Living, the Sustainer. And he who carried wrongdoing, will be indeed a complete failure.

112.verse: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he who works deeds of righteousness, while he is a believer, then he will have no fear of injustice, nor of any curtailment.

113.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And thus We have sent it down as a Qur'an in Arabic, and have explained therein in detail the warnings, in order that they may have Taqwa, or that it may cause them to have a lesson from it.

114.verse: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then High above all be Allah, the True King. And be not in haste with the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say: "My Lord! Increase me in knowledge."

115.verse: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَا إِلَىٰ آدَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We made a covenant with Adam before, but he forgot, and We found on his part no firm willpower.

116.verse: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) when We said to the angels: "Prostrate yourselves to Adam." They prostrated themselves (all) except Iblis; he refused.

117.verse: فَقُلْنَا يَا آدَمُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We said: "O Adam! Verily, this is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not get you both out of Paradise, so that you will be distressed."

118.verse: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You will never be hungry therein nor naked."

119.verse: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَأُ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And you (will) suffer not from thirst therein nor from the sun's heat."

120.verse: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ قَالَ يَا آدَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Shaytan whispered to him, saying: "O Adam! Shall I lead you to the Tree of Eternity and to a kingdom that will never waste away"

121.verse: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰ آدَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they both ate of the Tree, and so their private parts became manifest to them, and they began to cover themselves with the leaves of the Paradise for their covering. Thus Adam disobeyd his Lord, so he went astray.

122.verse: ثُمَّ اجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then his Lord chose him, and turned to him with forgiveness, and gave him guidance.

123.verse: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدًى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Allah) said: "Get you down, both of you, together, some of you are an enemy to some others. Then if there comes to you guidance from Me, then whoever follows My guidance he shall neither go astray nor shall be distressed.

124.verse: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَعْمَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But whosoever turns away from My Reminder, verily, for him is a life of hardship, and We shall raise him up blind on the Day of Resurrection."

125.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِي أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will say: "O my Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)."

126.verse: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ آيَاتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) will say: "Like this Our Ayat came unto you, but you disregarded them, and so this Day, you will be neglected."

127.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِن بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And thus do We requite him who transgresses beyond bounds and believes not in the Ayat of his Lord; and the torment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting.

128.verse: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي النُّهَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they walk Verily, in this are signs indeed for men of understanding.

129.verse: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And had it not been for a Word that went forth before from your Lord, and a term determined, (their punishment) must necessarily have come (in this world).

130.verse: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ آنَاءِ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So bear patiently what they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting, and during some hours of the night, and at the ends of the day, that you may become pleased with the reward which Allah shall give you.

131.verse: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And strain not your eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to various groups of them, the splendor of the life of this world, that We may test them thereby. But the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.

132.verse: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And enjoin Salah on your family, and be patient in offering them. We ask not of you a provision: We provide for you. And the good end is for those who have Taqwa.

133.verse: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِآيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

134.verse: وَلَوْ أَنَّا أَهْلَكْنَاهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا لَوْلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if We had destroyed them with a torment before this, they would surely have said: "Our Lord! If only You had sent us a Messenger we should certainly have followed Your Ayat, before we were humiliated and disgraced."

135.verse: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَابُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Say) "Say, O Muhammad, to those who deny you, oppose you and continue in their disbelief and obstinance."

1.verse: اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Draws near for mankind their reckoning, while they turn away in heedlessness.

2.verse: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Comes not unto them an admonition from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play.

3.verse: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا هَلْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ السِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With their hearts occupied. Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): "Is this more than a human being like you Will you submit to magic while you see it"

4.verse: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "My Lord knows what is said in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower."

5.verse: بَلْ قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ بَلِ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِآيَةٍ كَمَا أُرْسِلَ الْأَوَّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, they say: "These are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented it! -- Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayah like the ones that were sent before!"

6.verse: مَا آمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Not one of the towns of those which We destroyed, believed before them; will they then believe.

7.verse: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We sent not before you but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder if you do not know.

8.verse: وَمَا جَعَلْنَاهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا خَالِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We did not place them in bodies that did not eat food, nor were they immortals.

9.verse: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَاهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَاهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَاءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We fulfilled to them the promise. So We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifin.

10.verse: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَابًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed, We have sent down for you a Book in which there is Dhikrukum. Will you not then understand

11.verse: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: How many a town given to wrongdoing, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!

12.verse: فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوا بَأْسَنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, when they sensed Our torment, behold, they (tried to) flee from it.

13.verse: لَا تَرْكُضُوا وَارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَا أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْأَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned.

14.verse: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They cried: "Woe to us! Certainly we have been wrongdoers."

15.verse: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَامِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct.

16.verse: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for play.

17.verse: لَوْ أَرَدْنَا أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّاتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا إِن كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Had We intended to take a pastime, We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that).

18.verse: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ الْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, We fling the truth against the falsehood, so it destroys it, and behold, it disappears. And woe to you for that which you ascribe.

19.verse: وَلَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary.

20.verse: يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They glorify His praises night and day, they never slacken.

21.verse: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا آلِهَةً مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who raise the dead

22.verse: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) gods besides Allah, then verily, both would have been ruined. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, (High is He) above all that (evil) they associate with Him!

23.verse: لَا يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned.
