Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin taAArifu fee wujoohi allatheena kafaroo almunkara yakadoona yastoona biallatheena yatloona AAalayhim ayatina qul afaonabbiokum bisharrin min thalikum alnnaru waAAadaha Allahu allatheena kafaroo wabisa almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when Our clear Ayat are recited to them, you will notice a denial on the faces of the disbelievers! They are nearly ready to attack with violence those who recite Our Ayat to them. Say: "Shall I tell you of something worse than that The Fire which Allah has promised to those who disbelieved, and worst indeed is that destination!"

73.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْئًا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alnnasu duriba mathalun faistamiAAoo lahu inna allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lan yakhluqoo thubaban walawi ijtamaAAoo lahu wain yaslubuhumu alththubabu shayan la yastanqithoohu minhu daAAufa alttalibu waalmatloobu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O mankind! A parable has been made, so listen to it: Verily, those on whom you call besides Allah, cannot create a fly, even though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly snatches away a thing from them, they will have no power to release it from the fly. So weak are the seeker and the sought.

74.verse: مَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They have not regarded Allah with His rightful esteem. Verily, Allah is All-Strong, All-Mighty.

75.verse: اللَّهُ يَصْطَفِي مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ النَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu yastafee mina almalaikati rusulan wamina alnnasi inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah chooses Messengers from angels and from men. Verily, Allah is All-Hearer, All-Seer.

76.verse: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them. And to Allah return all matters.

77.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ارْكَعُوا وَاسْجُدُوا وَاعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُوا الْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo irkaAAoo waosjudoo waoAAbudoo rabbakum waifAAaloo alkhayra laAAallakum tuflihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Bow down, and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord and do good that you may be successful.

78.verse: وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ ۚ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِي هَـٰذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajahidoo fee Allahi haqqa jihadihi huwa ijtabakum wama jaAAala AAalaykum fee alddeeni min harajin millata abeekum ibraheema huwa sammakumu almuslimeena min qablu wafee hatha liyakoona alrrasoolu shaheedan AAalaykum watakoonoo shuhadaa AAala alnnasi faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waiAAtasimoo biAllahi huwa mawlakum faniAAma almawla waniAAma alnnaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And strive hard in Allah's cause as you ought to strive. He has chosen you, and has not laid upon you in religion any hardship: it is the religion of your father Ibrahim. He has named you Muslims both before and in this (Qur'an), that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you be witnesses over mankind! So, perform the Salah, give the Zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your Mawla, what an Excellent Mawla and what an Excellent Helper!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad aflaha almuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Successful indeed are the believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who with their Salah are Khashi`un.

3.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who turn away from Al-Laghw.

4.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَاةِ فَاعِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who pay the Zakah.

5.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who guard their private parts.

6.verse: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except from their wives or their right hand possessions, for then, they are free from blame.

7.verse: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors.

8.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who are faithfully true to their Amanat and to their covenants are Ra`un.

9.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who strictly guard their Salawat.

10.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika humu alwarithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: These are indeed the heirs.

11.verse: الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who shall inherit Firdaws. They shall dwell therein forever.

12.verse: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن سُلَالَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We created man out of an extract of Tin.

13.verse: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thereafter We made him a Nutfah in a safe lodging.

14.verse: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا آخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We made the Nutfah into a clot, then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.

15.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: After that, surely you will die.

16.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then (again), surely you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.

17.verse: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We have created above you seven Tara'iq, and We are never unaware of the creation.

18.verse: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We sent down from the sky water in measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are able to take it away.

19.verse: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat.

20.verse: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْآكِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a tree that springs forth from Tur Sinai, that grows oil, and relish for the eaters.

21.verse: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, in the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous benefits for you, and of them you eat.

22.verse: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on them, and on ships you are carried.

23.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We sent Nuh to his people, and he said: "O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other God but Him. Will you not then have Taqwa"

24.verse: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِي آبَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. Never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old."

25.verse: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while."

26.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

27.verse: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ ۙ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We revealed to him: "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our revelation. Then, when Our command comes, and (water) gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two, and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favor of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned."

28.verse: فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: `All the praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who are wrongdoers."

29.verse: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And say: `My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."'

30.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this, there are indeed Ayat, for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test.

31.verse: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا آخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, after them, We created another generation.

32.verse: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): "Worship Allah! You have no other God but Him. Will you not then have Taqwa"

33.verse: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of worldly life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink."

34.verse: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَاسِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily, you indeed would be losers."

35.verse: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive"

36.verse: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Far, very far is that which you are promised!"

37.verse: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!"

38.verse: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allah, and we are not going to believe in him."

39.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

40.verse: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "In a little while, they are sure to be regretful."

41.verse: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, the Sayhah overtook them in truth, and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So, away with the people who are wrongdoers.

42.verse: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا آخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, after them, We created other generations.

43.verse: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it.

44.verse: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَىٰ ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so, We made them follow one another, and We made them as Ahadith. So, away with a people who believe not!

45.verse: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We sent Musa and his brother Harun, with Our Ayat and manifest authority,

46.verse: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Fir`awn and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord).

47.verse: فَقَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility!"

48.verse: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, they denied them both and became of those who were destroyed.

49.verse: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We gave Musa the Scripture, that they may be guided.

50.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We made the son of Maryam and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on a Rabwah, Dhat Qarar, and Ma`in.

51.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا ۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O Messengers! Eat of the Tayyibat and do righteous deeds. Verily, I am Well-Acquainted with what you do.

52.verse: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, this your religion is one religion, and I am your Lord, so have Taqwa."

53.verse: فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in what is with it.

54.verse: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, leave them in their error for a time.

55.verse: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they think that in wealth and children with which We prolong them

56.verse: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We hasten unto them with good things. Nay, but they perceive not.

57.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;

58.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who believe in the Ayat of their Lord;

59.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who join not anyone as partners with their Lord;

60.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا آتَوا وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who give that which they give with their hearts full of fear, because they are sure to return to their Lord.

61.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them.

62.verse: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We task not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.

63.verse: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but their hearts are covered from this, and they have other deeds, besides which they are doing.

64.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Until when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment; behold, they make humble invocation with a loud voice.

65.verse: لَا تَجْأَرُوا الْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly you shall not be helped by Us.

66.verse: قَدْ كَانَتْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed My Ayat used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels.

67.verse: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In pride, talking evil about it by night.

68.verse: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ آبَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have they not pondered over the Word, or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old

69.verse: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger so they deny him

70.verse: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ ۚ بَلْ جَاءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or they say: There is madness in him Nay, but he brought them the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.

71.verse: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if Al-Haqq had followed their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder.

72.verse: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is it that you ask them for some Kharj But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance.

73.verse: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And certainly, you call them to the straight path.

74.verse: وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the path.

75.verse: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

76.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke with submission to Him.

77.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged in despair.

78.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is He Who has created for you hearing, eyes, and hearts. Little thanks you give.

79.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.

80.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand

81.verse: بَلْ قَالُوا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.

82.verse: قَالُوا أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed"

83.verse: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, this we have been promised -- we and our fathers before! This is only (from) tales of the ancients!") Allah's saying:

84.verse: قُل لِّمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَا إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein If you know!"

85.verse: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "It is Allah's!" Say: "Will you not then remember"

86.verse: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne"

87.verse: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Allah." Say: "Will you not then have Taqwa"

88.verse: قُلْ مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything And He protects, while against Whom there is no protector, if you know"

89.verse: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "(All that belongs) to Allah." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth"

90.verse: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but We have brought them the truth, and verily, they are liars.

91.verse: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No son (or offspring) did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allah above all that they attribute to Him!

92.verse: عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted be He over all that they associate as partners to Him!

93.verse: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened, "

94.verse: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "My Lord! Then, put me not amongst the people who are the wrongdoers."

95.verse: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We are able to show you that with which We have threatened them.

96.verse: ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Repel evil with that which is better. We are best-acquainted with the things they utter.

97.verse: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And say: "My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings of the Shayatin."

98.verse: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they should come near me."

99.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "My Lord! Send me back,"

100.verse: لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّا ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَائِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!" No! (Kalla) It is but a word that he speaks; and in front of them is Barzakh until the Day when they will be resurrected.

101.verse: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another.

102.verse: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, those whose Scales (of good deeds) are heavy, these! they are the successful.

103.verse: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those whose Scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose themselves, in Hell will they abide.

104.verse: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured).

105.verse: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Were not My Ayat recited to you, and then you used to deny them"

106.verse: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people."

107.verse: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be wrongdoers."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Allah) will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me!"

109.verse: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, there was a party of My servants who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!"

110.verse: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But you took them for a laughing stock, so much so that they made you forget My remembrance while you used to laugh at them!

111.verse: إِنِّي جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, I have rewarded them this Day for their patience; they are indeed the ones that are successful.

112.verse: قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth"

113.verse: قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَاسْأَلِ الْعَادِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account."

114.verse: قَالَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!"

115.verse: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Did you think that We had created you in play, and that you would not be brought back to Us"

116.verse: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۖ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So Exalted be Allah, the True King: None has the right to be worshipped but He, the Lord of Al-`Arsh Al-Karim!

117.verse: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whoever invokes besides Allah, any other god, of whom he has no proof; then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely, disbelievers will not be successful.

118.verse: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And say: "My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!"

1.verse: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَاهَا وَفَرَضْنَاهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَا آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sooratun anzalnaha wafaradnaha waanzalna feeha ayatin bayyinatin laAAallakum tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A Surah which We have sent down and which We have enjoined (Faradnaha), and in it We have revealed manifest Ayat, that you may remember.

2.verse: الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alzzaniyatu waalzzanee faijlidoo kulla wahidin minhuma miata jaldatin wala takhuthkum bihima rafatun fee deeni Allahi in kuntum tuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri walyashhad AAathabahuma taifatun mina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Zaniyah and the Zani, flog each of them with a hundred stripes. Let not pity withhold you in their case, in a punishment prescribed by Allah, if you believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of the believers witness their punishment.

3.verse: الزَّانِي لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alzzanee la yankihu illa zaniyatan aw mushrikatan waalzzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin aw mushrikun wahurrima thalika AAala almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Zani marries not but a Zaniyah or a Mushrikah; and the Zaniyah, none marries her except a Zani or a Mushrik. Such a thing is forbidden to the believers.

4.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا ۚ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yarmoona almuhsanati thumma lam yatoo biarbaAAati shuhadaa faijlidoohum thamaneena jaldatan wala taqbaloo lahum shahadatan abadan waolaika humu alfasiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who accuse chaste women, and produce not four witnesses, flog them with eighty stripes, and reject their testimony forever. They indeed are the rebellious.

5.verse: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa allatheena taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who repent thereafter and do righteous deeds; (for such) verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

6.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yarmoona azwajahum walam yakun lahum shuhadao illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arbaAAu shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alssadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And for those who accuse their wives, but have no witnesses except themselves, let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies by Allah that he is one of those who speak the truth.

7.verse: وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalkhamisatu anna laAAnata Allahi AAalayhi in kana mina alkathibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the fifth (testimony); invoking of the curse of Allah on him if he be of those who tell a lie.

8.verse: وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayadrao AAanha alAAathaba an tashhada arbaAAa shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alkathibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But she shall avert the punishment from her, if she bears witness four times by Allah, that he is telling a lie.

9.verse: وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalkhamisata anna ghadaba Allahi AAalayha in kana mina alssadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the fifth; should be that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaks the truth.

10.verse: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha tawwabun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy on you! And that Allah is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, the All-Wise.

11.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُوا بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُم مَّا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ ۚ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena jaoo bialifki AAusbatun minkum la tahsaboohu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli imriin minhum ma iktasaba mina alithmi waallathee tawalla kibrahu minhum lahu AAathabun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who brought forth the slander are a group among you. Consider it not a bad thing for you. Nay, it is good for you. Unto every man among them will be paid that which he had earned of the sin, and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be a great torment.

12.verse: لَّوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا هَـٰذَا إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lawla ith samiAAtumoohu thanna almuminoona waalmuminatu bianfusihim khayran waqaloo hatha ifkun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Why then, did not the believers, men and women, when you heard it, think good of their own people and say: "This is an obvious lie"

13.verse: لَّوْلَا جَاءُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lawla jaoo AAalayhi biarbaAAati shuhadaa faith lam yatoo bialshshuhadai faolaika AAinda Allahi humu alkathiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Why did they not produce four witnesses against him Since they have not produced witnesses! Then with Allah, they are the liars.

14.verse: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu fee alddunya waalakhirati lamassakum fee ma afadtum feehi AAathabun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in this world and in the Hereafter, a great torment would have touched you for that whereof you had spoken.

15.verse: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith talaqqawnahu bialsinatikum wataqooloona biafwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi AAilmun watahsaboonahu hayyinan wahuwa AAinda Allahi AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When you were propagating it with your tongues, and uttering with your mouths that whereof you had no knowledge, you counted it a little thing, while with Allah it was very great.

16.verse: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَـٰذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَـٰذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla ith samiAAtumoohu qultum ma yakoonu lana an natakallama bihatha subhanaka hatha buhtanun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And why did you not, when you heard it, say: "It is not right for us to speak of this. Glory be to You (O Allah)! This is a great lie."

17.verse: يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YaAAithukumu Allahu an taAAoodoo limithlihi abadan in kuntum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah forbids you from it and warns you not to repeat the like of it forever, if you are believers.

18.verse: وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah makes the Ayat plain to you, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

19.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena yuhibboona an tasheeAAa alfahishatu fee allatheena amanoo lahum AAathabun aleemun fee alddunya waalakhirati waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who like that Fahishah should be circulated among those who believe, they will have a painful torment in this world and in the Hereafter. And Allah knows and you know not.

20.verse: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha raoofun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy on you, and that Allah is full of kindness, Most Merciful.

21.verse: ۞ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani waman yattabiAA khutuwati alshshaytani fainnahu yamuru bialfahshai waalmunkari walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ahadin abadan walakinna Allaha yuzakkee man yashao waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Follow not the Khutuwat of Shaytan. And whosoever follows the footsteps of Shaytan, then, verily, he commands Al-Fahsha' and the evil deeds. And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy on you, not one of you would ever have been pure from sins. But Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

22.verse: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا وَلْيَصْفَحُوا ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yatali oloo alfadli minkum waalssaAAati an yutoo olee alqurba waalmasakeena waalmuhajireena fee sabeeli Allahi walyaAAfoo walyasfahoo ala tuhibboona an yaghfira Allahu lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And let not those among you who are blessed with graces and wealth swear not to give to their kinsmen, the poor, and those who left their homes for Allah's cause. Let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

23.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ لُعِنُوا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena yarmoona almuhsanati alghafilati almuminati luAAinoo fee alddunya waalakhirati walahum AAathabun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who accuse chaste believing women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity and are good believers -- are cursed in this life and in the Hereafter, and for them will be a great torment.

24.verse: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tashhadu AAalayhim alsinatuhum waaydeehim waarjuluhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their legs will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

25.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawmaithin yuwaffeehimu Allahu deenahumu alhaqqa wayaAAlamoona anna Allaha huwa alhaqqu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On that Day Allah will pay them the recompense of their deeds in full, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.

26.verse: الْخَبِيثَاتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَاتِ ۖ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَاتِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alkhabeethatu lilkhabeetheena waalkhabeethoona lilkhabeethati waalttayyibatu lilttayyibeena waalttayyiboona lilttayyibati olaika mubarraoona mimma yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Bad statements are for bad people and bad people for bad statements. Good statements are for good people and good people for good statements: such are innocent of (every) bad statement which they say; for them is forgiveness, and honored provision.

27.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا وَتُسَلِّمُوا عَلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hatta tastanisoo watusallimoo AAala ahliha thalikum khayrun lakum laAAallakum tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Enter not houses other than your own, until you have asked permission and greeted those in them; that is better for you, in order that you may remember.

28.verse: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا فِيهَا أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ارْجِعُوا فَارْجِعُوا ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fain lam tajidoo feeha ahadan fala tadkhulooha hatta yuthana lakum wain qeela lakumu irjiAAoo fairjiAAoo huwa azka lakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if you find no one therein, still enter not until permission has been given. And if you are asked to go back, go back, for it is purer for you. And Allah is All-Knower of what you do.

29.verse: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَاعٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laysa AAalaykum junahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feeha mataAAun lakum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is no sin on you that you enter houses uninhabited, you have any interest in them. And Allah has knowledge of what you reveal and what you conceal.

30.verse: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul lilmumineena yaghuddoo min absarihum wayahfathoo furoojahum thalika azka lahum inna Allaha khabeerun bima yasnaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze, and protect their private parts. That is purer for them. Verily, Allah is All-Aware of what they do.

31.verse: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَائِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَائِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَائِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا عَلَىٰ عَوْرَاتِ النِّسَاءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqul lilmuminati yaghdudna min absarihinna wayahfathna furoojahunna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa ma thahara minha walyadribna bikhumurihinna AAala juyoobihinna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa libuAAoolatihinna aw abaihinna aw abai buAAoolatihinna aw abnaihinna aw abnai buAAoolatihinna aw ikhwanihinna aw banee ikhwanihinna aw banee akhawatihinna aw nisaihinna aw ma malakat aymanuhunna awi alttabiAAeena ghayri olee alirbati mina alrrijali awi alttifli allatheena lam yathharoo AAala AAawrati alnnisai wala yadribna biarjulihinna liyuAAlama ma yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watooboo ila Allahi jameeAAan ayyuha almuminoona laAAallakum tuflihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze, and protect their private parts and not to show off their adornment except that which is apparent, and to draw their veils all over their Juyub and not to reveal their adornment except to their husbands, or their fathers, or their husband's fathers, or their sons, or their husband's sons, or their brothers or their brother's sons, or their sister's sons, or their women, or their right hand possessions, or the Tabi`in among men who do not have desire, or children who are not aware of the nakedness of women. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And all of you beg Allah to forgive you all, O believers, that you may be successful.

32.verse: وَأَنكِحُوا الْأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ ۚ إِن يَكُونُوا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waankihoo alayama minkum waalssaliheena min AAibadikum waimaikum in yakoonoo fuqaraa yughnihimu Allahu min fadlihi waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And marry those among you who are single (Al-Ayama) and the pious of your servants and maidservants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them out of His bounty. And Allah is All-Sufficent, All-Knowing.

33.verse: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا ۖ وَآتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي آتَاكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوا عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مِن بَعْدِ إِكْرَاهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WalyastaAAfifi allatheena la yajidoona nikahan hatta yughniyahumu Allahu min fadlihi waallatheena yabtaghoona alkitaba mimma malakat aymanukum fakatiboohum in AAalimtum feehim khayran waatoohum min mali Allahi allathee atakum wala tukrihoo fatayatikum AAala albighai in aradna tahassunan litabtaghoo AAarada alhayati alddunya waman yukrihhunna fainna Allaha min baAAdi ikrahihinna ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And let those who find not the financial means for marriage keep themselves chaste, until Allah enriches them of His bounty. And such of your servants as seek a writing (of emancipation), give them such writing, if you find that there is good and honesty in them. And give them something (yourselves) out of the wealth of Allah which He has bestowed upon you. And force not your slave-girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, in order that you may make a gain in the goods of this worldly life. But if anyone compels them, then after such compulsion, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

34.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad anzalna ilaykum ayatin mubayyinatin wamathalan mina allatheena khalaw min qablikum wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We have sent down for you Ayat that make things plain, and the example of those who passed away before you, and an admonition for those who have Taqwa.

35.verse: ۞ اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ ۗ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu nooru alssamawati waalardi mathalu noorihi kamishkatin feeha misbahun almisbahu fee zujajatin alzzujajatu kaannaha kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubarakatin zaytoonatin la sharqiyyatin wala gharbiyyatin yakadu zaytuha yudeeo walaw lam tamsashu narun noorun AAala noorin yahdee Allahu linoorihi man yashao wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His Light is as a niche and within it a lamp: the lamp is in a glass, the glass as it were a star Durriyyun, lit from a blessed tree, an olive, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow forth, though no fire touched it. Light upon Light! Allah guides to His Light whom He wills. And Allah sets forth parables for mankind, and Allah is All-Knower of everything.

36.verse: فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee buyootin athina Allahu an turfaAAa wayuthkara feeha ismuhu yusabbihu lahu feeha bialghuduwwi waalasali

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In houses which Allah has ordered to be raised, in them His Name is remembered. Therein glorify Him in the mornings and in the evenings,

37.verse: رِجَالٌ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rijalun la tulheehim tijaratun wala bayAAun AAan thikri Allahi waiqami alssalati waeetai alzzakati yakhafoona yawman tataqallabu feehi alquloobu waalabsaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Men whom neither trade nor business diverts from the remembrance of Allah nor from performing the Salah nor from giving the Zakah. They fear a Day when hearts and eyes will be overturned.

38.verse: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma AAamiloo wayazeedahum min fadlihi waAllahu yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That Allah may reward them according to the best of their deeds, and add even more for them out of His grace. And Allah provides without measure to whom He wills.

39.verse: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْآنُ مَاءً حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئًا وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ فَوَفَّاهُ حِسَابَهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena kafaroo aAAmaluhum kasarabin biqeeAAatin yahsabuhu alththamanu maan hatta itha jaahu lam yajidhu shayan wawajada Allaha AAindahu fawaffahu hisabahu waAllahu sareeAAu alhisabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As for those who disbelieved, their deeds are like a mirage in a Qi`ah. The thirsty one thinks it to be water until he comes up to it, he finds it to be nothing; but he finds Allah with him, Who will pay him his due. And Allah is swift in taking account.

40.verse: أَوْ كَظُلُمَاتٍ فِي بَحْرٍ لُّجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ ۚ ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَا أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَاهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُ مِن نُّورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw kathulumatin fee bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi sahabun thulumatun baAAduha fawqa baAAdin itha akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraha waman lam yajAAali Allahu lahu nooran fama lahu min noorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or like the darkness in a vast deep sea, overwhelmed with waves topped by waves, topped by dark clouds, (layers of) darkness upon darkness: if a man stretches out his hand, he can hardly see it! And he for whom Allah has not appointed light, for him there is no light.

41.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صَافَّاتٍ ۖ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara anna Allaha yusabbihu lahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waalttayru saffatin kullun qad AAalima salatahu watasbeehahu waAllahu AAaleemun bima yafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not that Allah, He it is Whom glorify whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, and the birds with wings outspread Of each one He knows indeed his Salah and his glorification; and Allah is All-Aware of what they do.

42.verse: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to Allah belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the return.

43.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِن بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَن مَّن يَشَاءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصَارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara anna Allaha yuzjee sahaban thumma yuallifu baynahu thumma yajAAaluhu rukaman fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi wayunazzilu mina alssamai min jibalin feeha min baradin fayuseebu bihi man yashao wayasrifuhu AAan man yashao yakadu sana barqihi yathhabu bialabsari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not that Allah drives the clouds gently, then joins them together, then makes them into a heap of layers, and you see the rain come forth from between them; and He sends down from the sky, from mountains in it of ice, and strikes therewith whom He wills, and averts it from whom He wills. The vivid flash of its (clouds) lightning nearly blinds the sight.

44.verse: يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yuqallibu Allahu allayla waalnnahara inna fee thalika laAAibratan liolee alabsari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah causes the night and the day to succeed each other. Truly, in this is indeed a lesson for those who have insight.

45.verse: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ أَرْبَعٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshee AAala batnihi waminhum man yamshee AAala rijlayni waminhum man yamshee AAala arbaAAin yakhluqu Allahu ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
