Translations.translation: Allah has created every moving creature from water. Of them there are some that creep on their bellies, and some that walk on two legs, and some that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Verily, Allah is able to do all things.

46.verse: لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad anzalna ayatin mubayyinatin waAllahu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We have indeed sent down manifest Ayat. And Allah guides whom He wills to the straight path.

47.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا أُولَـٰئِكَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayaqooloona amanna biAllahi wabialrrasooli waataAAna thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum min baAAdi thalika wama olaika bialmumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They say: "We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obey," then a party of them turn away thereafter, such are not believers.

48.verse: وَإِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum itha fareequn minhum muAAridoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger, to judge between them, lo! a party of them refuses and turns away.

49.verse: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain yakun lahumu alhaqqu yatoo ilayhi muthAAineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But if the truth is on their side, they come to him willingly with submission.

50.verse: أَفِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتَابُوا أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ ۚ بَلْ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afee quloobihim maradun ami irtaboo am yakhafoona an yaheefa Allahu AAalayhim warasooluhu bal olaika humu alththalimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is there a disease in their hearts Or do they doubt or fear lest Allah and His Messenger should wrong them in judgement. Nay, it is they themselves who are the wrongdoers.

51.verse: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۚ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama kana qawla almumineena itha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqooloo samiAAna waataAAna waolaika humu almuflihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The only saying of the faithful believers, when they are called to Allah and His Messenger, to judge between them, is that they say: "We hear and we obey." And such are the successful.

52.verse: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَخْشَ اللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu wayakhsha Allaha wayattaqhi faolaika humu alfaizoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whosoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, fears Allah, and has Taqwa of Him, such are the successful.

53.verse: ۞ وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا ۖ طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain amartahum layakhrujunna qul la tuqsimoo taAAatun maAAroofatun inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if only you would order them, they would leave. Say: "Swear you not; obedience is known. Verily, Allah knows well what you do."

54.verse: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا ۚ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayhi ma hummila waAAalaykum ma hummiltum wain tuteeAAoohu tahtadoo wama AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu almubeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, but if you turn away, he is only responsible for the duty placed on him and you for that placed on you. If you obey him, you shall be on the right guidance. The Messenger's duty is only to convey (the Message) in a clear way.") Allah says about the hypocrites who had promised the Messenger and sworn that if he were to command them to go out for battle, they would go:

55.verse: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ الَّذِي ارْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّن بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا ۚ يَعْبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِي شَيْئًا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waAAamiloo alssalihati layastakhlifannahum fee alardi kama istakhlafa allatheena min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu allathee irtada lahum walayubaddilannahum min baAAdi khawfihim amnan yaAAbudoonanee la yushrikoona bee shayan waman kafara baAAda thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah has promised those among you who believe and do righteous good deeds, that He will certainly grant them succession in the land, as He granted it to those before them, and that He will grant them the authority to practise their religion which He has chosen for them. And He will surely give them in exchange a safe security after their fear if they worship Me and do not associate anything with Me. But whoever disbelieved after this, they are the rebellious.

56.verse: وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo alrrasoola laAAallakum turhamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And perform the Salah, and give the Zakah and obey the Messenger that you may receive mercy.

57.verse: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ ۖ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tahsabanna allatheena kafaroo muAAjizeena fee alardi wamawahumu alnnaru walabisa almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Consider not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Their abode shall be the Fire -- and worst indeed is that destination.

58.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِيَسْتَأْذِنكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِن بَعْدِ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ ۚ ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّافُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo liyastathinkumu allatheena malakat aymanukum waallatheena lam yablughoo alhuluma minkum thalatha marratin min qabli salati alfajri waheena tadaAAoona thiyabakum mina alththaheerati wamin baAAdi salati alAAishai thalathu AAawratin lakum laysa AAalaykum wala AAalayhim junahun baAAdahunna tawwafoona AAalaykum baAAdukum AAala baAAdin kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Let your slaves and slave-girls, and those among you who have not come to the age of puberty ask your permission on three occasions: before the Fajr prayer, and while you put off your clothes during the afternoon, and after the `Isha' prayer. (These) three (times) are of privacy for you; other than these times there is no sin on you or on them to move about, attending to each other. Thus Allah makes clear the Ayat to you. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

59.verse: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ الْأَطْفَالُ مِنكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَأْذِنُوا كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ آيَاتِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha balagha alatfalu minkumu alhuluma falyastathinoo kama istathana allatheena min qablihim kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the children among you come to puberty, then let them (also) ask for permission, as those senior to them (in age) ask permission. Thus Allah makes clear His Ayat for you. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

60.verse: وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَاتٍ بِزِينَةٍ ۖ وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalqawaAAidu mina alnnisai allatee la yarjoona nikahan falaysa AAalayhinna junahun an yadaAAna thiyabahunna ghayra mutabarrijatin bizeenatin waan yastaAAfifna khayrun lahunna waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Qawa`id among women who do not hope for marriage, it is no sin on them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show their adornment. But to refrain is better for them. And Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

61.verse: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا مِن بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ آبَائِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَانِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَامِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَالِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَالَاتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأْكُلُوا جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا ۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ مُبَارَكَةً طَيِّبَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun wala AAala anfusikum an takuloo min buyootikum aw buyooti abaikum aw buyooti ommahatikum aw buyooti ikhwanikum aw buyooti akhawatikum aw buyooti aAAmamikum aw buyooti AAammatikum aw buyooti akhwalikum aw buyooti khalatikum aw ma malaktum mafatihahu aw sadeeqikum laysa AAalaykum junahun an takuloo jameeAAan aw ashtatan faitha dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo AAala anfusikum tahiyyatan min AAindi Allahi mubarakatan tayyibatan kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is no restriction on the blind, nor any restriction on the lame, nor any restriction on the sick, nor on yourselves, if you eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your father's brothers, or the houses of your father's sisters, or the houses of your mother's brothers, or the houses of your mother's sisters, or (from that) whereof you hold keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin on you whether you eat together or apart. But when you enter the houses, greet one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus Allah makes clear the Ayat to you that you may understand.

62.verse: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا مَعَهُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۚ فَإِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi waitha kanoo maAAahu AAala amrin jamiAAin lam yathhaboo hatta yastathinoohu inna allatheena yastathinoonaka olaika allatheena yuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi faitha istathanooka libaAAdi shanihim fathan liman shita minhum waistaghfir lahumu Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger; and when they are with him on some common matter, they go not away until they have asked his permission. Verily, those who ask your permission, those are they who (really) believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they ask your permission for some affairs of theirs, give permission to whom you will of them, and ask Allah for their forgiveness. Truly, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

63.verse: لَّا تَجْعَلُوا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tajAAaloo duAAaa alrrasooli baynakum kaduAAai baAAdikum baAAdan qad yaAAlamu Allahu allatheena yatasallaloona minkum liwathan falyahthari allatheena yukhalifoona AAan amrihi an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Make not the calling of the Messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knows those of you who slip away under shelter. And let those beware who oppose the Messenger's commandment, lest some Fitnah should befall them or a painful torment be inflicted on them.

64.verse: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ala inna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi qad yaAAlamu ma antum AAalayhi wayawma yurjaAAoona ilayhi fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Certainly, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He knows your condition and the Day when they will be brought back to Him, then He will inform them of what they did. And Allah is All-Knower of everything.

1.verse: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabaraka allathee nazzala alfurqana AAala AAabdihi liyakoona lilAAalameena natheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Blessed be He Who sent down (Nazzala) the criterion to His servant that he may be a warner to all nations.

2.verse: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقْدِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi walam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Who has begotten no son and for Whom there is no partner in the dominion. He has created everything, and has measured it exactly according to its due measurements.

3.verse: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَاةً وَلَا نُشُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona wala yamlikoona lianfusihim darran wala nafAAan wala yamlikoona mawtan wala hayatan wala nushooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Yet they have taken besides Him other gods who created nothing but are themselves created, and possess neither harm nor benefit for themselves, and possess no power (of causing) death, nor (of giving) life, nor of raising the dead.

4.verse: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ افْتَرَاهُ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ آخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَاءُوا ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa ifkun iftarahu waaAAanahu AAalayhi qawmun akharoona faqad jaoo thulman wazooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who disbelieve say: "This is nothing but a lie that he has invented, and others have helped him in it." In fact, they have produced an unjust wrong and a lie.

5.verse: وَقَالُوا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo asateeru alawwaleena iktatabaha fahiya tumla AAalayhi bukratan waaseelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "Tales of the ancients which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon. "

6.verse: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul anzalahu allathee yaAAlamu alssirra fee alssamawati waalardi innahu kana ghafooran raheeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "It has been sent down by Him Who knows the secret of the heavens and the earth. Truly, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

7.verse: وَقَالُوا مَالِ هَـٰذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo mali hatha alrrasooli yakulu alttaAAama wayamshee fee alaswaqi lawla onzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona maAAahu natheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "Why does this Messenger eat food, and walk about in the markets. Why is not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him"

8.verse: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yulqa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahu jannatun yakulu minha waqala alththalimoona in tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Or (why) has not a treasure been granted to him, or why has he not a garden whereof he may eat" And the wrongdoers say: "You follow none but a man bewitched."

9.verse: انظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Onthur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoona sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See how they coin similitudes for you, so they have gone astray, and they cannot find a path.

10.verse: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِن شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabaraka allathee in shaa jaAAala laka khayran min thalika jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wayajAAal laka qusooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Blessed be He Who, if He wills, will assign you better than (all) that -- Gardens under which rivers flow and will assign you palaces.

11.verse: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal kaththaboo bialssaAAati waaAAtadna liman kaththaba bialssaAAati saAAeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, they deny the Hour, and for those who deny the Hour, We have prepared a flaming Fire.

12.verse: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha raathum min makanin baAAeedin samiAAoo laha taghayyuthan wazafeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When it sees them from a far place, they will hear its raging and its roaring.

13.verse: وَإِذَا أُلْقُوا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha olqoo minha makanan dayyiqan muqarraneena daAAaw hunalika thubooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they shall be thrown into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they will exclaim therein for destruction.

14.verse: لَّا تَدْعُوا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tadAAoo alyawma thubooran wahidan waodAAoo thubooran katheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Exclaim not today for one destruction, but exclaim for many destructions.

15.verse: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul athalika khayrun am jannatu alkhuldi allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona kanat lahum jazaan wamaseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Is that better or the Paradise of Eternity which is promised to those who have Taqwa" It will be theirs as a reward and final destination.

16.verse: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْئُولًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahum feeha ma yashaoona khalideena kana AAala rabbika waAAdan masoolan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For them there will be therein all that they desire, and they will abide (therein forever). It is upon your Lord a Wa`dan Mas'ula.

17.verse: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ أَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَـٰؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma yahshuruhum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi fayaqoolu aantum adlaltum AAibadee haolai am hum dalloo alssabeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on the Day when He will gather them together and that which they worship besides Allah. He will say: "Was it you who misled these My servants or did they stray from the path"

18.verse: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنبَغِي لَنَا أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا بُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo subhanaka ma kana yanbaghee lana an nattakhitha min doonika min awliyaa walakin mattaAAtahum waabaahum hatta nasoo alththikra wakanoo qawman booran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Glorified be You! It was not for us to take any Awliya' besides You, but You gave them and their fathers comfort till they forgot the warning, and became a lost people."

19.verse: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqad kaththabookum bima taqooloona fama tastateeAAoona sarfan wala nasran waman yathlim minkum nuthiqhu AAathaban kabeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus they will deny you in what you say; then you can neither avert nor find help. And whoever among you does wrong, We shall make him taste a great torment.

20.verse: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama arsalna qablaka mina almursaleena illa innahum layakuloona alttaAAama wayamshoona fee alaswaqi wajaAAalna baAAdakum libaAAdin fitnatan atasbiroona wakana rabbuka baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We never sent before you any of the Messengers but verily, they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you as a trial for others; will you have patience And your Lord is Ever All-Seer.

21.verse: ۞ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana lawla onzila AAalayna almalaikatu aw nara rabbana laqadi istakbaroo fee anfusihim waAAataw AAutuwwan kabeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who expect not a meeting with Us said: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord" Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and are scornful with great pride.

22.verse: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yarawna almalaikata la bushra yawmaithin lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijran mahjooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day they will see the angels -- no good news will there be for the criminals that day. And they will say: "Hijran Mahjura."

23.verse: وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَّنثُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqadimna ila ma AAamiloo min AAamalin fajaAAalnahu habaan manthooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did, and We shall make such deeds as scattered floating particles of dust.

24.verse: أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ashabu aljannati yawmaithin khayrun mustaqarran waahsanu maqeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The dwellers of Paradise will, on that Day, have the best abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.

25.verse: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma tashaqqaqu alssamao bialghamami wanuzzila almalaikatu tanzeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) the Day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down, with a grand descending.

26.verse: الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Almulku yawmaithin alhaqqu lilrrahmani wakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The sovereignty on that Day will be the true (sovereignty) of the Most Gracious, and it will be a hard Day for the disbelievers.

27.verse: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma yaAAaddu alththalimu AAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtu maAAa alrrasooli sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) the Day when the wrongdoer will bite at his hands, he will say: "Oh! Would that I had taken a path with the Messenger."

28.verse: يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya waylata laytanee lam attakhith fulanan khaleelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had never taken so-and-so as an intimate friend!"

29.verse: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي ۗ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْإِنسَانِ خَذُولًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder after it had come to me. And Shaytan is to man ever a deserter."

30.verse: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala alrrasoolu ya rabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqurana mahjooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Qur'an."

31.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus have We made for every Prophet an enemy among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.

32.verse: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi alquranu jumlatan wahidatan kathalika linuthabbita bihi fuadaka warattalnahu tarteelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who disbelieve say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once" Thus, that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages.

33.verse: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yatoonaka bimathalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi waahsana tafseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And no example or parable do they bring, but We reveal to you the truth, and the better explanation thereof.

34.verse: الَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُولَـٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yuhsharoona AAala wujoohihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan waadallu sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who will be gathered to Hell on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the path.

35.verse: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroona wazeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We gave Musa the Scripture, and placed his brother Harun with him as a helper;

36.verse: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqulna ithhaba ila alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fadammarnahum tadmeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayat." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.

37.verse: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ آيَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqawma noohin lamma kaththaboo alrrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum lilnnasi ayatan waaAAtadna lilththalimeena AAathaban aleeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Nuh's people, when they denied the Messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the wrongdoers.

38.verse: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAadan wathamooda waashaba alrrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (also) `Ad and Thamud, and the Dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.

39.verse: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakullan darabna lahu alamthala wakullan tabbarna tatbeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And for each We put forward examples, and each We brought to utter ruin.

40.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allatee omtirat matara alssawi afalam yakoonoo yarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed they have passed by the town on which was rained the evil rain. Did they not then see it Nay! But they used not to expect any resurrection.

41.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha raawka in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahu rasoolan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they see you, they treat you only in mockery (saying): "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a Messenger"

42.verse: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In kada layudilluna AAan alihatina lawla an sabarna AAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathaba man adallu sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He would have nearly misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know, when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the path!

43.verse: أَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you seen him who has taken as his god his own vain desire Would you then be a guardian over him

44.verse: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kaalanAAami bal hum adallu sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do you think that most of them hear or understand They are only like cattle -- nay, they are even farther astray from the path.

45.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alththilla walaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalna alshshamsa AAalayhi daleelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. If He willed, He could have made it still -- but We have made the sun its guide.

46.verse: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yaseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We withdraw it towards Ourselves -- a gradual withdrawal.

47.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla libasan waalnnawma subatan wajaAAala alnnahara nushooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who makes the night a covering for you, and the sleep (as) a repose, and makes the day Nushur.

48.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee arsala alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina alssamai maan tahooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy; and We send down pure water from the sky,

49.verse: لِّنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyya katheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give to drink thereof many of the cattle and men that We have created.

50.verse: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبَىٰ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We have distributed it among them in order that they may remember the grace of Allah, but most men refuse (out of) gratitude.

51.verse: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw shina labaAAathna fee kulli qaryatin natheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town.

52.verse: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُم بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala tutiAAi alkafireena wajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost endeavor with it.

53.verse: ۞ وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee maraja albahrayni hatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhun ojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijran mahjooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who has let free the two seas, this is palatable and sweet, and that is salty and bitter; and He has set a barrier and a complete partition between them.

54.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina almai basharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakana rabbuka qadeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who has created man from water, and has appointed for him kindred by blood, and kindred by marriage. And your Lord is Ever All-Powerful to do what He wills.

55.verse: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakana alkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they worship besides Allah, that which can neither profit them nor harm them; and the disbeliever is ever a helper against his Lord.

56.verse: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner.

57.verse: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَاءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin illa man shaa an yattakhitha ila rabbihi sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this, save that whosoever wills may take a path to his Lord."

58.verse: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allathee la yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafa bihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And put your trust in the Ever Living One Who dies not, and glorify His praises, and sufficient is He as the All-Knower of the sins of His servants,

59.verse: الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۚ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَاسْأَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days. Then He rose over (Istawa) the Throne. The Most Gracious! Ask Him, as He is the All-Knower.

60.verse: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوا لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا وَمَا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha qeela lahumu osjudoo lilrrahmani qaloo wama alrrahmanu anasjudu lima tamuruna wazadahum nufooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when it is said to them: "Prostrate yourselves to Ar-Rahman!" They say: "And what is Ar-Rahman Shall we fall down in prostration to that which you command us" And it increases in them only aversion.

61.verse: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabaraka allathee jaAAala fee alssamai buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajan waqamaran muneeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Blessed be He Who has placed in the heaven Al-Buruj, and has placed therein a great lamp, and a moon giving light.

62.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla waalnnahara khilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw arada shukooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He it is Who has put the night and the day in succession (Khilfatan), for such who desires to remember or desires to show his gratitude.

63.verse: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAibadu alrrahmani allatheena yamshoona AAala alardi hawnan waitha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloo salaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the servants of the Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth Hawna, and when the foolish address them they say; "Salama."

64.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who spend the night in worship of their Lord, prostrate and standing.

65.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana isrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabaha kana gharaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who say: "Our Lord! Avert from us the torment of Hell. Verily, its torment is ever an inseparable, permanent punishment."

66.verse: إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Evil indeed it is as an abode and as a place to rest in.

67.verse: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنفَقُوا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena itha anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalika qawaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor stingy, but are in a just balance between them.

68.verse: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena la yadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi wala yaznoona waman yafAAal thalika yalqa athaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who invoke not any other god along with Allah, nor kill such person as Allah has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse -- and whoever does this shall receive Athama.

69.verse: يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَانًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawma alqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhanan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The torment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace;

70.verse: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَـٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila AAamalan salihan faolaika yubaddilu Allahu sayyiatihim hasanatin wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for those, Allah will change their sins into good deeds, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

71.verse: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman taba waAAamila salihan fainnahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds; then indeed he has repented to Allah Mataba.

72.verse: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا كِرَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena la yashhadoona alzzoora waitha marroo biallaghwi marroo kiraman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.

73.verse: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena itha thukkiroo biayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summan waAAumyanan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayat of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

74.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of those who have Taqwa."

75.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika yujzawna alghurfata bima sabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those will be rewarded with the highest place because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.

76.verse: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalideena feeha hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Abiding therein -- excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

77.verse: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَأُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawla duAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied. So the torment will be yours forever."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Taseenmeem

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ta Sin Mim.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: These are Ayat of the Book Mubin.

3.verse: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It may be that you are going Bakhi` yourself, that they do not become believers.

4.verse: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ آيَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.

5.verse: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.

6.verse: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَاءُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, they have indeed denied, then the news of what they mocked at will come to them.

7.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not observe the earth -- how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein

8.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this is an Ayah, yet most of them are not believers.

9.verse: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

10.verse: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) when your Lord called Musa (saying): "Go to the people who are wrongdoers."

11.verse: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qawma firAAawna ala yattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The people of Fira`wn. Will they not have Taqwa"

12.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will deny me,"

13.verse: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَارُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Harun."

14.verse: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me. "

15.verse: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَاذْهَبَا بِآيَاتِنَا ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "Nay! Go you both with Our signs. Verily, We shall be with you, listening."

16.verse: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And go both of you to Fira`wn, and say: `We are the Messengers of the Lord of Al-`Alamin,'

17.verse: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An arsil maAAana banee israeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `So allow the Children of Israel to go with us."'

18.verse: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Fir`awn) said (to Musa): "Did we not bring you up among us as a child And you did dwell many years of your life with us."

19.verse: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And you did your deed, which you did. While you were one of the ingrates."

20.verse: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Musa said: "I did it then, when I was in error."

21.verse: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, I fled from you when I feared you. But my Lord has granted me Hukm, and made me one of the Messengers."

22.verse: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And this is the past favor with which you reproach me, -- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."

23.verse: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala firAAawnu wama rabbu alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Fir`awn said: "And what is the Lord of Al-`Alamin"

24.verse: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty."

25.verse: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala liman hawlahu ala tastamiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Fir`awn) said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)"

26.verse: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers!"

27.verse: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Fir`awn) said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!"

28.verse: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand!"

29.verse: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "If you choose a god other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners."

30.verse: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala awalaw jituka bishayin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Even if I bring you something manifest"

31.verse: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful!"

32.verse: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So he threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest.

33.verse: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!

34.verse: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said to the chiefs around him: "Verily, this is indeed a well-versed sorcerer."

35.verse: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command"

36.verse: قَالُوا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities;"

37.verse: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yatooka bikulli sahharin AAaleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."

38.verse: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajumiAAa alssaharatu limeeqati yawmin maAAloomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.

39.verse: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqeela lilnnasi hal antum mujtamiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble"

40.verse: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That we may follow the sorcerers if they are the winners."

41.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir`awn: "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners"

42.verse: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near (to myself)."

43.verse: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Musa said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw!"

44.verse: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir`awn, it is we who will certainly win!"

45.verse: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Musa threw his stick, and behold, it swallowed up all that they falsely showed!

46.verse: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faolqiya alssaharatu sajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the sorcerers fell down prostrate.

47.verse: قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of Al-`Alamin."

48.verse: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi moosa waharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The Lord of Musa and Harun."

49.verse: قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."

50.verse: قَالُوا لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord we are to return."

51.verse: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَن كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers."

52.verse: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We revealed to Musa, saying: "Depart by night with My servants, verily, you will be pursued."

53.verse: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faarsala firAAawnu fee almadaini hashireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Fir`awn sent callers to (all) the cities.

54.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna haolai lashirthimatun qaleeloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Saying): "Verily, these indeed are but a small band."

55.verse: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahum lana laghaithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And verily, they have done what has enraged us."

56.verse: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lajameeAAun hathiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "But we are a host all assembled, amply forewarned."

57.verse: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُم مِّن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhrajnahum min jannatin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,

58.verse: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakunoozin wamaqamin kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Treasures, and every kind of honorable place.

59.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika waawrathnaha banee israeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

60.verse: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaatbaAAoohum mushriqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, they pursued them at sunrise.

61.verse: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Musa said: "We are sure to be overtaken."

62.verse: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Musa) said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me."

63.verse: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We revealed to Musa (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part became like huge mountain.

64.verse: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waazlafna thamma alakhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We brought near the others to that place.

65.verse: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanjayna moosa waman maAAahu ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We saved Musa and all those with him.

66.verse: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We drowned the others.

67.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

68.verse: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

69.verse: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa ibraheema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And recite to them the story of Ibrahim.

70.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship"

71.verse: قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted."

72.verse: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala hal yasmaAAoonakum ith tadAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Do they hear you when you call"

73.verse: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yanfaAAoonakum aw yadurroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Or do they benefit you or do they cause harm"

74.verse: قَالُوا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so."

75.verse: قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala afaraaytum ma kuntum taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping --"

76.verse: أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Antum waabaokumu alaqdamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You and your ancient fathers"

77.verse: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, they are enemies to me, save the Lord of Al-`Alamin,"

78.verse: الَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee khalaqanee fahuwa yahdeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me.

79.verse: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee huwa yutAAimunee wayasqeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.

80.verse: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha maridtu fahuwa yashfeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me.

81.verse: وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee yumeetunee thumma yuhyeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life.

82.verse: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense.

83.verse: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: My Lord! Bestow Hukm on me, and join me with the righteous.

84.verse: وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And grant me an honorable mention in later generations.

85.verse: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaijAAalnee min warathati jannati alnnaAAeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.

86.verse: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And forgive my father, verily, he is of the erring.

87.verse: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tukhzinee yawma yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And disgrace me not on the Day when they will be resurrected.

88.verse: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,

89.verse: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except him who brings to Allah a clean heart.

90.verse: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to those who had Taqwa.

91.verse: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waburrizati aljaheemu lilghaweena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the astray.

92.verse: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it will be said to them: "Where are those that you used to worship."

93.verse: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Instead of Allah Can they help you or help themselves"

94.verse: فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakubkiboo feeha hum waalghawoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
