Translations.translation: Then they will be thrown on their faces into it (the Fire), they and the astray.

95.verse: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajunoodu ibleesa ajmaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And all of the hosts of Iblis together.

96.verse: قَالُوا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo wahum feeha yakhtasimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say while contending therein,

97.verse: تَاللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "By Allah, we were truly in a manifest error,

98.verse: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith nusawweekum birabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "When we held you as equals with the Lord of all that exists;"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adallana illa almujrimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And none has brought us into error except the criminals."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama lana min shafiAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Now we have no intercessors,"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala sadeeqin hameemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Nor a close friend."

102.verse: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "(Alas!) If we only had a chance to return, we shall truly be among the believers!"

103.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat qawmu noohin almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The people of Nuh denied the Messengers.

106.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When their brother Nuh said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

109.verse: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of all that exists."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo anuminu laka waittabaAAaka alarthaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Shall we believe in you, when the inferior follow you"

112.verse: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do"

113.verse: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama ana bitaridi almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And I am not going to drive away the believers."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In ana illa natheerun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I am only a plain warner."

116.verse: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا نُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "If you cease not, O Nuh you will surely be among those stoned."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi inna qawmee kaththabooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have denied me."

118.verse: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."

119.verse: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma aghraqna baAAdu albaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We drowned the rest thereafter.

121.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat AAadun almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Ad denied the Messengers.

124.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When their brother Hud said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, I am a trustworthy Messenger to you."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

127.verse: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of all that exists."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Atabnoona bikulli reeAAin ayatan taAAbathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Do you build on every Ri` an Ayah for your amusement"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watattakhithoona masaniAAa laAAallakum takhludoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And do you get for yourselves Masani` as if you will live therein forever"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha batashtum batashtum jabbareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waittaqoo allathee amaddakum bima taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And have Taqwa of Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amaddakum bianAAamin wabaneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He has aided you with cattle and children."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajannatin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And gardens and springs."

135.verse: إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."

136.verse: قَالُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In hatha illa khuluqu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "This is no other than Khuluq of the ancients,"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And we are not going to be punished."

139.verse: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the Almighty, the Most Merciful.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat thamoodu almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thamud denied the Messengers.

142.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

145.verse: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of Al-`Alamin."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Atutrakoona fee ma hahuna amineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Will you be left secure in that which you have here"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "In gardens and springs."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WazurooAAin wanakhlin talAAuha hadeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And crops and date palms with soft clusters."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan fariheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tuteeAAoo amra almusrifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And follow not the command of the extravagant,"

152.verse: الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "You are only of those bewitched!"

154.verse: مَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."

155.verse: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known."

156.verse: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaAAaqarooha faasbahoo nadimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they killed her, and then they became regretful.

158.verse: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, your Lord He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat qawmu lootin almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The people of Lut denied the Messengers.

161.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When their brother Lut said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, I am a trustworthy Messenger to you."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

164.verse: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of all that exits."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Atatoona alththukrana mina alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Go you in unto the males of Al-`Alamin (people),"

166.verse: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your wives Nay, you are a trespassing people!"

167.verse: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا لُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "If you cease not, O Lut, verily, you will be one of those who are driven out!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala innee liAAamalikum mina alqaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "I am indeed of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your behavior."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi najjinee waahlee mimma yaAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fanajjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We saved him and his family, all,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma dammarna alakhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

173.verse: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We rained on them a rain, and how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!

174.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththaba ashabu alaykati almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The companions of Al-Aykah denied the Messengers.

177.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When Shu`ayb said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me."

180.verse: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of Al-`Alamin."

181.verse: ۞ أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others)."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wazinoo bialqistasi almustaqeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And weigh with the true and straight balance."

183.verse: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waittaqoo allathee khalaqakum waaljibillata alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And have Taqwa of Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!"

186.verse: وَمَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!"

187.verse: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbee aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."

189.verse: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they denied him, so the torment of the Day of Shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.

190.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu latanzeelu rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And truly, this is a revelation from the Lord of all that exists,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nazala bihi alrroohu alameenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which the trustworthy Ruh (Jibril) has brought down.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala qalbika litakoona mina almunthireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Upon your heart that you may be (one) of the warners,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bilisanin AAarabiyyin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In the plain Arabic language.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu lafee zuburi alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, it is in the Zubur of the former people.

197.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars of the Children of Israel knew it

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw nazzalnahu AAala baAAdi alaAAjameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if We had revealed it unto any of the non-Arabs,

199.verse: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika salaknahu fee quloobi almujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the criminals.

201.verse: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fayaqooloo hal nahnu muntharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they will say: "Can we be respited"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Would they then wish for Our torment to be hastened on

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraayta in mattaAAnahum sineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Think, if We do let them enjoy for years,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma jaahum ma kanoo yooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And afterwards comes to them that which they had been promised.

207.verse: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُمَتَّعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.

208.verse: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thikra wama kunna thalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tanazzalat bihi alshshayateenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is not the Shayatin (devils) who have brought it down.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yanbaghee lahum wama yastateeAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Neither would it suit them nor are they able.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum AAani alssamAAi lamaAAzooloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.

213.verse: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, invoke not with Allah another god lest you should be among those who receive punishment.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanthir AAasheerataka alaqrabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And warn your tribe of near kindred.

215.verse: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.

216.verse: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watawakkal AAala alAAazeezi alrraheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee yaraka heena taqoomu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who sees you when you stand up.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wataqallubaka fee alssajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And your movements among those who fall prostrate.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

221.verse: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the Shayatin descend

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanazzalu AAala kulli affakin atheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They descend on every lying, sinful person (Athim).

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yulqoona alssamAAa waaktharuhum kathiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who gives ear, and most of them are liars.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalshshuAAarao yattabiAAuhumu alghawoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As for the poets, the astray follow them,

225.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not that they speak about every subject in their poetry

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahum yaqooloona ma la yafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that they say what they do not do.

227.verse: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانتَصَرُوا مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and remember Allah much and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.

1.verse: طس ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْقُرْآنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Taseen tilka ayatu alqurani wakitabin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ta Sin. These are the Ayat of the Qur'an, and (it is) a Book (that is) clear.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hudan wabushra lilmumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A guide and glad tidings for the believers.

3.verse: الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum yooqinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who perform the Salah and give the Zakah and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter.

4.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati zayyanna lahum aAAmalahum fahum yaAAmahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly.

5.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika allatheena lahum sooo alAAathabi wahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They are those for whom there will be an evil torment. And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

6.verse: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْآنَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnaka latulaqqa alqurana min ladun hakeemin AAaleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, you are being taught the Qur'an from One, All-Wise, All-Knowing.

7.verse: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِ إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا سَآتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ آتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala moosa liahlihi innee anastu naran saateekum minha bikhabarin aw ateekum bishihabin qabasin laAAallakum tastaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Remember) when Musa said to his household: "Verily, I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning ember, that you may warm yourselves."

8.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهَا نُودِيَ أَن بُورِكَ مَن فِي النَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaaha noodiya an boorika man fee alnnari waman hawlaha wasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified be Allah, the Lord of all that exists."

9.verse: يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya moosa innahu ana Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "O Musa! Verily, it is I, Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise."

10.verse: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَانٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa la takhaf innee la yakhafu ladayya almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And throw down your stick!" But when he saw it moving as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and did not look back. (It was said:) "O Musa! Fear not: verily, the Messengers fear not in front of Me."

11.verse: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًا بَعْدَ سُوءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man thalama thumma baddala husnan baAAda sooin fainnee ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good; then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

12.verse: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ ۖ فِي تِسْعِ آيَاتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waadkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin fee tisAAi ayatin ila firAAawna waqawmihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And put your hand into opening of your garment, it will come forth white without hurt. (These are) among the nine signs (you will take) to Fir`awn and his people. Verily, they are a people who are rebellious."

13.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaathum ayatuna mubsiratan qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when Our Ayat came to them, clear to see, they said: "This is a manifest magic."

14.verse: وَجَحَدُوا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا ۚ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajahadoo biha waistayqanatha anfusuhum thulman waAAuluwwan faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they belied them wrongfully and arrogantly, though they themselves were convinced thereof. So, see what was the end of the mischief-makers.

15.verse: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad atayna dawooda wasulaymana AAilman waqala alhamdu lillahi allathee faddalana AAala katheerin min AAibadihi almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We gave knowledge to Dawud and Sulayman, and they both said: "All praise be to Allah, Who has preferred us above many of His believing servants!"

16.verse: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawaritha sulaymanu dawooda waqala ya ayyuha alnnasu AAullimna mantiqa alttayri waooteena min kulli shayin inna hatha lahuwa alfadlu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Sulayman inherited from Dawud. He said: "O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from everything. This, verily, is an evident grace."

17.verse: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahushira lisulaymana junooduhu mina aljinni waalinsi waalttayri fahum yoozaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there were gathered before Sulayman his hosts of Jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order (marching forward).

18.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha ataw AAala wadi alnnamli qalat namlatun ya ayyuha alnnamlu odkhuloo masakinakum la yahtimannakum sulaymanu wajunooduhu wahum la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: "O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulayman and his armies should crush you, while they perceive not."

19.verse: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatabassama dahikan min qawliha waqala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waadkhilnee birahmatika fee AAibadika alssaliheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So he (Sulayman) smiled, amused at her speech and said: "My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your favors which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants."

20.verse: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watafaqqada alttayra faqala ma liya la ara alhudhuda am kana mina alghaibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He inspected the birds, and said: "What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe Or is he among the absentees"

21.verse: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LaoAAaththibannahu AAathaban shadeedan aw laathbahannahu aw layatiyannee bisultanin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I will surely punish him with a severe torment or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason."

22.verse: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famakatha ghayra baAAeedin faqala ahattu bima lam tuhit bihi wajituka min sabain binabain yaqeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But (the hoopoe) stayed not long, he said: "I have grasped which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba' with true news."

23.verse: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee wajadtu imraatan tamlikuhum waootiyat min kulli shayin walaha AAarshun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I found a woman ruling over them, she has been given all things, and she has a great throne."

24.verse: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajadtuha waqawmaha yasjudoona lilshshamsi min dooni Allahi wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fasaddahum AAani alssabeeli fahum la yahtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah, and Shaytan has made their deeds fair seeming to them to prevent them from the way, so they have no guidance."

25.verse: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alla yasjudoo lillahi allathee yukhriju alkhabaa fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tukhfoona wama tuAAlinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So they do not prostrate themselves before Allah, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

26.verse: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah, La ilaha illa Huwa, the Lord of the Supreme Throne!"

27.verse: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala sananthuru asadaqta am kunta mina alkathibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Sulayman) said: "We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars."

28.verse: اذْهَب بِّكِتَابِي هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ithhab bikitabee hatha faalqih ilayhim thumma tawalla AAanhum faonthur matha yarjiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Go you with this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then draw back from them and see what they return."

29.verse: قَالَتْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ إِنِّي أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao innee olqiya ilayya kitabun kareemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: She said: "O chiefs! Verily, here is delivered to me a noble letter, "

30.verse: إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu min sulaymana wainnahu bismi Allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, it is from Sulayman, and it (reads): `In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful;'

31.verse: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alla taAAloo AAalayya watoonee muslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Be you not exalted against me, but come to me submitting (as Muslims).' "

32.verse: قَالَتْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee amree ma kuntu qatiAAatan amran hatta tashhadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: She said: "O chiefs! Advise me in case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me."

33.verse: قَالُوا نَحْنُ أُولُو قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُو بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo nahnu oloo quwwatin waoloo basin shadeedin waalamru ilayki faonthuree matha tamureena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command; so think over what you will command."

34.verse: قَالَتْ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qalat inna almulooka itha dakhaloo qaryatan afsadooha wajaAAaloo aAAizzata ahliha athillatan wakathalika yafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: She said: "Verily, kings, when they enter a town, they destroy it and make the most honorable among its people the lowest. And thus they do."

35.verse: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanathiratun bima yarjiAAu almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "But verily, I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return."

36.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَا آتَانِيَ اللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا آتَاكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaa sulaymana qala atumiddoonani bimalin fama ataniya Allahu khayrun mimma atakum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, when (the messengers with the gift) came to Sulayman, he said: "Will you help me in wealth What Allah has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift!"

37.verse: ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَا أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: IrjiAA ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunoodin la qibala lahum biha walanukhrijannahum minha athillatan wahum saghiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Go back to them. We verily, shall come to them with armies that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased."

38.verse: قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya ayyuha almalao ayyukum yateenee biAAarshiha qabla an yatoonee muslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience (as Muslims)"

39.verse: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala AAifreetun mina aljinni ana ateeka bihi qabla an taqooma min maqamika wainne AAalayhi laqawiyyun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: An `Ifrit from the Jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. And verily, I am indeed strong and trustworthy for such work."

40.verse: قَالَ الَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala allathee AAindahu AAilmun mina alkitabi ana ateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuka falamma raahu mustaqirran AAindahu qala hatha min fadli rabbee liyabluwanee aashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna rabbee ghaniyyun kareemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture, said: "I will bring it to you within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when he saw it placed before him, he said: "This is by the grace of my Lord -- to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful! And whoever is grateful, truly, his gratitude is for himself; and whoever is ungrateful, certainly my Lord is Rich, Bountiful."

41.verse: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِي أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala nakkiroo laha AAarshaha nanthur atahtadee am takoonu mina allatheena la yahtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will be guided, or she will be one of those not guided."

42.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaat qeela ahakatha AAarshuki qalat kaannahu huwa waooteena alAAilma min qabliha wakunna muslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So when she came, it was said, "Is your throne like this" She said: "As though it were the very same." And he said, "Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we had submitted to Allah (as Muslims)."

43.verse: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasaddaha ma kanat taAAbudu min dooni Allahi innaha kanat min qawmin kafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Saddaha that which she used to worship besides Allah has prevented her (from Islam), for she was of a disbelieving people.

44.verse: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qeela laha odkhulee alssarha falamma raathu hasibathu lujjatan wakashafat AAan saqayha qala innahu sarhun mumarradun min qawareera qalat rabbi innee thalamtu nafsee waaslamtu maAAa sulaymana lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It was said to her: "Enter As-Sarh," but when she saw it, she thought it was a pool, and she (tucked up her clothes) uncovering her legs. Sulayman said: "Verily, it is a Sarh Mumarrad of Qawarir." She said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, and I submit, together with Sulayman to Allah, the Lord of all that exits."

45.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad arsalna ila thamooda akhahum salihan ani oAAbudoo Allaha faitha hum fareeqani yakhtasimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We sent to Thamud their brother Salih, (saying): "Worship Allah." Then look! They became two parties quarreling with each other.

46.verse: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya qawmi lima tastaAAjiloona bialssayyiati qabla alhasanati lawla tastaghfiroona Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "O my people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil before the good Why seek you not the forgiveness of Allah, that you may receive mercy"

47.verse: قَالُوا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ittayyarna bika wabiman maAAaka qala tairukum AAinda Allahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We augur an omen from you and those with you." He said: "Your omen is of Allah; nay, but you are a people that are being tested."

48.verse: وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakana fee almadeenati tisAAatu rahtin yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there were in the city nine Rahtin, who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.

49.verse: قَالُوا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo taqasamoo biAllahi lanubayyitannahu waahlahu thumma lanaqoolanna liwaliyyihi ma shahidna mahlika ahlihi wainna lasadiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Swear one to another by Allah that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his household, and thereafter we will surely say to his near relatives: `We witnessed not the destruction of his household, and verily, we are telling the truth."'

50.verse: وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamakaroo makran wamakarna makran wahum la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, they plotted a plot, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.

51.verse: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu makrihim anna dammarnahum waqawmahum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily, We destroyed them and their nation all together.

52.verse: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوا ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatilka buyootuhum khawiyatan bima thalamoo inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: These are their houses in utter ruin, for they did wrong. Verily, in this is indeed an Ayah for people who know.

53.verse: وَأَنجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We saved those who believed, and had Taqwa of Allah.

54.verse: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walootan ith qala liqawmihi atatoona alfahishata waantum tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) Lut! When he said to his people: "Do you commit immoral sins while you see"

55.verse: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ النِّسَاءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ainnakum latatoona alrrijala shahwatan min dooni alnnisai bal antum qawmun tajhaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Do you practice your lusts on men instead of women Nay, but you are a people who behave senselessly."

56.verse: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا أَخْرِجُوا آلَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo akhrijoo ala lootin min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There was no other answer given by his people except that they said: "Drive out the family of Lut from your city. Verily, these are men who want to be clean and pure!"

57.verse: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanjaynahu waahlahu illa imraatahu qaddarnaha mina alghabireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

58.verse: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We rained down on them a rain. So, evil was the rain of those who were warned.

59.verse: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَىٰ ۗ آللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Quli alhamdu lillahi wasalamun AAala AAibadihi allatheena istafa allahu khayrun amma yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Praise and thanks be to Allah, and peace be on His servants whom He has chosen! Is Allah better, or what they ascribe as partners"

60.verse: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنبِتُوا شَجَرَهَا ۗ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala lakum mina alssamai maan faanbatna bihi hadaiqa thata bahjatin ma kana lakum an tunbitoo shajaraha ailahun maAAa Allahi bal hum qawmun yaAAdiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water from the sky, whereby We cause to grow wonderful gardens full of beauty and delight It is not in your ability to cause the growth of their trees. Is there any god with Allah Nay, but they are a people who ascribe equals!

61.verse: أَمَّن جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman jaAAala alarda qararan wajaAAala khilalaha anharan wajaAAala laha rawasiya wajaAAala bayna albahrayni hajizan ailahun maAAa Allahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not He Who has made the earth as a fixed abode, and has placed rivers in its midst, and has placed firm mountains therein, and has set a barrier between the two seas (of salt and sweet water) Is there any ilah (god) with Allah Nay, but most of them know not!

62.verse: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ الْأَرْضِ ۗ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman yujeebu almudtarra itha daAAahu wayakshifu alssooa wayajAAalukum khulafaa alardi ailahun maAAa Allahi qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not He Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls on Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations Is there any god with Allah Little is that you remember!

63.verse: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ ۗ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ تَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman yahdeekum fee thulumati albarri waalbahri waman yursilu alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi ailahun maAAa Allahi taAAala Allahu AAamma yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not He Who guides you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy Is there any god with Allah Exalted be Allah above all that they associate as partners!

64.verse: أَمَّن يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu waman yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi ailahun maAAa Allahi qul hatoo burhanakum in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not He Who originates creation, and shall thereafter repeat it, and Who provides for you from heaven and earth Is there any god with Allah Say: "Bring forth your proofs, if you are truthful."

65.verse: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul la yaAAlamu man fee alssamawati waalardi alghayba illa Allahu wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "None in the heavens and the earth knows the Unseen except Allah, nor can they perceive when they shall be resurrected."

66.verse: بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bali iddaraka AAilmuhum fee alakhirati bal hum fee shakkin minha bal hum minha AAamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, their knowledge will perceive that in the Hereafter. Nay, they are in doubt about it. Nay, they are in complete blindness about it.

67.verse: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَآبَاؤُنَا أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala allatheena kafaroo aitha kunna turaban waabaona ainna lamukhrajoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who disbelieve say: "When we have become dust -- we and our fathers -- shall we really be brought forth"

68.verse: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad wuAAidna hatha nahnu waabaona min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Indeed we were promised this -- we and our forefathers before, verily, these are nothing but tales of ancients."

69.verse: قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say to them: "Travel in the land and see how has been the end of the criminals."

70.verse: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tahzan AAalayhim wala takun fee dayqin mimma yamkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And grieve you not over them, nor be straitened (in distress) because of what they plot.

71.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "When this promise, if you are truthful"

72.verse: قُلْ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul AAasa an yakoona radifa lakum baAAdu allathee tastaAAjiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Perhaps that which you wish to hasten on, may be close behind you."

73.verse: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your Lord is full of grace for mankind, yet most of them do not give thanks.

74.verse: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna rabbaka layaAAlamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yuAAlinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal.

75.verse: وَمَا مِنْ غَائِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama min ghaibatin fee alssamai waalardi illa fee kitabin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven and the earth but it is in a Clear Book.

76.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَكْثَرَ الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha alqurana yaqussu AAala banee israeela akthara allathee hum feehi yakhtalifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this Qur'an narrates to the Children of Israel most of that in which they differ.

77.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu lahudan warahmatun lilmumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And truly, it is a guide and a mercy for the believers.

78.verse: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum bihukmihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

79.verse: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawakkal AAala Allahi innaka AAala alhaqqi almubeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, put your trust in Allah; surely, you are on manifest truth.

80.verse: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaka la tusmiAAu almawta wala tusmiAAu alssumma aldduAAaa itha wallaw mudbireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear nor can you make the deaf to hear the call, when they flee, turning their backs.

81.verse: وَمَا أَنتَ بِهَادِي الْعُمْيِ عَن ضَلَالَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama anta bihadee alAAumyi AAan dalalatihim in tusmiAAu illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can only make to hear those who believe in Our Ayat, so they submit (became Muslims).

82.verse: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَابَّةً مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha waqaAAa alqawlu AAalayhim akhrajna lahum dabbatan mina alardi tukallimuhum anna alnnasa kanoo biayatina la yooqinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the Word is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast for them, to speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayat.

83.verse: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma nahshuru min kulli ommatin fawjan mimman yukaththibu biayatina fahum yoozaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a Fawj of those who denied Our Ayat, and they shall be driven,

84.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءُوا قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِآيَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha jaoo qala akaththabtum biayatee walam tuheetoo biha AAilman ammatha kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Till, when they come, He will say: "Did you deny My Ayat whereas you comprehended them not by knowledge, or what was it that you used to do"

85.verse: وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WawaqaAAa alqawlu AAalayhim bima thalamoo fahum la yantiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Word will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak.

86.verse: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yaraw anna jaAAalna allayla liyaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and the day sight-giving Verily, in this are Ayat for the people who believe.

87.verse: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fafaziAAa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu wakullun atawhu dakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) the Day on which the Trumpet (Sur) will be blown -- and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allah wills. And all shall come to Him, humbled.

88.verse: وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watara aljibala tahsabuha jamidatan wahiya tamurru marra alssahabi sunAAa Allahi allathee atqana kulla shayin innahu khabeerun bima tafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The work of Allah, Who perfected all things, verily, He is well-acquainted with what you do.

89.verse: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ آمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Man jaa bialhasanati falahu khayrun minha wahum min fazaAAin yawmaithin aminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whoever brings a good deed, will have better than its worth; and they will be safe from the terror on that Day.

90.verse: وَمَن جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman jaa bialssayyiati fakubbat wujoohuhum fee alnnari hal tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whoever brings an evil deed, they will be cast down on their faces in the Fire. (And it will be said to them) "Are you being recompensed anything except what you used to do"

91.verse: إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama omirtu an aAAbuda rabba hathihi albaldati allathee harramaha walahu kullu shayin waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: I have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city, Who has sanctified it and to Whom belongs everything. And I am commanded to be from among the Muslims.

92.verse: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَ الْقُرْآنَ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waan atluwa alqurana famani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla faqul innama ana mina almunthireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that I should recite the Qur'an, then whosoever receives guidance, receives it for the good of himself; and whosoever goes astray, say (to him): "I am only one of the warners."

93.verse: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waquli alhamdu lillahi sayureekum ayatihi fataAArifoonaha wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah. He will show you His Ayat, and you shall recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Taseenmeem

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ta Sin Mim

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: These are the Ayat of the manifest Book.

3.verse: نَتْلُو عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Natloo AAalayka min nabai moosa wafirAAawna bialhaqqi liqawmin yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We recite to you some of the news of Musa and Fir`awn in truth, for a people who believe.

4.verse: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
