Translations.translation: Wala alththulumatu wala alnnooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor are (depths of) darkness and light.

21.verse: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala alththillu wala alharooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor are the shade and the sun's heat.

22.verse: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِي الْقُبُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashao wama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor are the living and the dead. Verily, Allah makes whom He wills to hear, but you cannot make hear those who are in graves.

23.verse: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In anta illa natheerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You are only a warner.

24.verse: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wain min ommatin illa khala feeha natheerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner. And there never was a nation but a warner had passed among them.

25.verse: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wabialzzuburi wabialkitabi almuneeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if they deny you, those before them also denied. Their Messengers came to them with clear signs, and with the Scriptures, and with the Book giving light.

26.verse: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma akhathtu allatheena kafaroo fakayfa kana nakeeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then I took hold of those who disbelieved, and how terrible was My denial!

27.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifan alwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedun wahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebu soodun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not that Allah sends down water from the sky, and We produce therewith fruits of various colors, and among the mountains are Judad, white and red, of varying colors and (others) Gharabib black.

28.verse: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamina alnnasi waalddawabbi waalanAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihi alAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoorun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And likewise, men and moving creature and cattle are of various colors. It is only those among His servants who have knowledge that fear Allah. Verily, Allah is Almighty, Oft-Forgiving.

29.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَّن تَبُورَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena yatloona kitaba Allahi waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan yarjoona tijaratan lan taboora

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who recite the Book of Allah, and perform the Salah, and spend out of what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, they hope for a (sure) trade-gain that will never perish.

30.verse: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoorun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That He may pay them their wages in full, and give them (even) more, out of His grace. Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate.

31.verse: وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee awhayna ilayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha biAAibadihi lakhabeerun baseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what We have revealed to you of the Book, it is the (very) truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Verily, Allah is indeed All-Aware and All-Seer of His servants.

32.verse: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bialkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We gave the Book as inheritance to such of Our servants whom We chose. Then of them are some who wrong themselves, and of them are some who follow a middle course, and of them are some who are, by Allah's leave, foremost in good deeds. That -- that is indeed a great grace.

33.verse: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Adn (Gardens) will they enter, therein will they be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk.

34.verse: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba AAanna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoorun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will say: "All praise and thanks be to Allah, Who has removed from us (all) grief. Verily, our Lord is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate."

35.verse: الَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoobun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Who, out of His grace, has lodged us in a home that will last forever, where toil will touch us not nor weariness will touch us."

36.verse: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But those who disbelieve, for them will be the fire of Hell. Neither will it have a complete killing effect on them so that they die nor shall its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every disbeliever!

37.verse: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahum yastarikhoona feeha rabbana akhrijna naAAmal salihan ghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu awalam nuAAammirkum ma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumu alnnatheeru fathooqoo fama lilththalimeena min naseerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein they will cry: "Our Lord! Bring us out, we shall do righteous good deeds, not that we used to do." (Allah will reply:) "Did We not give you lives long enough, so that whosoever would receive admonition could receive it And the warner came to you. So taste you. For the wrongdoers there is no helper."

38.verse: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna Allaha AAalimu ghaybi alssamawati waalardi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Allah is the All-Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Verily, He is the All-Knower of that is in the breasts.

39.verse: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He it is Who has made you successors generations after generations in the earth, so whosoever disbelieves, on him will be his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers adds nothing but hatred of their Lord. And the disbelief of the disbelievers adds nothing but loss.

40.verse: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum AAala bayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu alththalimoona baAAduhum baAAdan illa ghurooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Have you considered your partners whom you call upon besides Allah Show Me, what they have created of the earth. Or have they any share in the heavens Or have We given them a Book, so that they act on clear proof therefrom Nay, the wrongdoers promise one another nothing but delusions."

41.verse: ۞ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna Allaha yumsiku alssamawati waalarda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kana haleeman ghafooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Allah grasps the heavens and the earth lest they should move away from their places, and if they were to move away from their places, there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Truly, He is Ever Most Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.

42.verse: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِن جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they swore by Allah their most binding oath that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any of the nations; yet when a warner came to them, it increased in them nothing but flight (from the truth).

43.verse: اسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra alssayyii wala yaheequ almakru alssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yanthuroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They took to flight because of their) arrogance in the land and their plotting of evil. But the evil plot encompasses only him who makes it. Then, can they expect anything (else) but the Sunnah (way of dealing) of the peoples of old So, no change will you find in Allah's Sunnah, and no turning off will you find in Allah's Sunnah.

44.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have they not traveled in the land, and seen what was the end of those before them -- though they were superior to them in power Allah is not such that anything in the heavens or in the earth escapes Him. Verily, He is All-Knowing, All-Able.

45.verse: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَابَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if Allah were to punish men for that which they earned, He would not leave a moving creature on the surface of the earth; but He gives them respite to an appointed term, and when their term comes, then verily, Allah is Ever All-Seer of His servants.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaseen

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ya Sin.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqurani alhakeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the Qur'an, full of wisdom,

3.verse: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaka lamina almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, you are one of the Messengers,

4.verse: عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the straight path.

5.verse: تَنزِيلَ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Sent down by the Almighty, the Most Merciful,

6.verse: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا أُنذِرَ آبَاؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In order that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

7.verse: لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed the Word has proved true against most of them, so they will not believe.

8.verse: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ أَغْلَالًا فَهِيَ إِلَى الْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have put on their necks iron collars reaching to the chins, so that their heads are raised up.

9.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا مِن بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَاهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have put a barrier before them, and a barrier behind them, and We have covered them up, so that they cannot see.

10.verse: وَسَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is the same to them whether you warn them or you warn them not, they will not believe.

11.verse: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You can only warn him who follows the Reminder, and fears the Most Gracious unseen. Bear you to such one the glad tidings of forgiveness, and a generous reward.

12.verse: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا وَآثَارَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before (them), and their traces and all things We have recorded with numbers in Imam Mubin (a Clear Book).

13.verse: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَابَ الْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَاءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And put forward to them a similitude; the Dwellers of the Town, when there came Messengers to them.

14.verse: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When We sent to them two Messengers, they denied them both; so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: "Verily, we have been sent to you as Messengers."

15.verse: قَالُوا مَا أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَا أَنزَلَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Most Gracious has revealed nothing. You are only telling lies."

16.verse: قَالُوا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Messengers said: "Our Lord knows that we have been sent as Messengers to you,"

17.verse: وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And our duty is only to convey plainly."

18.verse: قَالُوا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They (people) said: "For us, we see an evil omen from you; if you cease not, we will surely stone you, and a painful torment will touch you from us."

19.verse: قَالُوا طَائِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They (Messengers) said: "Your evil omens be with you! Because you are admonished Nay, but you are a people mischievous."

20.verse: وَجَاءَ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there came a man running from the farthest part of the town. He said, "O my people! Obey the Messengers."

21.verse: اتَّبِعُوا مَن لَّا يَسْأَلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Obey those who ask no wages of you, and who are rightly guided."

22.verse: وَمَا لِيَ لَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And why should I not worship Him Who has created me and to Whom you shall be returned."

23.verse: أَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Shall I take besides Him gods If the Most Gracious intends me any harm, their intercession will be of no use for me whatsoever, nor can they save me."

24.verse: إِنِّي إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then verily, I should be in plain error."

25.verse: إِنِّي آمَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me!"

26.verse: قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It was said: "Enter Paradise." He said: "Would that my people knew."

27.verse: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That my Lord (Allah) has forgiven me, and made me of the honored ones!"

28.verse: ۞ وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِن بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We sent not against his people after him an army from the heaven, nor was it needful for Us to send (such a thing).

29.verse: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It was but one Sayhah and lo! they (all) were still.

30.verse: يَا حَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Alas for mankind! There never came a Messenger to them but they used to mock at him.

31.verse: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them Verily, they will not return to them.

32.verse: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And surely, all -- everyone of them will be brought before Us.

33.verse: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْأَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَاهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a sign for them is the dead land. We give it life, and We bring forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.

34.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّاتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْعُيُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have made therein gardens of date palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.

35.verse: لِيَأْكُلُوا مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof -- and their hands made it not. Will they not then give thanks

36.verse: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Glory be to Him Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own kind, and of that which they know not.

37.verse: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ اللَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a sign for them is the night. We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.

38.verse: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (appointed). That is the decree of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

39.verse: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the moon, We have decreed for it stages, till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.

40.verse: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنبَغِي لَهَا أَن تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.

41.verse: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And an Ayah for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship.

42.verse: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride.

43.verse: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout for them, nor will they be saved.

44.verse: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.

45.verse: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when it is said to them: "Beware of that which is before you, and that which is behind you, in order that you may receive mercy."

46.verse: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ مِّنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And never came an Ayah from among the Ayat of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.

47.verse: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allah has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allah willed, He would have fed You are only in a plain error."

48.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful"

49.verse: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They await only but a single Sayhah which will seize them while they are disputing!

50.verse: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.

51.verse: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Trumpet will be blown and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.

52.verse: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَن بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"

53.verse: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It will be but a single Sayhah, so behold they will all be brought up before Us!

54.verse: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This Day, none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.

55.verse: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.

56.verse: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.

57.verse: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will have therein fruits and all that they ask for.

58.verse: سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said to them): "Salam (Peace!)" -- a Word from the Lord, Most Merciful.

59.verse: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said): "And O you the criminals! Get you apart this Day."

60.verse: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَا بَنِي آدَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطَانَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaytan Verily, he is a plain enemy to you."

61.verse: وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And that you should worship Me. That is the straight path."

62.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And indeed he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not then understand"

63.verse: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is Hell which you were promised!

64.verse: اصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Burn (enter) therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.

65.verse: الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn.

66.verse: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if it had been Our will, We would surely have wiped out their eyes, so that they would struggle for the path, how then would they see

67.verse: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if it had been Our will, We could have transformed them in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.

68.verse: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he whom We grant long life -- We reverse him in creation. Will they not then understand

69.verse: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have not taught him poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur'an.

70.verse: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That he or it may give warning to him who is living, and that Word may be justified against the disbelievers.

71.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have fashioned, the cattle, so that they are their owners.

72.verse: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.

73.verse: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they have (other) benefits from them, and (they get to) drink. Will they not then be grateful

74.verse: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they have taken besides Allah, gods, hoping that they might be helped.

75.verse: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop (against those who worshipped them).

76.verse: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, let not their speech then grieve you. Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

77.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah. Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.

78.verse: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust"

79.verse: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"

80.verse: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.

81.verse: أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, able to create the like of them Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.

82.verse: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, His command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" -- and it is!

83.verse: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So glorified be He and exalted (above all that they associate with Him), and in Whose Hand is the dominion of all things, and to Him you shall be returned.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssaffati saffan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By those ranged in ranks.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalzzajirati zajran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By those who drive the clouds in a good way.

3.verse: فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalttaliyati thikran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By those who bring the Dhikr.

4.verse: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna ilahakum lawahidun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your God is indeed One;

5.verse: رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun's risings.

6.verse: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have adorned the near heaven with the stars.

7.verse: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّارِدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahifthan min kulli shaytanin maridin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to guard against every rebellious Shaytan.

8.verse: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They cannot listen to the higher group for they are pelted from every side.

9.verse: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasibun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Outcast, and theirs is a constant torment.

10.verse: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.

11.verse: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَا ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then ask them: "Are they harder to create, or those whom We have created" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.

12.verse: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal AAajibta wayaskharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, you wondered while they mock.

13.verse: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha thukkiroo la yathkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.

14.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا آيَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha raaw ayatan yastaskhiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they see an Ayah (a sign) from Allah, they mock at it.

15.verse: وَقَالُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!"

16.verse: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we verily be resurrected"

17.verse: أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awaabaona alawwaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And also our fathers of old"

18.verse: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

19.verse: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It will be a single Zajrah, and behold, they will be staring!

20.verse: وَقَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"

21.verse: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said:) "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

22.verse: ۞ احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said to the angels:) Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions and what they used to worship,

23.verse: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Instead of Allah, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);

24.verse: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْئُولُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqifoohum innahum masooloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But stop them, verily, they are to be questioned.

25.verse: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma lakum la tanasaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "What is the matter with you Why do you not help one another"

26.verse: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.

27.verse: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will turn to one another and question one another.

28.verse: قَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side."

29.verse: قَالُوا بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers."

30.verse: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were a transgressing people."

31.verse: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا ۖ إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly taste (the torment)."

32.verse: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaghwaynakum inna kunna ghaweena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."

33.verse: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnahum yawmaithin fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.

34.verse: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Certainly, that is how We deal with the criminals.

35.verse: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, when it was said to them: "La ilaha illallah," they puffed themselves up with pride.

36.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُو آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our gods for the sake of a mad poet"

37.verse: بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal jaa bialhaqqi wasaddaqa almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! he has come with the truth and he confirms the Messengers.

38.verse: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innakum lathaiqoo alAAathabi alaleemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, you are going to taste the painful torment;

39.verse: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do.

40.verse: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Save the chosen servants of Allah.

41.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika lahum rizqun maAAloomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For them there will be a known provision,

42.verse: فَوَاكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawakihu wahum mukramoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Fruits; and they shall be honored,

43.verse: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In the Gardens of Delight,

44.verse: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala sururin mutaqabileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Facing one another on thrones.

45.verse: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yutafu AAalayhim bikasin min maAAeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine

46.verse: بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Baydaa laththatin lilshsharibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: White, delicious to the drinkers.

47.verse: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Neither will they have Ghawl from that nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

48.verse: وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi AAeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And beside them will be Qasirat-At-Tarf with (wide and beautiful) eyes.

49.verse: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaannahunna baydun maknoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: as if they were Bayd Maknun.

50.verse: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.

51.verse: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),"

52.verse: يَقُولُ أَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaqoolu ainnaka lamina almusaddiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Who used to say: `Are you among those who believe.

53.verse: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be indebted (Madinun)"'

54.verse: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala hal antum muttaliAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (The speaker) said: "Will you look down"

55.verse: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَآهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaittalaAAa faraahu fee sawai aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

56.verse: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala taAllahi in kidta laturdeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "By Allah! You have nearly ruined me."

57.verse: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."

58.verse: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afama nahnu bimayyiteena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Are we then not to die (any more)"

59.verse: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Except our first death, and we shall not be punished"

60.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, this is the supreme success!

61.verse: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For the like of this let the workers work.

62.verse: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum

63.verse: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna jaAAalnaha fitnatan lilththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, We have made it (as) a trial for the wrongdoers.

64.verse: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,

65.verse: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TalAAuha kaannahu ruoosu alshshayateeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The shoots of its fruit stalks are like the heads of Shayatin.

66.verse: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

67.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling Hamim.

68.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma inna marjiAAahum laila aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.

69.verse: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا آبَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;

70.verse: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fahum AAala atharihim yuhraAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!

71.verse: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad dalla qablahum aktharu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed most of the earlier ones went astray before them;

72.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We sent among them warners;

73.verse: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then see what was the end of those who were warned.

74.verse: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except the chosen servants of Allah.

75.verse: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad nadana noohun falaniAAma almujeeboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed Nuh invoked Us, and We are the best of those who answer.

76.verse: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress,

77.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna thurriyyatahu humu albaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors.

78.verse: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations

79.verse: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salamun AAala noohin fee alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Salam (peace!) be upon Nuh among the all creatures!"

80.verse: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, thus We reward the gooddoers.

81.verse: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he [Nuh] was one of Our believing servants.

82.verse: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We drowned the others.

83.verse: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لَإِبْرَاهِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna min sheeAAatihi laibraheema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, among those who followed his way was Ibrahim.

84.verse: إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith jaa rabbahu biqalbin saleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When he came to his Lord with a Salim heart.

85.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship"

86.verse: أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aifkan alihatan doona Allahi tureedoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Is it a falsehood -- gods other than Allah -- that you desire"

87.verse: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama thannukum birabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then what think you about the Lord of the all that exists"

88.verse: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fanathara nathratan fee alnnujoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he cast a glance at the stars,

89.verse: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqala innee saqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he said: "Verily, I am sick."

90.verse: فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawallaw AAanhu mudbireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So they turned away from him and departed.

91.verse: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he turned to their gods and said: "Will you not eat"

92.verse: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma lakum la tantiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "What is the matter with you that you speak not"

93.verse: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faragha AAalayhim darban bialyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.

94.verse: فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaqbaloo ilayhi yaziffoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they came hastily towards him.

95.verse: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ataAAbudoona ma tanhitoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve"

96.verse: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu khalaqakum wama taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "While Allah has created you and what you make!"

97.verse: قَالُوا ابْنُوا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Build for him a building and throw him into the blazing fire!"

98.verse: فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alasfaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.

99.verse: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he said: "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi hab lee mina alssaliheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabashsharnahu bighulamin haleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.

102.verse: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you. So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, if Allah wills, you shall find me of the patient."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma aslama watallahu liljabeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, when they had both submitted themselves, and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanadaynahu an ya ibraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We called out to him: "O Ibrahim!"

105.verse: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha lahuwa albalao almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafadaynahu bithibhin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We left for him among the later generations.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salamun AAala ibraheema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Salam (peace!) be upon Ibrahim!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika najzee almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus indeed do We reward the doers of good.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he was one of Our believing servants.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabashsharnahu biishaqa nabiyyan mina alssaliheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishaq -- a Prophet from the righteous.

113.verse: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We blessed him and Ishaq. And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad mananna AAala moosa waharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And, indeed We gave Our grace to Musa and Harun.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanajjaynahuma waqawmahuma mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanasarnahum fakanoo humu alghalibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And helped them, so that they became the victors;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waataynahuma alkitaba almustabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We gave them the clear Scripture;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahadaynahuma alssirata almustaqeema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And guided them to the right path.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watarakna AAalayhima fee alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We left for them among the later generations.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salamun AAala moosa waharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Salam (peace!) be upon Musa and Harun!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahuma min AAibadina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, they were two of Our believing servants.

Translations.author: transliteration
