Translations.translation: Wainna ilyasa lamina almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, Ilyas was one of the Messengers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala liqawmihi ala tattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When he said to his people: "Will you not have Taqwa"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsana alkhaliqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Will you call upon `Ba`l and forsake the Best of creators,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allaha rabbakum warabba abaikumu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakaththaboohu fainnahum lamuhdaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they denied him, so they will certainly be brought forth,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Save the chosen servants of Allah.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We left for him among the later generations.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salamun AAala il yaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Salam (peace!) be upon Ilyasin!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he was one of Our believing servants.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lootan lamina almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, Lut was one of the Messengers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith najjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When We saved him and his family, all,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma dammarna alakhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We destroyed the rest.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, you pass by them in the morning.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabiallayli afala taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And at night; will you not then reflect

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna yoonusa lamina almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, Yunus was one of the Messengers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When he ran to the laden ship:

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Failtaqamahu alhootu wahuwa muleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falawla annahu kana mina almusabbiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Had he not been of them who glorify Allah,

144.verse: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fanabathnahu bialAAarai wahuwa saqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanbatna AAalayhi shajaratan min yaqteenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.

147.verse: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamanoo famattaAAnahum ila heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faistaftihim alirabbika albanatu walahumu albanoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Now ask them: "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them"

150.verse: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ala innahum min ifkihim layaqooloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they say:

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walada Allahu wainnahum lakathiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Allah has begotten." And, verily, they are liars!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Astafa albanati AAala albaneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What is the matter with you How do you decide

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afala tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Will you not then remember

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lakum sultanun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is there for you a plain authority

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatoo bikitabikum in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!

158.verse: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the Jinn, but the Jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him).

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Glorified be Allah! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except the servants of Allah, whom He chooses.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnakum wama taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, verily you and those whom you worship

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma antum AAalayhi bifatineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Cannot lead astray,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man huwa sali aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!

164.verse: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lanahnu alssaffoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lanahnu almusabbihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, we (angels) indeed are those who glorify.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain kanoo layaqooloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed they used to say:

168.verse: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old,"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lakunna AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "We would have indeed been the chosen servants of Allah!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakafaroo bihi fasawfa yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But (now) they disbelieve therein, so they will come to know!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna liAAibadina almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our servants, the Messengers,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum lahumu almansooroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That they verily would be made triumphant,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna jundana lahumu alghaliboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawalla AAanhum hatta heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, turn away from them for a while,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And watch them and they shall see!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they seek to hasten on Our torment

177.verse: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, when it descends in their courtyard, evil will be the morning for those who had warned!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watawalla AAanhum hatta heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, turn away from them for a while,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And watch and they shall see!

180.verse: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Al-`Izzah! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasalamun AAala almursaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Salam (peace!) be on the Messengers!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And all the praises and thanks be to Allah, Lord of all that exists.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Sad. By the Qur'an full of reminding.

2.verse: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.

3.verse: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.

4.verse: وَعَجِبُوا أَن جَاءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This is a sorcerer, a liar."

5.verse: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Has he made the gods into One God. Verily, this is a curious thing!"

6.verse: وَانطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your gods! Verily, this is a thing designed!"

7.verse: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days. This is nothing but an invention!"

8.verse: أَأُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا عَذَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) torment!

9.verse: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the Almighty, the Real Bestower

10.verse: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs If so, let them ascend up with means!

11.verse: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ الْأَحْزَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times.

12.verse: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Before them denied -- the people of Nuh; and `Ad; and Fir`awn the man of stakes,

13.verse: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Dwellers of Al-Aykah; such were the Confederates.

14.verse: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Not one of them but denied the Messengers; therefore My torment was justified.

15.verse: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And these only wait for a single Sayhah there will be no pause or ending thereto.

16.verse: وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittana before the Day of Reckoning!"

17.verse: اصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Be patient of what they say and remember Our slave Dawud, endued with Al-Ayd. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance.

18.verse: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our praises with him in the `Ashi and Ishraq.

19.verse: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (so did) the birds assembled, all obedient to him.

20.verse: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah and sound judgement in speech and decision.

21.verse: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And has the news of the litigants reached you When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrab (private chamber of worship);

22.verse: إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ دَاوُودَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When they entered in upon Dawud, he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of us has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the right way.

23.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech."

24.verse: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Dawud] said: "He has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes. And, verily, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and they are few." And Dawud guessed that We have tried him and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate and turned (to Allah) in repentance.

25.verse: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We forgave him that, and verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good place of return.

26.verse: يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O Dawud! Verily, We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in truth (and justice) and follow not your desire -- for it will mislead you from the path of Allah. Verily, those who wander astray from the path of Allah (shall) have a severe torment, because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.

27.verse: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنَ النَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire!

28.verse: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Shall We treat those who believe and do righteous good deeds as those who cause mischief on the earth Or shall We treat those who have Taqwa as the evildoers

29.verse: كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (This is) a Book which We have sent down to you, full of blessings, that they may ponder over its Verses, and that men of understanding may remember.

30.verse: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to Dawud We gave Sulayman. How excellent a servant! Verily, he was ever turning in repentance (to Us)!

31.verse: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed.

32.verse: فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "I did love the good instead of remembering my Lord," till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night).

33.verse: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he said: "Bring them back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks.

34.verse: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We tried Sulayman and We placed on his throne Jasad (a body), and he returned.

35.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me. Verily, You are the Bestower."

36.verse: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order wherever he willed,

37.verse: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Shayatin, from every kind of builder and diver,

38.verse: وَآخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And also others bound in fetters.

39.verse: هَـٰذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Allah said to Sulayman]: "This is Our gift, so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked of you."

40.verse: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good (final) return.

41.verse: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remember Our servant Ayyub, when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily, Shaytan has afflicted me with distress and torment!"

42.verse: ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot. This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a drink."

43.verse: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for those who understand.

44.verse: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِب بِّهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath." Truly, We found him patient. How excellent a servant! Verily, he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!

45.verse: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq, and Ya`qub, Ulil-Aydi wal-Absar.

46.verse: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We did choose them by granting them the remembrance of the Abode.

47.verse: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best!

48.verse: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remember Isma`il, Al-Yasa`, and Dhul-Kifl, all are among the best.

49.verse: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is a Reminder. And verily, for those who have Taqwa is a good final return.

50.verse: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Adn Paradise, whose doors will be opened for them.

51.verse: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein they will recline; therein they will call for fruits in abundance and drinks;

52.verse: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And beside them will be Qasirat-at-Tarf, (and) of equal ages.

53.verse: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This it is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning!

54.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِن نَّفَادٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said to them)! Verily, this is Our provision which will never finish.

55.verse: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is so! And for the Taghin will be an evil final return.

56.verse: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Hell! Where they will enter it, and worst (indeed) is that place to rest!

57.verse: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is so! Then let them taste it - Hamim and Ghassaq.

58.verse: وَآخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And other of similar kind - all together!

59.verse: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُو النَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is a troop entering with you (in Hell), no welcome for them! Verily, they shall enter in the Fire!

60.verse: قَالُوا بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (The followers will say to those who misled): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you who brought this upon us, so evil is this place to stay in!"

61.verse: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to him a double torment in the Fire!"

62.verse: وَقَالُوا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ الْأَشْرَارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will say: "What is the matter with us that we see not men whom we used to count among the bad ones"

63.verse: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Did we take them as an object of mockery, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them"

64.verse: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, that is the very truth -- the mutual dispute of the people of the Fire!

65.verse: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "I am only a warner and there is no God (worthy of worship) except Allah the One, the Irresistible,"

66.verse: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving."

67.verse: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "That is a great news,"

68.verse: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "From which you turn away!"

69.verse: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I had no knowledge of the chiefs (angels) on high when they were disputing and discussing."

70.verse: إِن يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Only this has been revealed to me, that I am a plain warner."

71.verse: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Truly, I am going to create man from clay."

72.verse: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, when I have fashioned him and breathed into him (his) soul created by Me, then you fall down prostrate to him."

73.verse: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them,

74.verse: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except Iblis, he was proud and was one of the disbelievers.

75.verse: قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud or are you one of the high exalted"

76.verse: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِي مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِن طِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Iblis] said: "I am better than he. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay."

77.verse: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "Then get out from here; for verily, you are outcast."

78.verse: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And verily, My curse is on you till the Day of Recompense."

79.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Iblis] said: "My Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are resurrected."

80.verse: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "Verily, you are of those allowed respite,"

81.verse: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Till the Day of the time appointed."

82.verse: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: [Iblis] said: "By Your might, then I will surely mislead them all,"

83.verse: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Except Your true servants amongst them."

84.verse: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) said: "The truth is -- the truth I say - "

85.verse: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That I will fill Hell with you and those of them (mankind) that follow you, together."

86.verse: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "No wage do I ask of you for this, nor am I one of the Mutakallifin."

87.verse: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "It is only a Reminder for all the creatures."

88.verse: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while."

1.verse: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

2.verse: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have sent down the Book to you in truth. So, worship Allah by doing religious deeds sincerely for Him only.

3.verse: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Surely, the religion is for Allah only. And those who take protectors besides Him (say): "We worship them only that they may bring us near to Allah." Verily, Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Truly, Allah guides not him who is a liar, and a disbeliever.

4.verse: لَّوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ ۖ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Had Allah willed to take a son, He could have chosen whom He willed out of those whom He created. But glory be to Him! He is Allah, the One, the Irresistible.

5.verse: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. He makes the night to go in the day and makes the day to go in the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon. Each running for an appointed term. Verily, He is the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.

6.verse: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّن بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۖ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He created you (all) from a single person; then made from him his wife. And He has sent down for you of An`am eight pairs. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation in three veils of darkness. Such is Allah your Lord. His is the kingdom. La ilaha illa Huwa. How then are you turned away

7.verse: إِن تَكْفُرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If you disbelieve, then verily, Allah is not in need of you; He likes not disbelief for His servants. And if you are grateful, He is pleased therewith for you. No bearer of burdens shall bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you what you used to do. Verily, He is the All-Knower of that which is in breasts.

8.verse: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when some hurt touches man, he cries to his Lord, turning to Him in repentance. But when He bestows a favor upon him from Himself, he forgets that for which he cried for before, and he sets up rivals to Allah, in order to mislead others from His path. Say: "Take pleasure in your disbelief for a while, surely, you are (one) of the dwellers of the Fire!"

9.verse: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْآخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُو رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is one who is obedient to Allah, Ana'a Al-Layl prostrating and standing fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord Say: "Are those who know equal to those who know not" It is only men of understanding who will remember.

10.verse: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "O My servants who believe, have Taqwa of your Lord. Good is for those who do good in this world, and Allah's earth is spacious! Only those who are patient shall receive their reward in full, without reckoning."

11.verse: قُلْ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Verily, I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion sincerely for Him."

12.verse: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And I am commanded (this) in order that I may be the first of the Muslims."

13.verse: قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Verily, if I disobey my Lord, I am afraid of the torment of a great Day."

14.verse: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ دِينِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Quli Allaha aAAbudu mukhlisan lahu deenee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Allah Alone I worship by doing religious deeds sincerely for His sake only."

15.verse: فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So, worship what you like besides Him." Say: "The losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Verily, that will be a manifest loss!"

16.verse: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ ۚ يَا عِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They shall have coverings of Fire, above them and covering (of Fire) beneath them. With this Allah frightens His servants: "O My servants, therefore have Taqwa of Me!"

17.verse: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who avoid At-Taghut by not worshipping them and turn to Allah, for them are glad tidings; so announce the good news to My servants.

18.verse: الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who listen to the Word and follow the best thereof, those are (the ones) whom Allah has guided and those are men of understanding.

19.verse: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي النَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is, then one against whom the Word of punishment is justified (equal to the one who avoids evil) Will you rescue him who is in the Fire

20.verse: لَـٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But those who have Taqwa of their Lord, for them are built lofty rooms, one above another under which rivers flow. (This is) the promise of Allah, and Allah does not fail in (His) promise.

21.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not that Allah sends down water from the sky, and causes it to penetrate the earth, as water springs, and afterward thereby produces crops of different colors, and afterward they wither and you see them turn yellow; then He makes them dry and broken pieces. Verily, in this is a reminder for men of understanding.

22.verse: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is he whose breast Allah has opened to Islam, so that he is in light from his Lord So, woe to those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah! They are in plain error!

23.verse: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah has sent down the Best Statement, a Book, its parts resembling each other, (and) oft-repeated. The skins of those who fear their Lord shiver from it. Then their skin and their heart soften to the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah. He guides therewith whom He wills; and whomever Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide.

24.verse: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوا مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is he then, who will confront with his face the awful torment on the Day of Resurrection And it will be said to the wrongdoers: "Taste what you used to earn!"

25.verse: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those before them denied, and so the torment came on them from directions they perceived not.

26.verse: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, Allah made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew!

27.verse: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We have put forth for men, in this Qur'an every kind of parable in order that they may remember.

28.verse: قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: An Arabic Qur'an, without any crookedness (therein) in order that they may have Taqwa of Him.

29.verse: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah puts forth a parable: a man belonging to many partners disputing with one another, and a man belonging entirely to one master. Are those two equal in comparison All the praises and thanks be to Allah! But most of them know not.

30.verse: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, you will die, and verily, they (too) will die.

31.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be disputing before your Lord.

32.verse: ۞ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, who does more wrong than one who utters a lie against Allah, and denies the truth when it comes to him! Is there not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers

33.verse: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ ۙ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he who has brought the truth and (those who) believed therein, they are those who have Taqwa.

34.verse: لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They shall have all that they will desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good.

35.verse: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So that Allah may expiate from them the evil of what they did and give them the reward, according to the best of what they used to do.

36.verse: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not Allah Sufficient for His servant Yet they try to frighten you with those besides Him! And whom Allah sends astray, for him there will be no guide.

37.verse: وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انتِقَامٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whomsoever Allah guides, for him there will be no misleader. Is not Allah Almighty, Possessor of Retribution

38.verse: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, if you ask them: "Who created the heavens and the earth" Surely, they will say: "Allah." Say: "Tell me then, the things that you invoke besides Allah -- if Allah intended some harm for me, could they remove His harm Or if He intended some mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy" Say: "Sufficient for me is Allah; in Him those who trust must put their trust."

39.verse: قُلْ يَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "O My people! Work according to your way, I am working. Then you will come to know"

40.verse: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "To whom comes a disgracing torment, and on whom descends an everlasting torment."

41.verse: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have sent down to you the Book for mankind in truth. So, whosoever accepts the guidance, it is only for himself; and whosoever goes astray, he goes astray only to his (own) loss. And you are not a trustee over them.

42.verse: اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرَىٰ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha waallatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada AAalayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is Allah Who takes away the souls at the time of their death, and those that die not during their sleep. He keeps those (souls) for which He has ordained death and sends the rest for a term appointed. Verily, in this are signs for a people who think deeply.

43.verse: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufaAAaa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala yaAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have they taken as intercessors besides Allah Say: "Even if they have power over nothing whatever and have no intelligence"

44.verse: قُل لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul lillahi alshshafaAAatu jameeAAan lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "To Allah belongs all intercession. His is the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you shall be brought back."

45.verse: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha thukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waitha thukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when Allah Alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are filled with disgust and when those besides Him are mentioned, behold, they rejoice!

46.verse: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Quli allahumma fatira alssamawati waalardi AAalima alghaybi waalshshahadati anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! You will judge between your servants about that wherein they used to differ."

47.verse: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِن سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَحْتَسِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw anna lillatheena thalamoo ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi min sooi alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati wabada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakoonoo yahtasiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who did wrong, if they had all that is on the earth and therewith as much again, they verily, would offer it to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the evil torment; and there will become apparent to them from Allah what they had not been reckoning.

48.verse: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the evils of that which they earned will become apparent to them, and that which they used to mock at will encircle them.

49.verse: فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ ۚ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha massa alinsana durrun daAAana thumma itha khawwalnahu niAAmatan minna qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin bal hiya fitnatun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When harm touches man, he calls to Us (for help); then when We have changed it into a favor from Us, he says: "Only because of knowledge I obtained it." Nay, it is only a trial, but most of them know not!

50.verse: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad qalaha allatheena min qablihim fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not.

51.verse: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا ۚ وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo waallatheena thalamoo min haolai sayuseebuhum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wama hum bimuAAjizeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, the evil results of that which they earned overtook them. And those who did wrong of these will also be overtaken by the evil results for that which they earned; and they will never be able to escape.

52.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not know that Allah expands the provision for whom He wills, and straitens it. Verily, in this are signs for the folk who believe!

53.verse: ۞ قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ya AAibadiya allatheena asrafoo AAala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru alththunooba jameeAAan innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, verily, Allah forgives all sins. Truly, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

54.verse: وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaneeboo ila rabbikum waaslimoo lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu thumma la tunsaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And turn in repentance (and in obedience with true faith) to your Lord and submit to Him before the torment comes upon you, (and) then you will not be helped."

55.verse: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaittabiAAoo ahsana ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu baghtatan waantum la tashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And follow the best of that which is sent down to you from your Lord, before the torment comes on you suddenly while you perceive not!"

56.verse: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَا حَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنبِ اللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An taqoola nafsun ya hasrata AAala ma farrattu fee janbi Allahi wain kuntu lamina alssakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Lest a person should say: "Alas, my grief that I was undutiful to Allah, and I was indeed among those who mocked."

57.verse: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw taqoola law anna Allaha hadanee lakuntu mina almuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or (lest) he should say: "If only Allah had guided me, I should indeed have been among those who have Taqwa."

58.verse: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw taqoola heena tara alAAathaba law anna lee karratan faakoona mina almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or (lest) he should say when he sees the torment: "If only I had another chance, then I should indeed be among the doers of good."

59.verse: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ آيَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bala qad jaatka ayatee fakaththabta biha waistakbarta wakunta mina alkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Yes! Verily, there came to you My Ayat and you denied them, and were proud and were among the disbelievers.

60.verse: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayawma alqiyamati tara allatheena kathaboo AAala Allahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied against Allah - their faces will be black. Is there not in Hell an abode for the arrogant

61.verse: وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
