50.verse: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِن بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَـٰذَا لِي وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي إِنَّ لِي عِندَهُ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walain athaqnahu rahmatan minna min baAAdi darraa massathu layaqoolanna hatha lee wama athunnu alssaAAata qaimatan walain rujiAAtu ila rabbee inna lee AAindahu lalhusna falanunabbianna allatheena kafaroo bima AAamiloo walanutheeqannahum min AAathabin ghaleethin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And truly, if We give him a taste of mercy from Us, after some adversity has touched him, he is sure to say: "This is due to my (merit); I think not that the Hour will be established. But if I am brought back to my Lord, surely there will be for me the best with Him. "Then, We verily will show to the disbelievers what they have done, and We shall make them taste a severe torment.

51.verse: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَأَىٰ بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha anAAamna AAala alinsani aAArada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu alshsharru fathoo duAAain AAareedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when We show favor to man, he turns away and becomes arrogant; but when evil touches him, then he has recourse to long supplications.

52.verse: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi thumma kafartum bihi man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaqin baAAeedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Tell me, if it is from Allah, and you disbelieve in it Who is more astray than one who is in opposition far away."

53.verse: سَنُرِيهِمْ آيَاتِنَا فِي الْآفَاقِ وَفِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sanureehim ayatina fee alafaqi wafee anfusihim hatta yatabayyana lahum annahu alhaqqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We will show them Our signs in the universes, and within themselves, until it becomes manifest to them that this is the truth. Is it not sufficient in regard to your Lord that He is a Witness over all things

54.verse: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُّحِيطٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ala innahum fee miryatin min liqai rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shayin muheetun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Lo, Verily, they are in doubt concerning the meeting with their Lord. Verily, He is surrounding all things!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hameem

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ha Mim.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAaynseenqaf

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Ain Sin Qaf.

3.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika yoohee ilayka waila allatheena min qablika Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Likewise Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise sends revelation to you as to those before you.

4.verse: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAaliyyu alAAatheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.

5.verse: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna waalmalaikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fee alardi ala inna Allaha huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nearly the heavens might be rent asunder from above them, and the angels glorify the praises of their Lord, and ask for forgiveness for those on the earth. Lo, Verily, Allah is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

6.verse: وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa Allahu hafeethun AAalayhim wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And as for those who take as protecting friends others besides Him -- Allah is Hafiz over them, and you are not a trustee over them.

7.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka quranan AAarabiyyan litunthira omma alqura waman hawlaha watunthira yawma aljamAAi la rayba feehi fareequn fee aljannati wafareequn fee alssaAAeeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And thus We have revealed to you a Qur'an in Arabic that you may warn the Mother of the Towns and all around it, and warn (them) of the Day of Assembling of which there is no doubt, a party will be in Paradise and a party in the blazing Fire.

8.verse: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalahum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimoona ma lahum min waliyyin wala naseerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if Allah had willed, He could have made them one nation, but He admits whom He wills to His mercy. And the wrongdoers will have neither a protector nor a helper.

9.verse: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۖ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa faAllahu huwa alwaliyyu wahuwa yuhyee almawta wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they taken protecting friends besides Him But Allah --- He Alone is the protector. And He Who gives life to the dead, and He is Able to do all things.

10.verse: وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama ikhtalaftum feehi min shayin fahukmuhu ila Allahi thalikumu Allahu rabbee AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi oneebu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in whatsoever you differ, the decision thereof is with Allah. Such is Allah, my Lord in Whom I put my trust, and to Him I turn in repentance.

11.verse: فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatiru alssamawati waalardi jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wamina alanAAami azwajan yathraokum feehi laysa kamithlihi shayon wahuwa alssameeAAu albaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you mates from yourselves, and for the cattle (also) mates. By this means He creates you. There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.

12.verse: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges provision for whom He wills, and straitens. Verily, He is the All-Knower of everything.

13.verse: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: SharaAAa lakum mina alddeeni ma wassa bihi noohan waallathee awhayna ilayka wama wassayna bihi ibraheema wamoosa waAAeesa an aqeemoo alddeena wala tatafarraqoo feehi kabura AAala almushrikeena ma tadAAoohum ilayhi Allahu yajtabee ilayhi man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man yuneebu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He (Allah) has ordained for you the same religion which He ordained for Nuh, and that which We have revealed to you, and that which We ordained for Ibrahim, Musa and `Isa saying you should establish religion and make no divisions in it. Intolerable for the idolators is that to which you call them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills, and guides unto Himself who turns to Him in repentance.

14.verse: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tafarraqoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ila ajalin musamman laqudiya baynahum wainna allatheena oorithoo alkitaba min baAAdihim lafee shakkin minhu mureebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they divided not till after knowledge had come to them, through transgression between themselves. And had it not been for a Word that went forth before from your Lord for an appointed term, the matter would have been settled between them. And verily, those who were made to inherit the Scripture after them, are in grave doubt concerning it.

15.verse: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَادْعُ ۖ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ آمَنتُ بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِن كِتَابٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falithalika faodAAu waistaqim kama omirta wala tattabiAA ahwaahum waqul amantu bima anzala Allahu min kitabin waomirtu liaAAdila baynakum Allahu rabbuna warabbukum lana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum la hujjata baynana wabaynakumu Allahu yajmaAAu baynana wailayhi almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So unto this then invite (people), and stand firm as you are commanded, and follow not their desires but say: "I believe in whatsoever Allah has sent down of the Book and I am commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us our deeds and for you your deeds. There is no dispute between us and you. Allah will assemble us (all), and to Him is the final return."

16.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yuhajjoona fee Allahi min baAAdi ma istujeeba lahu hujjatuhum dahidatun AAinda rabbihim waAAalayhim ghadabun walahum AAathabun shadeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who dispute concerning Allah, after it has been accepted, of no use is their dispute before their Lord and on them is wrath, and for them will be a severe torment.

17.verse: اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu allathee anzala alkitaba bialhaqqi waalmeezani wama yudreeka laAAalla alssaAAata qareebun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is Allah Who has sent down the Book in truth, and the Balance. And what can make you know that perhaps the Hour is close at hand

18.verse: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YastaAAjilu biha allatheena la yuminoona biha waallatheena amanoo mushfiqoona minha wayaAAlamoona annaha alhaqqu ala inna allatheena yumaroona fee alssaAAati lafee dalalin baAAeedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who believe not therein seek to hasten it, while those who believe are fearful of it, and know that it is the very truth. Verily, those who dispute concerning the Hour are certainly in error far away.

19.verse: اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu lateefun biAAibadihi yarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu alAAazeezu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His servants. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the Almighty.

20.verse: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْآخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Man kana yureedu hartha alakhirati nazid lahu fee harthihi waman kana yureedu hartha alddunya nutihi minha wama lahu fee alakhirati min naseebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whosoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We give him increase in his reward, and whosoever desires the reward of this world, We give him thereof, and he has no portion in the Hereafter.

21.verse: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوا لَهُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَن بِهِ اللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lahum shurakao sharaAAoo lahum mina alddeeni ma lam yathan bihi Allahu walawla kalimatu alfasli laqudiya baynahum wainna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they partners with Allah who have instituted for them a religion which Allah has not ordained And had it not been for a decisive Word, the matter would have been judged between them. And verily, for the wrongdoers there is a painful torment.

22.verse: تَرَى الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tara alththalimeena mushfiqeena mimma kasaboo wahuwa waqiAAun bihim waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fee rawdati aljannati lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of that which they have earned, and it will surely befall them. But those who believe and do righteous deeds (will be) in the flowering meadows of the Gardens. They shall have whatsoever they desire with their Lord. That is the supreme grace.

23.verse: ذَٰلِكَ الَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ ۗ قُل لَّا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thalika allathee yubashshiru Allahu AAibadahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati qul la asalukum AAalayhi ajran illa almawaddata fee alqurba waman yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feeha husnan inna Allaha ghafoorun shakoorun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That is whereof Allah gives glad tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous good deeds. Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this except to be kind to me for my kinship with you." And whoever earns a good righteous deed, We shall give him an increase of good in respect thereof. Verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate.

24.verse: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yaqooloona iftara AAala Allahi kathiban fain yashai Allahu yakhtim AAala qalbika wayamhu Allahu albatila wayuhiqqu alhaqqa bikalimatihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or say they: "He has invented a lie against Allah" If Allah willed, He could have sealed up your heart. And Allah wipes out falsehood, and establishes the truth by His Word. Verily, He knows well what are in the breasts.

25.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee yaqbalu alttawbata AAan AAibadihi wayaAAfoo AAani alssayyiati wayaAAlamu ma tafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants, and forgives sins, and He knows what you do.

26.verse: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ وَالْكَافِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayastajeebu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wayazeeduhum min fadlihi waalkafiroona lahum AAathabun shadeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He answers those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and gives them increase of His bounty. And as for the disbelievers, theirs will be a severe torment.

27.verse: ۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw basata Allahu alrrizqa liAAibadihi labaghaw fee alardi walakin yunazzilu biqadarin ma yashao innahu biAAibadihi khabeerun baseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if Allah were to extend the provision for His servants, they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sends down by measure as He wills. Verily, He is, in respect of His servants, the Well-Aware, the All-Seer.

28.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ ۚ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee yunazzilu alghaytha min baAAdi ma qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatahu wahuwa alwaliyyu alhameedu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He it is Who sends down the rain after they have despaired, and spreads His mercy. And He is the Wali, Worthy of all praise.

29.verse: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin ayatihi khalqu alssamawati waalardi wama baththa feehima min dabbatin wahuwa AAala jamAAihim itha yashao qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And among His Ayat is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and whatever moving creatures He has dispersed in them both. And He is Able to assemble them whenever He wills.

30.verse: وَمَا أَصَابَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُو عَن كَثِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama asabakum min museebatin fabima kasabat aydeekum wayaAAfoo AAan katheerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whatever of misfortune befalls you, it is because of what your hands have earned. And He pardons much.

31.verse: وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama antum bimuAAjizeena fee alardi wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you cannot escape from Allah in the earth, and besides Allah you have neither any protector nor any helper.

32.verse: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin ayatihi aljawari fee albahri kaalaAAlami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And among His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains.

33.verse: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In yasha yuskini alrreeha fayathlalna rawakida AAala thahrihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If He wills, He causes the wind to cease, then they would become motionless on the surface (of the sea). Verily, in this are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

34.verse: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yoobiqhunna bima kasaboo wayaAAfu AAan katheerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or He may destroy them because of that which their (people) have earned. And He pardons much.

35.verse: وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayaAAlama allatheena yujadiloona fee ayatina ma lahum min maheesin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who dispute as regards Our Ayat may know that there is no place of refuge for them.

36.verse: فَمَا أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama ooteetum min shayin famataAAu alhayati alddunya wama AAinda Allahi khayrun waabqa lillatheena amanoo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So whatever you have been given is but (a passing) enjoyment for this worldly life, but that which is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord.

37.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha waitha ma ghadiboo hum yaghfiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who shun the greater sins, and Al-Fawahish, and when they are angry, they forgive.

38.verse: وَالَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena istajaboo lirabbihim waaqamoo alssalata waamruhum shoora baynahum wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who answer the Call of their Lord, and perform the Salah, and who (conduct) their affairs by mutual consultation, and who spend of what We have bestowed on them.

39.verse: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena itha asabahumu albaghyu hum yantasiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who, when an oppressive wrong is done to them, take revenge.

40.verse: وَجَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajazao sayyiatin sayyiatun mithluha faman AAafa waaslaha faajruhu AAala Allahi innahu la yuhibbu alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The recompense for an evil is an evil like thereof; but whoever forgives and makes reconciliation, his reward is with Allah. Verily, He likes not the wrongdoers.

41.verse: وَلَمَنِ انتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walamani intasara baAAda thulmihi faolaika ma AAalayhim min sabeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed whosoever takes revenge after he has suffered wrong, for such there is no way (of blame) against them.

42.verse: إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama alssabeelu AAala allatheena yathlimoona alnnasa wayabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi olaika lahum AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The way is only against those who oppress men and rebel in the earth without justification; for such there will be a painful torment.

43.verse: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaman sabara waghafara inna thalika lamin AAazmi alomoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, whosoever shows patience and forgives, that would truly be from the things recommended by Allah.

44.verse: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن وَلِيٍّ مِّن بَعْدِهِ ۗ وَتَرَى الظَّالِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min waliyyin min baAAdihi watara alththalimeena lamma raawoo alAAathaba yaqooloona hal ila maraddin min sabeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whomsoever Allah sends astray, for him there is no protector after Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they behold the torment, they will say: "Is there any way of return"

45.verse: وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watarahum yuAAradoona AAalayha khashiAAeena mina alththulli yanthuroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqala allatheena amanoo inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala inna alththalimeena fee AAathabin muqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you will see them brought forward to it (Hell) made humble by disgrace, (and) looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say: "Verily, the losers are they who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection." Verily, the wrongdoers will be in a lasting torment.

46.verse: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن سَبِيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama kana lahum min awliyaa yansuroonahum min dooni Allahi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min sabeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will have no protectors to help them other than Allah. And he whom Allah sends astray, for him there is no way.

47.verse: اسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljain yawmaithin wama lakum min nakeerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Answer the Call of your Lord before there comes from Allah a Day which cannot be averted. You will have no refuge on that Day nor there will be for you any denying.

48.verse: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ ۗ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ كَفُورٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fain aAAradoo fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan in AAalayka illa albalaghu wainna itha athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan fariha biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fainna alinsana kafoorun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But if they turn away, We have not sent you as a Hafiz over them. Your duty is to convey. And verily, when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us, he rejoices there at; but when some evil befalls them because of the deeds which their hands have sent forth, then verily, man (becomes) ingrate!

49.verse: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yakhluqu ma yashao yahabu liman yashao inathan wayahabu liman yashao alththukoora

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He bestows female upon whom He wills, and bestows male upon whom He wills.

50.verse: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yuzawwijuhum thukranan wainathan wayajAAalu man yashao AAaqeeman innahu AAaleemun qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or He bestows both males and females, and He renders barren whom He wills. Verily, He is the All-Knower and is Able (to do all things).

51.verse: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama kana libasharin an yukallimahu Allahu illa wahyan aw min warai hijabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya biithnihi ma yashao innahu AAaliyyun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation, or from behind a veil, or (that) He sends a Messenger to reveal what He wills by His leave. Verily, He is Most High, Most Wise.

52.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْإِيمَانُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِي بِهِ مَن نَّشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin jaAAalnahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min AAibadina wainnaka latahdee ila siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And thus We have sent to you Ruh of Our command. You knew not what is the Book, nor what is Faith. But We have made it a light wherewith We guide whosoever of Our servants We will. And verily, you are indeed guiding to a straight path.

53.verse: صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sirati Allahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ala ila Allahi taseeru alomooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The path of Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth. Verily, all matters at the end go to Allah.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hameem

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ha Mim.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalkitabi almubeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the manifest Book.

3.verse: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna jaAAalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic that you may be able to understand.

4.verse: وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book with Us, indeed exalted, full of wisdom.

5.verse: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Shall We then take away the Reminder from you, because you are a people excessive.

6.verse: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And how many a Prophet have We sent amongst the men of old.

7.verse: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And never came there a Prophet to them but they used to mock at him.

8.verse: فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We destroyed men stronger (in power) than these and the example of the ancients has passed away.

9.verse: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed if you ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them."

10.verse: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way.

11.verse: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Who sends down water from the sky in due measure, then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth.

12.verse: وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride,

13.verse: لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In order that you may mount on their backs, and then may remember the favor of your Lord when you mount thereon, and say: "Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could have never had it."

14.verse: وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, to Our Lord we indeed are to return!"

15.verse: وَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Yet, they assign to some of His servants a share with Him. Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate!

16.verse: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُم بِالْبَنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons

17.verse: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if one of them is informed of the news of that which he sets forth as a parable to the Most Gracious, his face becomes dark, and he is filled with grief!

18.verse: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّأُ فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A creature who is brought up in adornments, and who in dispute cannot make itself clear

19.verse: وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَاثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْأَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they make females the angels who themselves are servants of the Most Gracious. Did they witness their creation Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned!

20.verse: وَقَالُوا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they said: "If it had been the will of the Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped them." They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do nothing but lie!

21.verse: أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِّن قَبْلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have We given them any Book before this (the Qur'an) to which they are holding fast

22.verse: بَلْ قَالُوا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! They say: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps."

23.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And similarly, We sent not a warner before you to any town (people) but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps."

24.verse: ۞ قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."

25.verse: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So We took revenge on them, then see what was the end of those who denied.

26.verse: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) when Ibrahim said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship,"

27.verse: إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Except Him Who created me; and verily, He will guide me."

28.verse: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he made it a word lasting among his offspring, that they may turn back.

29.verse: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but I gave to these and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth, and a Messenger making things clear.

30.verse: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the truth came to them, they said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein."

31.verse: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some great man of the two towns"

32.verse: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it they who would portion out the mercy of your Lord It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the mercy of your Lord is better than what they amass.

33.verse: وَلَوْلَا أَن يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And were it not that mankind would have become of one community, We would have provided for those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses, and elevators whereby they ascend,

34.verse: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And for their houses, doors, and thrones on which they could recline,

35.verse: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَالْآخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And adornments of gold. Yet all this would have been nothing but an enjoyment of this world. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for those who have Taqwa.

36.verse: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whosoever Ya`shu (turns away blindly) from the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We appoint for him Shaytan to be a Qarin (a companion) to him.

37.verse: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, they hinder them from the path, but they think that they are guided aright!

38.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says, "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west) a worst companion (indeed)!"

39.verse: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It will profit you not this Day as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers in the punishment.

40.verse: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Can you make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error

41.verse: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And even if We take you away, We shall indeed take vengeance on them.

42.verse: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or (if) We show you that wherewith We threaten them, then verily, We have perfect command over them.

43.verse: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So hold you fast to that which is revealed to you. Verily, you are on the straight path.

44.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْأَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, this is indeed a Dhikr for you and your people, and you will be questioned.

45.verse: وَاسْأَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And ask whom We sent before you of Our Messengers: "Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped besides the Most Gracious"

46.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We did send Musa with Our Ayat to Fir`awn and his chiefs. He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of all that exists."

47.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِآيَاتِنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when he came to them with Our Ayat, behold, they laughed at them.

48.verse: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And not an Ayah We showed them but it was greater than its fellow preceding it, and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn.

49.verse: وَقَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they said (to Musa): "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to what He has made a pact with you. Verily, We shall guide ourselves."

50.verse: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when We removed the torment from them, behold, they broke their covenant.

51.verse: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِي ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Fir`awn proclaimed among his people (saying): "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then"

52.verse: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Am I not better than this one (Musa) who is despicable and can scarcely express himself clearly"

53.verse: فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him"

54.verse: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were ever a people who were rebellious.

55.verse: فَلَمَّا آسَفُونَا انتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So when they angered Us, We punished them, and drowned them all.

56.verse: فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We made them a precedent, and an example to later generations.

57.verse: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the son of Maryam is quoted as an example, behold, your people cry aloud thereat.

58.verse: وَقَالُوا أَآلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And say: "Are our gods better or is he" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people.

59.verse: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He was not more than a servant. We granted Our favor to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

60.verse: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if it were Our will, We would have made angels to replace you on the earth.

61.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour. Therefore have no doubt concerning it. And follow Me! This is the straight path.

62.verse: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And let not Shaytan hinder you. Verily, he (Shaytan) to you is a plain enemy.

63.verse: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when `Isa came with clear proofs, he said: "I have come to you with Al-Hikmah, and in order to make clear to you some of that in which you differ. Therefore have Taqwa of Allah and obey me."

64.verse: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, Allah! He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is the straight path."

65.verse: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong from the torment of a painful Day!

66.verse: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly while they perceive not

67.verse: الْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except those who have Taqwa.

68.verse: يَا عِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: My servants! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,

69.verse: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَكَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (You) who believed in Our Ayat and were Muslims.

70.verse: ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.

71.verse: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that their souls desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever.

72.verse: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is the Paradise, which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds that you used to do.

73.verse: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire).

74.verse: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the criminals will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever.

75.verse: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein.

76.verse: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We wronged them not, but they were the wrongdoers.

77.verse: وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّاكِثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will cry: "O Malik (keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily, you shall abide forever."

78.verse: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed We have brought the truth to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth.

79.verse: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they plotted some plan Then We too are planning.

80.verse: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel Yes (We do) and Our messengers are by them, to record.

81.verse: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "If the Most Gracious had a son, then I am the first of the worshippers."

82.verse: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him).

83.verse: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised.

84.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is He Who is the only God in the heaven and the only God on the earth. And He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower.

85.verse: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned.

86.verse: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession -- except for those who bear witness to the truth knowingly, and they know.

87.verse: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: "Allah." How then are they turned away

88.verse: وَقِيلِهِ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And his saying: "O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!"

89.verse: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So turn away from them, and say: Salam (peace!) But they will come to know.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hameem

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ha Mim.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalkitabi almubeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the manifest Book that makes things clear.

3.verse: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We sent it down on a blessed night. Verily, We are ever warning.

4.verse: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein (that night) is decreed every matter, Hakim.

5.verse: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As a command from Us. Verily, We are ever sending,

6.verse: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (As) a mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

7.verse: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty.

8.verse: لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: La ilaha illa Huwa. He gives life and causes death -- your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

9.verse: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! They play about in doubt.

10.verse: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,

11.verse: يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Covering mankind, this is a painful torment.

12.verse: رَّبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"

13.verse: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: How can there be for them an admonition, when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.

14.verse: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they had turned away from him and said: "(He is) one taught, a madman!"

15.verse: إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily, you will revert.

16.verse: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day when We shall strike you with the great Batshah. Verily, We will exact retribution.

17.verse: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We tried before them Fir`awn's people, when there came to them a noble Messenger.

18.verse: أَنْ أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Saying: "Deliver to me the servants of Allah. Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust."

19.verse: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي آتِيكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And exalt not yourselves against Allah. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority."

20.verse: وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me."

21.verse: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."

22.verse: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So he (Musa) called upon his Lord (saying): "These are indeed the people who are criminals."

23.verse: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah said): "Depart you with My servants by night. Surely, you will be pursued."

24.verse: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned."

25.verse: كَمْ تَرَكُوا مِن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: How many of gardens and springs that they (Fir`awn's people) left behind,

26.verse: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And green crops (fields) and goodly places,

27.verse: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!

28.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them.

29.verse: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنظَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the heavens and the earth wept not for them, nor were they given respite.

30.verse: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment,

31.verse: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: From Fir`awn; verily, he was arrogant and was of the excessive.

32.verse: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We chose them above the nations (Al-`Alamin) with knowledge,

33.verse: وَآتَيْنَاهُم مِّنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَاءٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial.

34.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna haolai layaqooloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, these people are saying:

35.verse: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
