18.verse: ۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad radiya Allahu AAani almumineena ith yubayiAAoonaka tahta alshshajarati faAAalima ma fee quloobihim faanzala alsakeenata AAalayhim waathabahum fathan qareeban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed, Allah was pleased with the believers when they gave the pledge to you under the tree, He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down As-Sakinah upon them, and He rewarded them with a near victory.

19.verse: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamaghanima katheeratan yakhuthoonaha wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And abundant spoils that they will capture. And Allah is Ever All-Mighty, All-Wise.

20.verse: وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ آيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAadakumu Allahu maghanima katheeratan takhuthoonaha faAAajjala lakum hathihi wakaffa aydiya alnnasi AAankum walitakoona ayatan lilmumineena wayahdiyakum siratan mustaqeeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah has promised you abundant spoils that you will capture, and He has hastened for you this, and He has restrained the hands of men from you, that it may be a sign for the believers, and that He may guide you to the straight path.

21.verse: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waokhra lam taqdiroo AAalayha qad ahata Allahu biha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And other (victories) which are not yet within your power; indeed Allah encompasses them. And Allah is Ever Able to do all things.

22.verse: وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw qatalakumu allatheena kafaroo lawallawoo aladbara thumma la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if those who disbelieve fight against you, they certainly would have turned their backs; then they would have found neither a protector nor a helper.

23.verse: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That has been the way of Allah already with those who passed away before. And you will not find any change in the way of Allah.

24.verse: وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa allathee kaffa aydiyahum AAankum waaydiyakum AAanhum bibatni makkata min baAAdi an athfarakum AAalayhim wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He it is Who has withheld their hands from you and your hands from them in the midst of Makkah, after He had made you victors over them. And Allah sees what you do.

25.verse: هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُّؤْمِنَاتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Humu allatheena kafaroo wasaddookum AAani almasjidi alharami waalhadya maAAkoofan an yablugha mahillahu walawla rijalun muminoona wanisaon muminatun lam taAAlamoohum an tataoohum fatuseebakum minhum maAAarratun bighayri AAilmin liyudkhila Allahu fee rahmatihi man yashao law tazayyaloo laAAaththabna allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathaban aleeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They are those who disbelieved and hindered you from Al-Masjid Al-Haram and detained the sacrificial animals, from reaching their place of sacrifice. Had there not been believing men and believing women whom you did not know, that you may kill and on whose account a sin would have been committed by you without (your) knowledge, that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He wills -- if they had been apart, We verily, would have punished with painful torment those of them who disbelieved.

26.verse: إِذْ جَعَلَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوا أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith jaAAala allatheena kafaroo fee quloobihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almumineena waalzamahum kalimata alttaqwa wakanoo ahaqqa biha waahlaha wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When those who disbelieve had put in their hearts pride and haughtiness -- the pride and haughtiness of the time of ignorance, -- then Allah sent down His calmness and tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and made them stick to the word of Taqwa; and they were well entitled to it and worthy of it. And Allah is the All-Knower of everything.

27.verse: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ آمِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad sadaqa Allahu rasoolahu alrruya bialhaqqi latadkhulunna almasjida alharama in shaa Allahu amineena muhalliqeena ruoosakum wamuqassireena la takhafoona faAAalima ma lam taAAlamoo fajaAAala min dooni thalika fathan qareeban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed Allah shall fulfill the true vision which He showed to His Messenger in very truth. Certainly, you shall enter Al-Masjid Al-Haram, if Allah wills, secure, (some) having your heads shaved, and (some) having your hair cut short, having no fear. He knew what you knew not, and He granted besides that a near victory.

28.verse: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi wakafa biAllahi shaheedan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He it is Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it superior to all religions. And All-Sufficient is Allah as a Witness.

29.verse: مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muhammadun rasoolu Allahi waallatheena maAAahu ashiddao AAala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukkaAAan sujjadan yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan seemahum fee wujoohihim min athari alssujoodi thalika mathaluhum fee alttawrati wamathaluhum fee alinjeeli kazarAAin akhraja shatahu faazarahu faistaghlatha faistawa AAala sooqihi yuAAjibu alzzurraAAa liyagheetha bihimu alkuffara waAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati minhum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. And those who are with him are severe against disbelievers, and merciful among themselves. You see them bowing falling down prostrate, seeking reward from Allah and acceptance. The mark of them is on their faces from the traces of prostration. This is their description in the Tawrah. But their description in the Injil is like a seed which sends forth its shoot, then makes it strong, and becomes thick and it stands straight on its stem, delighting the sowers, that He may enrage the disbelievers with them. Allah has promised those among them who believe and do righteous good deeds, forgiveness and a mighty reward.

1.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allahi warasoolihi waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Make not (a decision) in advance before Allah and His Messenger, and have Taqwa of Allah. Verily, Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

2.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tarfaAAoo aswatakum fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi wala tajharoo lahu bialqawli kajahri baAAdikum libaAAdin an tahbata aAAmalukum waantum la tashAAuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak aloud to him in talk as you speak aloud to one another, lest your deeds should be thwarted while you perceive not.

3.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum AAinda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum lilttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who lower their voices in the presence of Allah's Messenger, they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for Taqwa. For them is forgiveness and a great reward.

4.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who call you from behind the dwellings, most of them have no sense.

5.verse: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if they had patience till you could come out to them, it would have been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Most Merciful.

6.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَن تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo AAala ma faAAaltum nadimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! If a rebellious evil person comes to you with a news, verify it, lest you harm people in ignorance, and afterwards you become regretful to what you have done.

7.verse: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaiAAlamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yuteeAAukum fee katheerin mina alamri laAAanittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra waalfusooqa waalAAisyana olaika humu alrrashidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And know that among you there is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would surely be in trouble, but Allah has endeared the faith to you and has beautified it in your hearts, and has made disbelief, Fusuq and `Isyan hateful to you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.

8.verse: فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fadlan mina Allahi waniAAmatan waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is a grace from Allah and His favor. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

9.verse: وَإِن طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِن بَغَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَاتِلُوا الَّتِي تَبْغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيءَ إِلَىٰ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَاءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوا ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma AAala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bialAAadli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if two parties among the believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them both. But if one of them outrages against the other, then fight you (all) against the one that which outrages till it complies with the command of Allah. Then if it complies, then make reconciliation between them justly, and be equitable. Verily, Allah loves those who are the equitable.

10.verse: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The believers are but a brotherhood. So make reconciliation between your brothers, and have Taqwa of Allah that you may receive mercy.

11.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونُوا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَاءٌ مِّن نِّسَاءٍ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ ۖ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin AAasa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain AAasa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu baAAda aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu alththalimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Let not a group scoff at another group, it may be that the latter are better than the former. Nor let (some) women scoff at other women, it may be that the latter are better than the former. Nor defame yourselves, nor insult one another by nicknames. Evil is the name of wickedness after faith. And whosoever does not repent, then such are indeed wrongdoers.

12.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina alththanni inna baAAda alththanni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab baAAdukum baAAdan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicion is sin. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother You would hate it. And have Taqwa of Allah. Verily, Allah is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, Most Merciful.

13.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha wajaAAalnakum shuAAooban waqabaila litaAAarafoo inna akramakum AAinda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O mankind! We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes that you may know one another. Verily, the most honorable of you with Allah is that (believer) who has At-Taqwa. Verily, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.

14.verse: ۞ قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَـٰكِن قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qalati alaAArabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tuteeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min aAAmalikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The bedouins say: "We believe." Say: "You do not believe. But say, `We have submitted,' for Faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not decrease anything in reward for your deeds. Verily, Allah is Forgiving, Most Merciful."

15.verse: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الصَّادِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu alssadiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Only those are the believers who have believed in Allah and His Messenger, and afterward doubt not but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Those! They are the truthful.

16.verse: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ اللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Will you inform Allah of your religion while Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and Allah is All-Aware of everything."

17.verse: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا عَلَيَّ إِسْلَامَكُم ۖ بَلِ اللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَاكُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yamunnoona AAalayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo AAalayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu AAalaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They regard as a favor to you that they have embraced Islam. Say: "Do not count your Islam as a favor to me. Nay, but Allah has conferred a favor upon you that He has guided you to the Faith if you indeed are true. "

18.verse: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waAllahu baseerun bima taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is the All-Seer of what you do."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an.

2.verse: بَلْ عَجِبُوا أَن جَاءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!"

3.verse: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "When we are dead and have become dust. (Shall we be resurrected) That is a far return."

4.verse: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We know that which the earth takes of them, and with Us is a Book preserved.

5.verse: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a Marij state.

6.verse: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no Furuj in it

7.verse: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon Rawasi standing firm, and We planted in it every lovely (Bahij) pair.

8.verse: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: An insight and a Reminder for every servant who turns to Allah in repentance.

9.verse: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُّبَارَكًا فَأَنبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith Jannat and grain that are reaped.

10.verse: وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And date palms Basiqat, with arranged clusters.

11.verse: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A provision for the servants. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the Resurrection.

12.verse: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Denied before them the people of Nuh, and the Dwellers of Rass, and Thamud,

13.verse: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And `Ad, and Fir`awn, and the brethren of Lut,

14.verse: وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, and the people of Tubba`. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My threat took effect.

15.verse: أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Were We then tired with the first creation Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation.

16.verse: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We have created man, and We know what his self whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

17.verse: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being), one sitting on the right and one on the left.

18.verse: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it).

19.verse: وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"

20.verse: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Trumpet will be blown -- that will be the Day of the threat.

21.verse: وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And every person will come forth along with a Sa'iq and a Shahid.

22.verse: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this. Now We have removed from you, your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"

23.verse: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (his record) ready with me!"

24.verse: أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah will say to the angels:) "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever"

25.verse: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,"

26.verse: الَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Who set up another god with Allah. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment."

27.verse: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: His companion (devil) will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, but he was himself in error far astray."

28.verse: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِالْوَعِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Allah) will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat."

29.verse: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants."

30.verse: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled" It will say: "Are there any more"

31.verse: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Paradise will be Uzlifat to those who had Taqwa, not far off.

32.verse: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised -- (it is) for those returning in sincere repentance, and Hafiz."

33.verse: مَّنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Who feared Ar-Rahman unseen and brought a heart turned in repentance."

34.verse: ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Enter you therein in peace and security -- this is a Day of eternal life!"

35.verse: لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There they will have all that they desire -- and We have more.

36.verse: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And they went about the land! Could they find any place of refuge

37.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.

38.verse: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.

39.verse: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So bear with patience all that they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.

40.verse: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises and (so likewise) after the prostrations.

41.verse: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.

42.verse: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when they will hear As-Sayhah in truth, that will be the Day of coming out.

43.verse: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it is We Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.

44.verse: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.

45.verse: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We know best what they say. And you are not the one to force them. But warn by the Qur'an; him who fears My threat.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalththariyati tharwan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the scattering Dhariyat;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalhamilati wiqran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the laden Hamilat;

3.verse: فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaljariyati yusran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the steady Jariyat;

4.verse: فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalmuqassimati amran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the distributors of command,

5.verse: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, that which you are promised is surely true.

6.verse: وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَاقِعٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, Ad-Din is sure to occur.

7.verse: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamai thati alhubuki

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the heaven full of Hubuk,

8.verse: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Certainly, you have different ideas.

9.verse: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Turned aside therefrom is he who is turned aside.

10.verse: قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qutila alkharrasoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Cursed be Al-Kharrasun

11.verse: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who are under a cover of Sahun,

12.verse: يَسْأَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They ask: "When will be the Day of Ad-Din"

13.verse: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be) a Day when they will be Yuftanun in the Fire!

14.verse: ذُوقُوا فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Taste you your trial! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"

15.verse: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,

16.verse: آخِذِينَ مَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this doers of good.

17.verse: كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They used to sleep but little by night.

18.verse: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in the hours before dawn, they were asking for forgiveness.

19.verse: وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in their wealth there was the right of the Sa'il and the Mahrum.

20.verse: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on the earth are signs for those who have faith with certainty.

21.verse: وَفِي أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And also in yourselves. Will you not then see

22.verse: وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.

23.verse: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth, just as you can speak.

24.verse: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has the story reached you, of the honored guests of Ibrahim

25.verse: إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَامٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When they came in to him and said: "Salaman!" He answered: "Salamun" and said: "You are a people unknown to me."

26.verse: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf.

27.verse: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And placed it before them (saying): "Will you not eat"

28.verse: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge.

29.verse: فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice; she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"

30.verse: قَالُوا كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."

31.verse: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Ibrahim) said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O messengers"

32.verse: قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are criminals."

33.verse: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "To send down upon them stones of clay."

34.verse: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Marked by your Lord for transgressors."

35.verse: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So We brought out from therein the believers.

36.verse: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one.

37.verse: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا آيَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have left there a sign for those who fear the painful torment.

38.verse: وَفِي مُوسَىٰ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in Musa, when We sent him to Fir`awn with a manifest authority.

39.verse: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But (he) turned away along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer or a madman."

40.verse: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So We took him and his armies, and dumped them into the sea (Yamm), for he was blameworthy.

41.verse: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in `Ad when We sent against them the barren wind;

42.verse: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.

43.verse: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in Thamud, when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"

44.verse: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they insolently defied the command of their Lord, so the Sa`iqah overtook them while they were looking.

45.verse: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنتَصِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

46.verse: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (So were) the people of Nuh before them. Verily, they were a people who were rebellious.

47.verse: وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With Hands We constructed the heaven. Verily, We are able to expand the vastness of space thereof.

48.verse: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have made the earth a Firash; how excellent spreader (thereof) are We!

49.verse: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember.

50.verse: فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, flee to Allah. Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him.

51.verse: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And set not up any other god along with Allah. Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him.

52.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَتَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"

53.verse: أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have they transmitted this saying to these Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!

54.verse: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So turn away from them, you are not blameworthy.

55.verse: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remind, for verily, the reminding profits the believers.

56.verse: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And I created not the Jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me.

57.verse: مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: I seek not any provision from them nor do I ask that they should feed Me.

58.verse: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of power, the Most Strong.

59.verse: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on!

60.verse: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then woe to those who disbelieve from their Day which they have been promised.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalttoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the Tur

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakitabin mastoorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Book inscribed

3.verse: فِي رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee raqqin manshoorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In parchment unrolled.

4.verse: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalbayti almaAAmoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by Al-Bayt Al-Ma`mur.

5.verse: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the roof raised high.

6.verse: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalbahri almasjoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the sea that is Masjur.

7.verse: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.

8.verse: مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma lahu min dafiAAin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is none that can avert it.

9.verse: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day when Tamur the heaven Mawr,

10.verse: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Tasir the mountains Sayr.

11.verse: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then woe that Day to those who denied.

12.verse: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who were, in their falsehood, playing.

13.verse: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.

14.verse: هَـٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is the Fire which you used to deny.

15.verse: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is this magic or do you not see

16.verse: اصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Enter therein and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.

17.verse: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in Gardens and Delight.

18.verse: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.

19.verse: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."

20.verse: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will recline on thrones Masfufah. And We shall marry them to Hur (fair females) with wide lovely eyes.

21.verse: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in faith, -- to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.

22.verse: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُم بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

23.verse: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There they shall pass from hand to hand a cup, free from any idle talk, and free from sin.

24.verse: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.

25.verse: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.

26.verse: قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid in the midst of our families."

27.verse: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "So Allah has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire."

28.verse: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, We used to invoke Him before. Verily, He is the Most Subtle, the Most Merciful."

29.verse: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore, remind. By the grace of Allah, you are neither a Kahin nor a madman.

30.verse: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do they say: "A poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"

31.verse: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Wait! I am with you among those who wait!"

32.verse: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُم بِهَـٰذَا ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do their minds command them this or are they people transgressing all bounds

33.verse: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do they say: "He has forged it" Nay! They believe not!

34.verse: فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Let them then produce a recitation like unto it if they are truthful.

35.verse: أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or were they created by nothing Or were they themselves the creators

36.verse: أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth Nay, but they have no firm belief.

37.verse: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like

38.verse: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.

39.verse: أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or has He only daughters and you have sons

40.verse: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is it that you ask a wage from them so that they are burdened with a load of debt

41.verse: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or that the Unseen is with them, and they write it down

42.verse: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do they intend a plot But those who disbelieve are themselves plotted against!

43.verse: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they a god other than Allah Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partners.

44.verse: وَإِن يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

45.verse: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).

46.verse: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

47.verse: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment before this; but most of them know not.

48.verse: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So wait patiently for the decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the praises of your Lord when you get up.

49.verse: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in the nighttime also glorify His praises and at the setting of the stars.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnajmi itha hawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the star when it goes down.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma dalla sahibukum wama ghawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Your companion has neither gone astray nor has he erred.

3.verse: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yantiqu AAani alhawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor does he speak of desire.

4.verse: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In huwa illa wahyun yooha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is only a revelation revealed.

5.verse: عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAallamahu shadeedu alquwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has been taught by one mighty in power.

6.verse: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَاسْتَوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thoo mirratin faistawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Dhu Mirrah then he Istawa.

7.verse: وَهُوَ بِالْأُفُقِ الْأَعْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa bialofuqi alaAAla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: While he was in the highest part of the horizon,

8.verse: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma dana fatadalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he approached and came closer,

9.verse: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakana qaba qawsayni aw adna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And was at a distance of two bows' length or less.

10.verse: فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faawha ila AAabdihi ma awha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So (Allah) revealed to His servant whatever He revealed.

11.verse: مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma kathaba alfuadu ma raa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The heart lied not in what he saw.

12.verse: أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afatumaroonahu AAala ma yara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Will you then dispute with him about what he saw

13.verse: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad raahu nazlatan okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed he saw him at a second descent.

14.verse: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنتَهَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAinda sidrati almuntaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Near Sidrat Al-Muntaha.

15.verse: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَأْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAindaha jannatu almawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Near it is the Paradise of Abode.

16.verse: إِذْ يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith yaghsha alssidrata ma yaghsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When that covered the lote tree which did cover it!

17.verse: مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma zagha albasaru wama tagha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The sight turned not aside, nor it transgressed beyond the limit.

18.verse: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed he saw of the greatest Ssgns of his Lord.

19.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ اللَّاتَ وَالْعُزَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraaytumu allata waalAAuzza

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you then considered Al-Lat, and Al-`Uzza.

20.verse: وَمَنَاةَ الثَّالِثَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamanata alththalithata alokhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Manat, the other third

21.verse: أَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْأُنثَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alakumu alththakaru walahu alontha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it for you the males and for Him the females

22.verse: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tilka ithan qismatun deeza

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That indeed is a division most unfair!

23.verse: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُم مَّا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَانٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They are but names which you have named - you and your fathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow but a guess and that which they themselves desire, whereas there has surely come to them the guidance from their Lord!

24.verse: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lilinsani ma tamanna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or shall man have what he wishes

25.verse: فَلِلَّهِ الْآخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falillahi alakhiratu waaloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But to Allah belongs the last (Hereafter) and the first (the world).

26.verse: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَرْضَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And there are many angels in the heavens, whose intercession will avail nothing, except after Allah has given leave for whom He wills and is pleased with.

27.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنثَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.

28.verse: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but conjecture, and verily, conjecture is no substitute for the truth.

29.verse: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore withdraw from him who turns away from Our Reminder and desires nothing but the life of this world.

30.verse: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ
