Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That is what they could reach of knowledge. Verily, your Lord is He, Who knows best him who goes astray from His path, and He knows best him who receives guidance.

31.verse: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, that He may requite those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good, with what is best.

32.verse: الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who avoid great sins and Al-Fawahish (immoral sins) except Al-Lamam -- verily, your Lord is of vast forgiveness. He knows you well when He created you from the earth (Adam), and when you were fetuses in your mothers' wombs. So, ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows best him who has Taqwa.

33.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraayta allathee tawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Did you observe him who turned away (from Islam).

34.verse: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaaAAta qaleelan waakda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And gave a little, then stopped

35.verse: أَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees

36.verse: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is he not informed with what is in the Suhuf of Musa,

37.verse: وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waibraheema allathee waffa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And of Ibrahim who fulfilled all that:

38.verse: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alla taziru waziratun wizra okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That no burdened person (with sins) shall bear the burden (sins) of another.

39.verse: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that man can have nothing but what he does.

40.verse: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yura

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that his deeds will be seen.

41.verse: ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma yujzahu aljazaa alawfa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.

42.verse: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الْمُنتَهَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna ila rabbika almuntaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that to your Lord is the End.

43.verse: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu huwa adhaka waabka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that it is He Who makes laugh, and makes weep.

44.verse: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu huwa amata waahya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that it is He Who causes death and gives life.

45.verse: وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu khalaqa alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that He creates the pairs, male and female,

46.verse: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min nutfatin itha tumna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: From Nutfah when it is emitted.

47.verse: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna AAalayhi alnnashata alokhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that upon Him is another bringing forth (Resurrection).

48.verse: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu huwa aghna waaqna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that it is He Who Aghna and Aqna.

49.verse: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu huwa rabbu alshshiAAra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that He is the Lord of Ash-Shi`ra.

50.verse: وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu ahlaka AAadan aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that it is He Who destroyed the former `Ad,

51.verse: وَثَمُودَ فَمَا أَبْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathamooda fama abqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Thamud. He spared none of them.

52.verse: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the people of Nuh aforetime. Verily, they were more unjust and more rebellious and transgressing.

53.verse: وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalmutafikata ahwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He destroyed the overthrown cities.

54.verse: فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faghashshaha ma ghashsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, there covered them that which did cover.

55.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbika tatamara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the graces of your Lord will you doubt

56.verse: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ النُّذُرِ الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha natheerun mina alnnuthuri aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is a warner from the warners of old.

57.verse: أَزِفَتِ الْآزِفَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Azifati alazifatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Azifah draws near.

58.verse: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: None besides Allah can avert it.

59.verse: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afamin hatha alhadeethi taAAjaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you then wonder at this reci- tation

60.verse: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watadhakoona wala tabkoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you laugh at it and weep not,

61.verse: وَأَنتُمْ سَامِدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waantum samidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: While you are Samidun.

62.verse: فَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ وَاعْبُدُوا ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faosjudoo lillahi waoAAbudoo

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So fall you down in prostration to Allah and worship Him.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder.

2.verse: وَإِن يَرَوْا آيَةً يُعْرِضُوا وَيَقُولُوا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if they see an Ayah, they turn away and say: "This is magic, Mustamir."

3.verse: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They denied and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled.

4.verse: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّنَ الْأَنبَاءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed there has come to them news wherein there is Muzdajar.

5.verse: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Perfect wisdom, but warners benefit them not.

6.verse: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.

7.verse: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,

8.verse: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."

9.verse: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The people of Nuh denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our servant and said: "A madman!" Wazdujir.

10.verse: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"

11.verse: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, We opened the gates of the heaven with water Munhamir.

12.verse: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So, the waters met for a matter predestined.

13.verse: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails (Dusur)

14.verse: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Floating under Our Eyes, a reward for him who had been rejected!

15.verse: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember

16.verse: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then how (terrible) was My torment and My warnings

17.verse: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there anyone who will remember

18.verse: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Ad denied; then how was My torment and My warnings

19.verse: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We sent against them a violently cold (Sarsar) wind on a day of calamity, continuous.

20.verse: تَنزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date palms.

21.verse: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, how was My torment and My warnings

22.verse: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember

23.verse: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thamud denied the warnings.

24.verse: فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they said: "A man, alone among us -- shall we follow him Truly, then we should be in error and distress!"

25.verse: أَأُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him alone from among us Nay, he is an insolent liar!"

26.verse: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!

27.verse: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُو النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them, and be patient!

28.verse: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one's right to drink being established (by turns).

29.verse: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).

30.verse: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, how was My torment and My warnings

31.verse: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We sent against them a single Sayhah, and they became like straw Al-Muhtazir.

32.verse: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We have made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember

33.verse: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The people of Lut denied the warnings.

34.verse: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَاهُم بِسَحَرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We sent against them Hasib (a violent storm of stones), except the family of Lut, them We saved in the last hour of the night,

35.verse: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَن شَكَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As a favor from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks.

36.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he indeed had warned them of Our punishment, but they doubted the warnings!

37.verse: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they indeed sought to shame his guests. So, We blinded their eyes (saying), "Then taste you My torment and My warnings."

38.verse: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.

39.verse: فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then taste you My torment and My warnings.

40.verse: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We have made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember

41.verse: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir`awn.

42.verse: كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They) denied all Our signs, so We seized them with a punishment of the Almighty, All-Capable.

43.verse: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُولَـٰئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Are your disbelievers better than these Or have you immunity in the Divine Scriptures

44.verse: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious"

45.verse: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

46.verse: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.

47.verse: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the criminals are in error and will burn.

48.verse: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"

49.verse: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar.

50.verse: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Our commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.

51.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember

52.verse: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And everything they have done is noted in Az-Zubur.

53.verse: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And everything, small and large, is written down.

54.verse: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who have Taqwa, will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers.

55.verse: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In a seat of truth, near the Muqtadir King.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alrrahmanu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ar-Rahman!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAallama alqurana

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has taught the Qur'an.

3.verse: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqa alinsana

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He created man.

4.verse: عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAallamahu albayana

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He taught him Al-Bayan.

5.verse: الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The sun and the moon (run) on fixed courses.

6.verse: وَالنَّجْمُ وَالشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Najm and the trees prostrating.

7.verse: وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the heaven He has raised high, and He has set up the balance.

8.verse: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا فِي الْمِيزَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alla tatghaw fee almeezani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In order that you may not transgress the balance.

9.verse: وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.

10.verse: وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the earth He has put down (laid) for Al-An'am.

11.verse: فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَالنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ الْأَكْمَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein are fruits, date palms producing Akmam.

12.verse: وَالْحَبُّ ذُو الْعَصْفِ وَالرَّيْحَانُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And also corn, with (its) `Asf, and Rayhan.

13.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

14.verse: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He created man from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.

15.verse: وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Jinn He created from a smokeless flame of fire.

16.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

17.verse: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Lord of the two easts and the Lord of the two wests.

18.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

19.verse: مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has Maraja the two seas meeting together.

20.verse: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.

21.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

22.verse: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Out of them both come out pearls and Al-Marjan.

23.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

24.verse: وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنشَآتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And His are Al-Jawar Al-Munsha'at, in the seas like A`lam.

25.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

26.verse: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kullu man AAalayha fanin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.

27.verse: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Face of your Lord Dhul-Jalal wal-Ikram will remain forever.

28.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

29.verse: يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whosoever is in the heavens and on the earth begs of Him. Every day He is (engaged) in some affair!

30.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

31.verse: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ الثَّقَلَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We shall attend to you, O Thaqalan!

32.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

33.verse: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O assembly of Jinn and men! If you are able to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allah)!

34.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

35.verse: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There will be sent against you both, Shuwaz of fire and Nuhas, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

36.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

37.verse: فَإِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when the heaven is rent asunder, and it becomes Wardah like Dihan.

38.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

39.verse: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْأَلُ عَن ذَنبِهِ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَانٌّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, on that Day he will not be questioned about his sin, (neither) human nor Jinn.

40.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

41.verse: يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِي وَالْأَقْدَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by their foreheads and feet.

42.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

43.verse: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is the Hell which the criminals denied.

44.verse: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ آنٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yatoofoona baynaha wabayna hameemin anin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will go between it and Hamim An!

45.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

46.verse: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waliman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But for him who fears the standing before his Lord, there will be two Gardens.

47.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

48.verse: ذَوَاتَا أَفْنَانٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thawata afnanin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With Afnan.

49.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

50.verse: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feehima AAaynani tajriyani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In them (both) will be two springs flowing (free).

51.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

52.verse: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feehima min kulli fakihatin zawjani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In them (both) will be every kind of fruit in pairs.

53.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

54.verse: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطَائِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Reclining upon the couches lined with Istabraq, and the fruits of the two Gardens will be near at hand.

55.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

56.verse: فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Wherein both will be Qasirat At-Tarf, whom never deflowered a human before nor Jinn.

57.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

58.verse: كَأَنَّهُنَّ الْيَاقُوتُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaannahunna alyaqootu waalmarjanu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They are like Yaqut and Marjan.

59.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

60.verse: هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal jazao alihsani illa alihsanu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is there any reward for good other than good

61.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

62.verse: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin doonihima jannatani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And below these two, there are two other Gardens.

63.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

64.verse: مُدْهَامَّتَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Mudhammatani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Mudhammatan.

65.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

66.verse: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feehima AAaynani naddakhatani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In them (both) will be two springs Naddakhatan.

67.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

68.verse: فِيهِمَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feehima fakihatun wanakhlun warummanun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In them (both) will be fruits, and date palms and pomegranates.

69.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

70.verse: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feehinna khayratun hisanun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein (Gardens) will be Khayrat Hisan;

71.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

72.verse: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hoorun maqsooratun fee alkhiyami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Hur (beautiful, fair females) guarded in pavilions;

73.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

74.verse: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whom never deflowered a human before nor Jinn.

75.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

76.verse: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Reclining on green Rafraf and rich beautiful `Abqariy.

77.verse: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny

78.verse: تَبَارَكَ اسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Blessed be the Name of your Lord, Dhil-Jalali wal-Ikram.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When the Waqi`ah occurs

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laysa liwaqAAatiha kathibatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is not, for its occurrence, Kadhibah.

3.verse: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khafidatun rafiAAatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Bringing low (some), exalting (others).

4.verse: إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha rujjati alardu rajjan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

5.verse: وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabussati aljibalu bassan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

6.verse: فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُّنبَثًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakanat habaan munbaththan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So that they will become floating dust particles.

7.verse: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلَاثَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakuntum azwajan thalathatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you (all) will be in three groups.

8.verse: فَأَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So those on the right -- how (fortunate) will be those on the right!

9.verse: وَأَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waashabu almashamati ma ashabu almashamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those on the left -- how (unfortunate) will be those on the left!

10.verse: وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssabiqoona alssabiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those foremost will be foremost.

11.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika almuqarraboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: These will be the nearest (to Allah).

12.verse: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In the Gardens of Delight.

13.verse: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thullatun mina alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A multitude of those will be from the first ones.

14.verse: وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaleelun mina alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a few of those will be from the later ones.

15.verse: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala sururin mawdoonatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They will be) on thrones, Mawdunah.

16.verse: مُّتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muttakieena AAalayha mutaqabileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Reclining thereon, face to face.

17.verse: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),

18.verse: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Biakwabin waabareeqa wakasin min maAAeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,

19.verse: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yusaddaAAoona AAanha wala yunzifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Wherefrom neither Yusadda`un nor Yunzifun.

20.verse: وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafakihatin mimma yatakhayyaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And with fruit that they may choose.

21.verse: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walahmi tayrin mimma yashtahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.

22.verse: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahoorun AAeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (there will be) Hur with wide lovely eyes.

23.verse: كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaamthali allului almaknooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Like preserved pearls.

24.verse: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A reward for what they used to do.

25.verse: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No Laghw (evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech.

26.verse: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa qeelan salaman salaman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But only the saying of: "Salaman! Salaman!"

27.verse: وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waashabu alyameeni ma ashabu alyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those on the right -- how (fortunate) will be those on the right

28.verse: فِي سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee sidrin makhdoodin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (They will be) among Sidri Makhdud,

29.verse: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watalhin mandoodin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And among Talh Mandud.

30.verse: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathillin mamdoodin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And in shade Mamdud,

31.verse: وَمَاءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamain maskoobin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by water flowing constantly,

32.verse: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafakihatin katheeratin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And fruit in plenty,

33.verse: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La maqtooAAatin wala mamnooAAatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whose supply is not cut off nor are they out of reach.

34.verse: وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafurushin marfooAAatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And on couches, raised high.

35.verse: إِنَّا أَنشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنشَاءً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna anshanahunna inshaan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have created them a special creation.

36.verse: فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAalnahunna abkaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And made them virgins.

37.verse: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAuruban atraban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Urub, Atrab.

38.verse: لِّأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liashabi alyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For those on the right.

39.verse: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thullatun mina alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A multitude of those will be from the first generation.

40.verse: وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathullatun mina alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a multitude of those will be from the later generations.

41.verse: وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waashabu alshshimali ma ashabu alshshimali

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those on the left How will be those on the left

42.verse: فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee samoomin wahameemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In Samum, and Hamim.

43.verse: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathillin min yahmoomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a shadow from Yahmum,

44.verse: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La baridin wala kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Neither Barid nor Karim,

45.verse: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum kanoo qabla thalika mutrafeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

46.verse: وَكَانُوا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنثِ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakanoo yusirroona AAala alhinthi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And were persisting in great sin.

47.verse: وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected"

48.verse: أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awa abaona alawwaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And also our forefathers"

49.verse: قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul inna alawwaleena waalakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times."

50.verse: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LamajmooAAoona ila meeqati yawmin maAAloomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed meeting of a known Day."

51.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innakum ayyuha alddalloona almukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then verily, --- you the erring -- ones, the deniers!"

52.verse: لَآكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "You verily, will eat of the trees of Zaqqum."

53.verse: فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famalioona minha albutoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,"

54.verse: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fashariboona AAalayhi mina alhameemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And drink the Hamim on top of it."

55.verse: فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fashariboona shurba alheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And you will drink (that) like Al-Him!"

56.verse: هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha nuzuluhum yawma alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!

57.verse: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nahnu khalaqnakum falawla tusaddiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We created you, then why do you believe not

58.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraaytum ma tumnoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you not see the semen you emit.

59.verse: أَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aantum takhluqoonahu am nahnu alkhaliqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator

60.verse: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,

61.verse: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala an nubaddila amthalakum wanunshiakum fee ma la taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.

62.verse: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad AAalimtumu alnnashata aloola falawla tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation, why then do you not remember

63.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraaytum ma tahruthoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you not see what you sow.

64.verse: أَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aantum tazraAAoonahu am nahnu alzzariAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower

65.verse: لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Law nashao lajaAAalnahu hutaman fathaltum tafakkahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Were it Our will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be Tafakkahun.

66.verse: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna lamughramoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Saying:) "We are indeed Mughramun!"

67.verse: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal nahnu mahroomoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Nay, but we are deprived!"

68.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ الْمَاءَ الَّذِي تَشْرَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraaytumu almaa allathee tashraboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you not see the water that you drink.

69.verse: أَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنزِلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aantum anzaltumoohu mina almuzni am nahnu almunziloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it you who cause it to come down from Al-Muzn, or are We the Cause of it coming down

70.verse: لَوْ نَشَاءُ جَعَلْنَاهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Law nashao jaAAalnahu ojajan falawla tashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If We willed, We verily could make it salty; why then do you not give thanks

71.verse: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ النَّارَ الَّتِي تُورُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaraaytumu alnnara allatee tooroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you not see the fire which you kindle.

72.verse: أَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَا أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنشِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aantum anshatum shajarataha am nahnu almunshioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower

73.verse: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَاهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَاعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nahnu jaAAalnaha tathkiratan wamataAAan lilmuqweena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We have made it a Reminder, and an article of use for the Muqwin.

74.verse: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

75.verse: ۞ فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala oqsimu bimawaqiAAi alnnujoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Fala! I swear by the Mawaqi` of the stars.

76.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu laqasamun law taAAlamoona AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.

77.verse: إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu laquranun kareemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That (this) is indeed an honorable recitation.

78.verse: فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee kitabin maknoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In a Book Maknun.

79.verse: لَّا يَمَسُّهُ إِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yamassuhu illa almutahharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which none touches but the pure ones.

80.verse: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A revelation from the Lord of all that exists.

81.verse: أَفَبِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afabihatha alhadeethi antum mudhinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it such a talk that you are Mudhinun

82.verse: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WatajAAaloona rizqakum annakum tukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you make your provision your denial!

83.verse: فَلَوْلَا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falawla itha balaghati alhulqooma

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then why do you not (intervene) when it reaches Al-Hulqum

84.verse: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waantum heenaithin tanthuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you at the moment are looking,

85.verse: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walakin la tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But We are nearer to him than you, but you see not,

86.verse: فَلَوْلَا إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falawla in kuntum ghayra madeeneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then why do you not -- if you are not Madinin

87.verse: تَرْجِعُونَهَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TarjiAAoonaha in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Return the soul, if you are truthful

88.verse: فَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma in kana mina almuqarrabeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, if he be of the Muqarrabin,

89.verse: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Farawhun warayhanun wajannatu naAAeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Rawh, Rayhan and a Garden of Delights.

90.verse: وَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma in kana min ashabi alyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if he be of those on the right,

91.verse: فَسَلَامٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasalamun laka min ashabi alyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Salam (peace) to you from those on the right.

92.verse: وَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ الضَّالِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma in kana mina almukaththibeena alddalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But if he be of the denying, the erring,

93.verse: فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fanuzulun min hameemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then for him is an entertainment with Hamim.

94.verse: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watasliyatu jaheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And entry in Hellfire.

95.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha lahuwa haqqu alyaqeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this! This is an absolute truth with certainty.

96.verse: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

1.verse: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah -- and He is the Almighty, All-Wise.

2.verse: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. It is He Who gives life and causes death; and He is Able to do all things.

3.verse: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa alawwalu waalakhiru waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He is Al-Awwal and Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir and Al-Batin. And He is the All-Knower of everything.

4.verse: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa maAAakum ayna ma kuntum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days and then rose (Istawa) over the Throne. He knows what goes into the earth and what comes forth from it, and what descends from the heaven and what ascends thereto. And He is with you wheresoever you may be. And Allah is the All-Seer of what you do.

5.verse: لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allah return all the matters.

6.verse: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayi wahuwa AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He merges night into day, and merges day into night, and He has full knowledge of whatsoever is in the breasts.

7.verse: آمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waanfiqoo mimma jaAAalakum mustakhlafeena feehi faallatheena amanoo minkum waanfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend of that whereof He has made you trustees. And such of you as believe and spend, theirs will be a great reward.

8.verse: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ ۙ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama lakum la tuminoona biAllahi waalrrasoolu yadAAookum lituminoo birabbikum waqad akhatha meethaqakum in kuntum mumineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what is the matter with you that you believe not in Allah! While the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord; and He has indeed taken your covenant, if you are real believers.

9.verse: هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa allathee yunazzilu AAala AAabdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wainna Allaha bikum laraoofun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is He Who sends down manifest Ayat to His servant that He may bring you out from darkness into light. And verily, Allah is to you full of kindness, Most Merciful.

10.verse: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ الَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا مِن بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُوا ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama lakum alla tunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi walillahi meerathu alssamawati waalardi la yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qabli alfathi waqatala olaika aAAthamu darajatan mina allatheena anfaqoo min baAAdu waqataloo wakullan waAAada Allahu alhusna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what is the matter with you that you spend not in the cause of Allah And to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent and fought before the conquering. Such are higher in degree than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to all Allah has promised the best. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

11.verse: مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayudaAAifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who is he that will lend Allah a handsome loan: then He will increase it manifold to his credit, and he will have a honorable reward.

12.verse: يَوْمَ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِم بُشْرَاكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tara almumineena waalmuminati yasAAa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim bushrakumu alyawma jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day you shall see the believing men and the believing women -- their light running forward before them and in their right hands. Glad tidings for you this Day! Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever! Truly, this is the great success!
