Translations.translation: He knows what is in the heavens and on earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you reveal. And Allah is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts.

5.verse: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena kafaroo min qablu fathaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has not the news reached you of those who disbelieved aforetime And so they tasted the evil result of their disbelief, and theirs will be a painful torment.

6.verse: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا وَتَوَلَّوا ۚ وَّاسْتَغْنَى اللَّهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thalika biannahu kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati faqaloo abasharun yahdoonana fakafaroo watawallaw waistaghna Allahu waAllahu ghaniyyun hameedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That was because there came to them their Messengers with Bayyinat, but they said: "Shall mere men guide us" So they disbelieved and turned away. But Allah was not in need. And Allah is not in need, Worthy of all praise.

7.verse: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: ZaAAama allatheena kafaroo an lan yubAAathoo qul bala warabbee latubAAathunna thumma latunabbaonna bima AAamiltum wathalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The disbelievers pretend that they will never be resurrected. Say: "Yes! By my Lord, you will certainly be resurrected, then you will be informed of what you did; and that is easy for Allah."

8.verse: فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waalnnoori allathee anzalna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore, believe in Allah and His Messenger and in the Light which We have sent down. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

9.verse: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yajmaAAukum liyawmi aljamAAi thalika yawmu alttaghabuni waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when He will gather you on the Day of Gathering, that will be the Day of At-Taghabun. And whosoever believes in Allah and performs righteous deeds, He will expiate from him his sins, and will admit him to Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever; that will be the great success.

10.verse: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari khalideena feeha wabisa almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But those who disbelieved and denied Our Ayat, they will be the dwellers of the Fire, to dwell therein forever. And worst indeed is that destination

11.verse: مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma asaba min museebatin illa biithni Allahi waman yumin biAllahi yahdi qalbahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No calamity occurs, but by the permission of Allah, and whosoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart. And Allah is the All-Knower of everything.

12.verse: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaytum fainnama AAala rasoolina albalaghu almubeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then the duty of Our Messenger is only to convey clearly.

13.verse: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah! La ilaha illa Huwa. And in Allah therefore let the believers put their trust.

14.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna min azwajikum waawladikum AAaduwwan lakum faihtharoohum wain taAAfoo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Verily, among your wives and your children there are enemies for you; therefore beware of them! But if you pardon (them) and overlook, and forgive, then verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

15.verse: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waAllahu AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Your wealth and your children are only a Fitnah, whereas Allah! With Him is a great reward.

16.verse: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faittaqoo Allaha ma istataAAtum waismaAAoo waateeAAoo waanfiqoo khayran lianfusikum waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So have Taqwa of Allah as much as you can; listen and obey, and spend in charity; that is better for yourselves. And whosoever is saved from his own greed, then they are the successful ones.

17.verse: إِن تُقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In tuqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu shakoorun haleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If you lend to Allah a handsome loan, He will double it for you, and will forgive you. And Allah is Shakur, Halim,

18.verse: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alAAazeezu alhakeemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: All-Knower of the unseen and seen, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

1.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا الْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِن بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ ۚ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fatalliqoohunna liAAiddatihinna waahsoo alAAiddata waittaqoo Allaha rabbakum la tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wala yakhrujna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin watilka hudoodu Allahi waman yataAAadda hudooda Allahi faqad thalama nafsahu la tadree laAAalla Allaha yuhdithu baAAda thalika amran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O Prophet! When you divorce women, divorce them at their `Iddah and count their `Iddah. And have Taqwa of Allah, your Lord. And turn them not out of their homes nor shall they leave, except in case they are guilty of Fahishah Mubayyinah. And those are the set limits of Allah. And whosoever transgresses the set limits of Allah, then indeed he has wronged himself. You know not, it may be that Allah will afterward bring some new thing to pass.

2.verse: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha balaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bimaAAroofin aw fariqoohunna bimaAAroofin waashhidoo thaway AAadlin minkum waaqeemoo alshshahadata lillahi thalikum yooAAathu bihi man kana yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu makhrajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when they are about to attain their term appointed, either take them back in a good manner or part with them in a good manner. And take as witness two just persons from among you. And establish the testimony for Allah. That will be an admonition given to him who believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever has Taqwa of Allah, He will make a way for him to get out.

3.verse: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad jaAAala Allahu likulli shayin qadran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He will provide him from where he never could imagine. And whosoever puts his trust in Allah, then He will suffice him. Verily, Allah will accomplish his purpose. Indeed Allah has set a measure for all things.

4.verse: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallaee yaisna mina almaheedi min nisaikum ini irtabtum faAAiddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin waallaee lam yahidna waolatu alahmali ajaluhunna an yadaAAna hamlahunna waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu min amrihi yusran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those in menopause among your women, for them the `Iddah, if you have doubt, is three months; and for those who have no courses. And for those who are pregnant, their `Iddah is until they lay down their burden; and whosoever has Taqwa of Allah, He will make his matter easy for him.

5.verse: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayuAAthim lahu ajran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whosoever has Taqwa of Allah, He will expiate from him his sins, and will increase his reward.

6.verse: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wala tudarroohunna litudayyiqoo AAalayhinna wain kunna olati hamlin faanfiqoo AAalayhinna hatta yadaAAna hamlahunna fain ardaAAna lakum faatoohunna ojoorahunna watamiroo baynakum bimaAAroofin wain taAAasartum fasaturdiAAu lahu okhra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Lodge them where you dwell, according to what you have, and do not harm them so as to suppress them. And if they are pregnant, then spend on them till they lay down their burden. Then if they suckle the children for you, give them their due payment, and let each of you deal with each other in a mannerly way. But if you make difficulties for one another, then some other woman may suckle for him.

7.verse: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyunfiq thoo saAAatin min saAAatihi waman qudira AAalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa ma ataha sayajAAalu Allahu baAAda AAusrin yusran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Let the rich man spend according to his means; and the man whose resources are restricted, let him spend according to what Allah has given him. Allah puts no burden on any person beyond what He has given him. Allah will grant after hardship, ease.

8.verse: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakaayyin min qaryatin AAatat AAan amri rabbiha warusulihi fahasabnaha hisaban shadeedan waAAaththabnaha AAathaban nukran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And many a town revolted against the command of its Lord and His Messengers; and We called it to a severe account, and We shall punish it with a horrible torment.

9.verse: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathaqat wabala amriha wakana AAaqibatu amriha khusran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So it tasted the evil result of its affair, and the consequence of its affair was loss.

10.verse: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan faittaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi allatheena amanoo qad anzala Allahu ilaykum thikran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah has prepared for them a severe torment. So have Taqwa of Allah, O men of understanding, those who believe! Allah has indeed sent down to you a Reminder.

11.verse: رَّسُولًا يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rasoolan yatloo AAalaykum ayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyukhrija allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati mina alththulumati ila alnnoori waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan qad ahsana Allahu lahu rizqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A Messenger, who recites to you the Ayat of Allah containing clear explanations, that He may take out those who believe and do righteous good deeds, from the darkness to the light. And whosoever believes in Allah and performs righteous deeds, He will admit him into Gardens under which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever. Allah has indeed granted for him an excellent provision.

12.verse: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna litaAAlamoo anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin AAilman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is Allah Who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like thereof. His command descends between them, that you may know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah surrounds all things with (His) knowledge.

1.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla Allahu laka tabtaghee mardata azwajika waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O Prophet! Why do you forbid that which Allah has allowed to you, seeking to please your wives And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

2.verse: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad farada Allahu lakum tahillata aymanikum waAllahu mawlakum wahuwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah has already ordained for you (O men) the absolution from your oaths. And Allah is your Protector and He is the All-Knower, the All-Wise.

3.verse: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَن بَعْضٍ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنبَأَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waith asarra alnnabiyyu ila baAAdi azwajihi hadeethan falamma nabbaat bihi waathharahu Allahu AAalayhi AAarrafa baAAdahu waaAArada AAan baAAdin falamma nabbaaha bihi qalat man anbaaka hatha qala nabbaaniya alAAaleemu alkhabeeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And (remember) when the Prophet disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his wives, then she told it. And Allah made it known to him; he informed part thereof and left a part. Then when he told her thereof, she said: "Who told you this" He said: "The All-Knower, the All-Aware has told me."

4.verse: إِن تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In tatooba ila Allahi faqad saghat quloobukuma wain tathahara AAalayhi fainna Allaha huwa mawlahu wajibreelu wasalihu almumineena waalmalaikatu baAAda thalika thaheerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If you two turn in repentance to Allah, your hearts are indeed so inclined; but if you help one another against him, then verily, Allah is his Protector, and Jibril, and the righteous among the believers; and after that the angels are his helpers.

5.verse: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُّؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin muminatin qanitatin taibatin AAabidatin saihatin thayyibatin waabkaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Maybe his Lord, if he divorces you, will give him instead of you, wives better than you - submitting, believers, obedient, turning to Allah in repentance, worshipping Allah sincerely, Sa'ihat, previously married, and virgins.

6.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qoo anfusakum waahleekum naran waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu AAalayha malaikatun ghilathun shidadun la yaAAsoona Allaha ma amarahum wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families against a Fire (Hell) whose fuel is men and stones, over which are (appointed) angels stern (and) severe, who disobey not the commands they receive from Allah, but do that which they are commanded.

7.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena kafaroo la taAAtathiroo alyawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said in the Hereafter) O you who disbelieve! Make no excuses this Day! You are being requited only for what you used to do.

8.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo tooboo ila Allahi tawbatan nasoohan AAasa rabbukum an yukaffira AAankum sayyiatikum wayudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yawma la yukhzee Allahu alnnabiyya waallatheena amanoo maAAahu nooruhum yasAAa bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim yaqooloona rabbana atmim lana noorana waighfir lana innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you who believe! Turn to Allah with sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will expiate from you your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow -- the Day that Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run forward before them and in their right hands. They will say: "Our Lord! Keep perfect our light for us and grant us forgiveness. Verily, You are Able to do all things."

9.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waoghluth AAalayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O Prophet! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be severe against them; their abode will be Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.

10.verse: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Daraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena kafaroo imraata noohin waimraata lootin kanata tahta AAabdayni min AAibadina salihayni fakhanatahuma falam yughniya AAanhuma mina Allahi shayan waqeela odkhula alnnara maAAa alddakhileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Allah sets forth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Nuh and the wife of Lut. They were under two of our righteous servants, but they both betrayed them. So, they availed them not against Allah and it was said: "Enter the Fire along with those who enter!"

11.verse: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena amanoo imraata firAAawna ith qalat rabbi ibni lee AAindaka baytan fee aljannati wanajjinee min firAAawna waAAamalihi wanajjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah has set forth an example for those who believe: the wife of Fir`awn, when she said: "My Lord! Build for me a home with You in Paradise, and save me from Fir`awn and his work, and save me from the people who are wrongdoers.

12.verse: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamaryama ibnata AAimrana allatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feehi min roohina wasaddaqat bikalimati rabbiha wakutubihi wakanat mina alqaniteena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Maryam, the daughter of `Imran who guarded her chastity (private part). And We breathed into it through Our Ruh, and she testified to the truth of her Lords Kalimat, and His Kutub, and she was of the Qanitin.

1.verse: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Blessed be He in Whose Hand is the dominion; and He is Able to do all things.

2.verse: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has created death and life that He may test you which of you is best in deed. And He is the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving;

3.verse: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has created the seven heavens one above the other; you can see no fault in the creation of the Most Gracious. Then look again. Can you see any rifts

4.verse: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then look again and yet again, your sight will return to you Khasi', and worn out.

5.verse: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps, and We have made such lamps (as) missiles to drive away the Shayatin, and have prepared for them the torment of the blazing Fire.

6.verse: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.

7.verse: إِذَا أُلْقُوا فِيهَا سَمِعُوا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When they are cast therein, they will hear its Shahiq while it is simmering.

8.verse: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keepers will ask: "Did no warner come to you"

9.verse: قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "Yes, indeed a warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said: `Allah never sent down anything; you are only in great error."'

10.verse: وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers of the blazing Fire!"

11.verse: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they will confess their sin. So, away with the dwellers of the blazing Fire!

12.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who fear their Lord unseen, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.

13.verse: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts.

14.verse: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Should not He Who has created know And He is the Most Kind and Courteous, All-Aware.

15.verse: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you; so walk in the paths thereof and eat of His provision. And to Him will be the resurrection.

16.verse: أَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven, will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then it should quake

17.verse: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven, will not send against you a Hasib Then you shall know how has been My warning.

18.verse: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed those before them rejected, then how terrible was My reproach

19.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in None upholds them except the Most Gracious. Verily, He is the All-Seer of everything.

20.verse: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who is it besides the Most Gracious that can be an army to you to help you The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.

21.verse: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who is it that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and flee.

22.verse: أَفَمَن يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَىٰ أَمَّن يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is he who walks prone on his face, more rightly guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path

23.verse: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "It is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing and seeing, and hearts. Little thanks you give."

24.verse: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "It is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered."

25.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if you are telling the truth"

26.verse: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am only a plain warner."

27.verse: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when they will see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be sad and grievous, and it will be said: "This is what you were calling for!"

28.verse: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Tell me! If Allah destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment"

29.verse: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "He is the Most Gracious, in Him we believe, and upon Him we rely. So, you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error."

30.verse: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَاءٍ مَّعِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing water"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Noon waalqalami wama yasturoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nun. By the pen and by what they Yastur.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma anta biniAAmati rabbika bimajnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You, by the grace of your Lord, are not insane.

3.verse: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna laka laajran ghayra mamnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, for you will be reward that is not Mamnun.

4.verse: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnaka laAAala khuluqin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, you are on an exalted character.

5.verse: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasatubsiru wayubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You will see, and they will see,

6.verse: بِأَييِّكُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Biayyikumu almaftoonu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which of you is afflicted with madness.

7.verse: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your Lord is the best Knower of him who has gone astray from His path, and He is the best Knower of those who are guided.

8.verse: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala tutiAAi almukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, do not obey the deniers.

9.verse: وَدُّوا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They wish that you should compromise with them, so they (too) would compromise with you.

10.verse: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tutiAA kulla hallafin maheenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And do not obey every Hallaf Mahin.

11.verse: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hammazin mashshain binameemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A Hammaz, going about with Namim,

12.verse: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin atheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, sinful,

13.verse: عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAutullin baAAda thalika zaneemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `Utul, and moreover Zanim.

14.verse: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An kana tha malin wabaneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (He was so) because he had wealth and children.

15.verse: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When Our Ayat are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the men of old!"

16.verse: سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sanasimuhu AAala alkhurtoomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We shall brand him on the snout (nose)!

17.verse: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they swore to pluck the fruits in the morning,

18.verse: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yastathnoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Without saying: "If Allah wills."

19.verse: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَائِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then there passed over it a Ta'if from your Lord while they were asleep.

20.verse: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faasbahat kaalssareemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So by the morning, it became like As-Sarim.

21.verse: فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatanadaw musbiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they called out (one to another as soon) as the morning broke.

22.verse: أَنِ اغْدُوا عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَارِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Saying: "Go to your tilth in the morning, if you would pluck (the fruits)."

23.verse: فَانطَلَقُوا وَهُمْ يَتَخَافَتُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faintalaqoo wahum yatakhafatoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So they departed, and they were whispering:

24.verse: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "No poor person shall enter upon you into it today."

25.verse: وَغَدَوْا عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waghadaw AAala hardin qadireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they went in the morning with Hard Qadirin.

26.verse: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوا إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falamma raawha qaloo inna ladalloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when they saw it, they said: "Verily, we have gone astray."

27.verse: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal nahnu mahroomoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Nay! Indeed we are deprived!"

28.verse: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Awsat among them said; "Did I not tell you, `Why do you not Tusabbihun."'

29.verse: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Glory to Our Lord! Verily, we have been wrongdoers."

30.verse: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَاوَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatalawamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they turned one against another, blaming.

31.verse: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا طَاغِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They said: "Woe to us! Verily, we were Taghin."

32.verse: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَا أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَاغِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange better than it. Truly, we hope in our Lord."

33.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Such is the punishment, but truly, the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they but knew.

34.verse: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, for those who have Taqwa are Gardens of Delight with their Lord.

35.verse: أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AfanajAAalu almuslimeena kaalmujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Shall We then treat the Muslims like the criminals

36.verse: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What is the matter with you How judge you

37.verse: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lakum kitabun feehi tadrusoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have you a Book wherein you learn,

38.verse: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna lakum feehi lama takhayyaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That you shall therein have all that you choose

39.verse: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have you oaths from Us, lasting until the Day of Judgement, that yours will be what you judge

40.verse: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salhum ayyuhum bithalika zaAAeemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Ask them, which of them will stand as surety for that!

41.verse: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or have they "partners" Then let them bring their "partners" if they are truthful!

42.verse: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when the Shin shall be laid bare and they shall be called to prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able to do so.

43.verse: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Their eyes will be cast down and ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate themselves, while they were.

44.verse: فَذَرْنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then leave Me alone with whoever denies this narration. We shall punish them gradually from directions they perceive not.

45.verse: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And I will grant them a respite. Verily, My plan is strong.

46.verse: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or is it that you ask them a wage, so that they are heavily burdened with debt

47.verse: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down

48.verse: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, wait with patience for the decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish when he cried out (to Us) while he was Makzum.

49.verse: لَّوْلَا أَن تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Had not a grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been (left in the stomach of the fish, but We forgave him), so he was cast off on the naked shore, while he was to be blamed.

50.verse: فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faijtabahu rabbuhu fajaAAalahu mina alssaliheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

51.verse: وَإِن يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes (through hatred) when they hear the Reminder (the Qur'an), and they say: "Verily, he is a madman!"

52.verse: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But it is nothing else than a Reminder to all the creatures (`Alamin).

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alhaqqatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Al-Haqqah!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma alhaqqatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What is Al-Haqqah

3.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma alhaqqatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what Al-Haqqah is

4.verse: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌ بِالْقَارِعَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat thamoodu waAAadun bialqariAAati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thamud and `Ad denied the Qari`ah!

5.verse: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma thamoodu faohlikoo bialttaghiyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the Taghiyah!

6.verse: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And as for `Ad, they were destroyed by a wind, Sarsar `Atiyah!

7.verse: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which Allah imposed on them for seven nights and eight days Husum, so that you could see men lying toppled, as if they were trunks of date palms, Khawiyah!

8.verse: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّن بَاقِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fahal tara lahum min baqiyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do you see any remnants of them

9.verse: وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Fir`awn, and those before him, and the cities overthrown committed Al-Khati'ah.

10.verse: فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they disobeyed their Lord's Messenger, so He seized them with a punishment that was Rabiyah.

11.verse: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, when the water rose beyond its limits, We carried you in the ship.

12.verse: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That We might make it an admonition for you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.

13.verse: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing.

14.verse: وَحُمِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing.

15.verse: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fayawmaithin waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then on that Day shall the Event occur.

16.verse: وَانشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainshaqqati alssamao fahiya yawmaithin wahiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it will be frail and torn up.

17.verse: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰ أَرْجَائِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

18.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.

19.verse: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!"

20.verse: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَاقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innee thanantu annee mulaqin hisabiyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my account!"

21.verse: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.

22.verse: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In a lofty Paradise,

23.verse: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qutoofuha daniyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.

24.verse: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!

25.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!"

26.verse: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walam adri ma hisabiyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And that I had never known how my account is!"

27.verse: يَا لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya laytaha kanati alqadiyatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Would that it had been my end!"

28.verse: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ ۜ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma aghna AAannee maliyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "My wealth has not availed me;"

29.verse: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Halaka AAannee sultaniyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "My power has gone from me!"

30.verse: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khuthoohu faghulloohu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;"

31.verse: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma aljaheema salloohu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then throw him in the blazing Fire."

32.verse: ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Then fasten him on a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"

33.verse: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he used not to believe in Allah, the Most Great,

34.verse: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And urged not the feeding of the poor.

35.verse: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falaysa lahu alyawma hahuna hameemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, no friend has he here this Day,

36.verse: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala taAAamun illa min ghisleenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor any food except filth from Ghislin.

37.verse: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُ إِلَّا الْخَاطِئُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yakuluhu illa alkhatioona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: None will eat it except the Khati'un.

38.verse: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala oqsimu bima tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, I swear by whatsoever you see,

39.verse: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama la tubsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by whatsoever you see not,

40.verse: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That this is verily the word of an honored Messenger.

41.verse: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is not the word of a poet, little is that you believe!

42.verse: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer, little is that you remember!

43.verse: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: This is the revelation sent down from the Lord of all that exists.

44.verse: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw taqawwala AAalayna baAAda alaqaweeli

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And if he had forged a false saying concerning Us,

45.verse: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laakhathna minhu bialyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We surely would have seized him by his right hand,

46.verse: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma laqataAAna minhu alwateena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And then We certainly would have cut off Al-Watin from him,

47.verse: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And none of you could have prevented it from him.

48.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu latathkiratun lilmuttaqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, this is a Reminder for those who have Taqwa.

49.verse: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lanaAAlamu anna minkum mukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, We know that there are some among you that deny.

50.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu lahasratun AAala alkafireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed it will be an anguish for the disbelievers.

51.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu lahaqqu alyaqeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, it (this Qur'an) is an absolute truth with certainty.

52.verse: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Saala sailun biAAathabin waqiAAin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lilkafireena laysa lahu dafiAAun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

3.verse: مِّنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Mina Allahi thee almaAAariji

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: From Allah, the Lord of the ways of ascent.

4.verse: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The angels and the Ruh ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.

5.verse: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faisbir sabran jameelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So be patient, with a good patience.

6.verse: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum yarawnahu baAAeedan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, they see it (the torment) afar off.

7.verse: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanarahu qareeban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But We see it near.

8.verse: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma takoonu alssamao kaalmuhli

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day that the sky will be like the Al-Muhl.

9.verse: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the mountains will be like `Ihn.

10.verse: وَلَا يَسْأَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yasalu hameemun hameeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And no friend will ask a friend,

11.verse: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Though they shall be made to see one another, the criminal would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children.

12.verse: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasahibatihi waakheehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And his wife and his brother,

13.verse: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُؤْوِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafaseelatihi allatee tuweehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And his Fasilah who sheltered him,

14.verse: وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.

15.verse: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla innaha latha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By no means! Verily, it will be the fire of Hell,

16.verse: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: NazzaAAatan lilshshawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nazza`ah the Shawa!

17.verse: تَدْعُو مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TadAAoo man adbara watawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Calling (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces.

18.verse: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajamaAAa faawAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the cause of Allah).

19.verse: ۞ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alinsana khuliqa halooAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, man was created very impatient;

20.verse: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha massahu alshsharru jazooAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Apprehensive when evil touches him;

21.verse: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha massahu alkhayru manooAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And suppressive when good touches him.

22.verse: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa almusalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who are devoted to Salah.

23.verse: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena hum AAala salatihim daimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who with their Salah are Da'imun;

24.verse: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena fee amwalihim haqqun maAAloomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those in whose wealth there is a recognized right.

25.verse: لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lilssaili waalmahroomi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For the one who asks, and for the deprived.

26.verse: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena yusaddiqoona biyawmi alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.

27.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.

28.verse: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna AAathaba rabbihim ghayru mamoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure.

29.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who guard their private part (chastity).

30.verse: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except from their wives or their right hand possessions -- for (then) they are not blameworthy.

31.verse: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.

32.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.

33.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum bishahadatihim qaimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

34.verse: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena hum AAala salatihim yuhafithoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those who are with their Salah, Yuhafizun.

35.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika fee jannatin mukramoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Such shall dwell in the Gardens, honored

36.verse: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famali allatheena kafaroo qibalaka muhtiAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, what is the matter with those disbelievers, before you Muhti`in

37.verse: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali AAizeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the right and on the left, `Izin.

38.verse: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight

39.verse: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla inna khalaqnahum mimma yaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But no! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!

40.verse: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But no! I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that surely We are Able

41.verse: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
