Translations.translation: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.

42.verse: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised.

43.verse: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a Nusub,

44.verse: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!

1.verse: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We sent Nuh to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."

2.verse: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,"

3.verse: أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "That you should worship Allah, and have Taqwa of Him, and obey me,"

4.verse: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allah when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but know."

5.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He said: O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day,

6.verse: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight.

7.verse: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted, and magnified themselves in pride.

8.verse: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).

9.verse: ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.

10.verse: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: I said (to them): Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;

11.verse: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will send rain to you Midrar,

12.verse: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.

13.verse: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What is the matter with you, that you do not hope for any Waqar from Allah

14.verse: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: While He has created you (in) Atwar (stages).

15.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: See you not how Allah has created the seven heavens in tiers

16.verse: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

17.verse: وَاللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth

18.verse: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth.

19.verse: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah has made for you the earth a wide expanse.

20.verse: لِّتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That you may go about therein in broad roads.

21.verse: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nuh said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss."

22.verse: وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And they have plotted a mighty plot."

23.verse: وَقَالُوا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And they have said: `You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwa`, nor Yaghuth, and Ya`uq and Nasr.' "

24.verse: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allah): `Grant no increase to the wrongdoers save error."'

25.verse: مِّمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنصَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allah.

26.verse: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Nuh said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth Dayyar!"

27.verse: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your servants, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers."

28.verse: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the wrongdoers grant You no increase but destruction!") Allah says,

1.verse: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "It has been revealed to me that a group of Jinn listened. They said: `Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation!'

2.verse: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `It guides to the right path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join anything with our Lord.'

3.verse: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And He, exalted be the Jadd of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son.'

4.verse: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And that the foolish among us used to utter against Allah that which was an enormity in falsehood.'

5.verse: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And verily, we thought that men and Jinn would not utter a lie against Allah.'

6.verse: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the Jinn, but they increased them in Rahaq.'

7.verse: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And they thought as you thought, that Allah will not send any Messenger.'

8.verse: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And we have sought to reach the heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.'

9.verse: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.'

10.verse: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And we know not whether evil is intended for those on the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them guidance.'

11.verse: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways.'

12.verse: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And we think that we cannot escape Allah in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.'

13.verse: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And indeed when we heard the Guidance, we believed therein, and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins.'

14.verse: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: `And of us some are Muslims, and of us some are Al-Qasitun. And whosoever has embraced Islam, then such have sought the right path.' "

15.verse: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And as for the Qasitun, they shall be firewood for Hell.

16.verse: وَأَن لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّاءً غَدَقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: If they had believed in Allah, and went on the way, We would surely have bestowed on them water in abundance.

17.verse: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord, He will cause him to enter in a Sa`ad torment.

18.verse: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Masjids are for Allah, so invoke not anyone along with Allah.

19.verse: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the servant of Allah stood up invoking Him in prayer they just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other.

20.verse: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "I invoke only my Lord, and I associate none as partners along with Him."

21.verse: قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the right path."

22.verse: قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "None can protect me from Allah's punishment, nor can I find refuge except in Him."

23.verse: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "(Mine is) but conveyance from Allah and His Messages, and whosoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, then verily, for him is the fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."

24.verse: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.

25.verse: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "I know not whether that which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term."

26.verse: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The All-Knower of the Unseen, and He reveals to none His Unseen."

27.verse: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except to a Messenger whom He has chosen, and then He makes a band of watching guards to march before him and behind him.

28.verse: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Till he knows that they have conveyed the Messages of their Lord. And He surrounds all that which is with them, and He keeps count of all things.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you wrapped up!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Stand (to pray) all night, except a little.

3.verse: نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ انقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Half of it or less than that, a little.

4.verse: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or a little more. And Rattil the Qur'an Tartil.

5.verse: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We shall send down to you a Word Thaqil.

6.verse: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, rising (Nashi'ah) at night is better for understanding and more suitable for speech (recitation).

7.verse: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, for you in the day is lengthy Sabh.

8.verse: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remember the Name of your Lord and (Tabattil) devote yourself to Him with complete devotion.

9.verse: رَّبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Lord of the east and the west; La ilaha illa Huwa, so take Him as a trustee.

10.verse: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And be patient with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.

11.verse: وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And leave Me alone to deal with the deniers, those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little.

12.verse: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, with Us are Ankal, and Jahim.

13.verse: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

14.verse: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will (Tarjufu) shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.

15.verse: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger to Fir`awn.

16.verse: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But Fir`awn disobeyed the Messenger; so We seized him with a severe punishment.

17.verse: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then how can you protect yourselves from the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day that will make the children gray-headed

18.verse: السَّمَاءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder His promise is certainly to be accomplished.

19.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this is an admonition, therefore whosoever wills, let him take a path to His Lord!

20.verse: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand a little less than two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you. So, recite you of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others traveling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty, yet others fighting in Allah's cause. So recite as much of the Qur'an as may be easy,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha almuddaththiru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O you enveloped in garments!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qum faanthir

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Arise and warn!

3.verse: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Warabbaka fakabbir

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And magnify your Lord!

4.verse: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathiyabaka fatahhir

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And purify your garments!

5.verse: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalrrujza faohjur

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And keep away from Ar-Rujz!

6.verse: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tamnun tastakthiru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And give not a thing in order to have more.

7.verse: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walirabbika faisbir

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And be patient for the sake of your Lord!

8.verse: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha nuqira fee alnnaqoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, when the Naqur is sounded.

9.verse: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathalika yawmaithin yawmun AAaseerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, that Day will be a Hard Day.

10.verse: عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala alkafireena ghayru yaseerin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Far from easy for the disbelievers.

11.verse: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tharnee waman khalaqtu waheedan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Leave Me alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely.

12.verse: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAaltu lahu malan mamdoodan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And then granted him resources in abundance.

13.verse: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabaneena shuhoodan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And children attending.

14.verse: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamahhadtu lahu tamheedan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And made life smooth and comfortable for him.

15.verse: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma yatmaAAu an azeeda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: After all that he desires that I should give more.

16.verse: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِآيَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla innahu kana liayatina AAaneedan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayat.

17.verse: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Saorhiquhu saAAoodan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: I shall force him to Sa`ud!

18.verse: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu fakkara waqaddara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he thought and plotted.

19.verse: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqutila kayfa qaddara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So let him be cursed, how he plotted!

20.verse: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma qutila kayfa qaddara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And once more let him be cursed, how he plotted!

21.verse: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma nathara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he thought.

22.verse: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma AAabasa wabasara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;

23.verse: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma adbara waistakbara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he turned back, and was proud.

24.verse: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old,

25.verse: إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In hatha illa qawlu albashari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "This is nothing but the word of a human being!"

26.verse: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Saosleehi saqara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: I will cast him into Saqar.

27.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma saqaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know (exactly) what Saqar is

28.verse: لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tubqee wala tatharu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It spares not, nor does it leave (anything)!

29.verse: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lawwahatun lilbashari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Scorching for the humans!

30.verse: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalayha tisAAata AAashara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Over it are nineteen.

31.verse: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِيمَانًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire. And We have fixed their number only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the People of the Scripture may arrive at a certainty and that the believers may increase in faith, and that no doubt may be left for the People of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the disbelievers may say: "What does Allah intend by this example" Thus Allah leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this is nothing but a reminder to mankind.

32.verse: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla waalqamari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! And by the moon.

33.verse: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli ith adbara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the night when it withdraws.

34.verse: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssubhi itha asfara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the dawn when it brightens.

35.verse: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaha laihda alkubari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it is but one of the greatest (signs).

36.verse: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Natheeran lilbashari

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A warning to mankind

37.verse: لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To any of you that chooses to go forward, or to remain behind.

38.verse: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kullu nafsin bima kasabat raheenatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Every person is a pledge for what he has earned,

39.verse: إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa ashaba alyameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those on the Right.

40.verse: فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jannatin yatasaaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In Gardens they will ask one another,

41.verse: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAani almujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: About criminals (and they will say to them):

42.verse: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma salakakum fee saqara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "What has caused you to enter Hell"

43.verse: قَالُوا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo lam naku mina almusalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will say: "We were not of those who used to offer the Salah,"

44.verse: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walam naku nutAAimu almiskeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Nor did we feed the poor;"

45.verse: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakunna nakhoodu maAAa alkhaideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And we used to speak falsehood with vain speakers."

46.verse: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakunna nukaththibu biyawmi alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And we used to deny the Day of Recompense,"

47.verse: حَتَّىٰ أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta atana alyaqeenu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Until Al-Yaqin came to us."

48.verse: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama tanfaAAuhum shafaAAatu alshshafiAAeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.

49.verse: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama lahum AAani alttathkirati muAArideena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then what is wrong with them that they turn away from admonition

50.verse: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaannahum humurun mustanfiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As if they were wild donkeys.

51.verse: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Farrat min qaswaratin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Fleeing from a Qaswarah.

52.verse: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out.

53.verse: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ الْآخِرَةَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla bal la yakhafoona alakhirata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter.

54.verse: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla innahu tathkiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, verily, this is an admonition.

55.verse: فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faman shaa thakarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, whosoever wills receives admonition from it!

56.verse: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will not receive admonition unless Allah wills; He is the One, deserving of the Taqwa and He is the One Who forgives.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La oqsimu biyawmi alqiyamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala oqsimu bialnnafsi allawwamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And nay! I swear by An-Nafs Al-Lawwamah.

3.verse: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ayahsabu alinsanu allan najmaAAa AAithamahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does man think that We shall not assemble his bones

4.verse: بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Yes, We are able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.

5.verse: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal yureedu alinsanu liyafjura amamahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Man desires to break out ahead of himself.

6.verse: يَسْأَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yasalu ayyana yawmu alqiyamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection"

7.verse: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha bariqa albasaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, when Bariqa the sight.

8.verse: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakhasafa alqamaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the moon will be eclipsed.

9.verse: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajumiAAa alshshamsu waalqamaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the sun and moon will be joined together.

10.verse: يَقُولُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaqoolu alinsanu yawmaithin ayna almafarru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On that Day man will say: "Where (is the refuge) to flee"

11.verse: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla la wazara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No! There is no refuge!

12.verse: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almustaqarru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Unto your Lord will be the place of rest that Day.

13.verse: يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward, and what he left behind.

14.verse: بَلِ الْإِنسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bali alinsanu AAala nafsihi baseeratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Man will be well informed about himself,

15.verse: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaw alqa maAAatheerahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Though he may put forth his excuses.

16.verse: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Move not your tongue concerning to make haste therewith.

17.verse: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna AAalayna jamAAahu waquranahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is for Us to collect it and that it be recited.

18.verse: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha qaranahu faittabiAA quranahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when We have recited it to you, then follow its recitation.

19.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma inna AAalayna bayanahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then it is for Us to make it clear.

20.verse: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla bal tuhibboona alAAajilata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But no! Rather you love the present life of this world,

21.verse: وَتَذَرُونَ الْآخِرَةَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watatharoona alakhirata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And neglect the Hereafter.

22.verse: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wujoohun yawmaithin nadiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah.

23.verse: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila rabbiha nathiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Looking at their Lord.

24.verse: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawujoohun yawmaithin basiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And some faces that Day will be Basirah,

25.verse: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tathunnu an yufAAala biha faqiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them.

26.verse: كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla itha balaghati alttaraqiya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, when it rea- ches to the collarbones.

27.verse: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqeela man raqin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it will be said: "Who can cure him"

28.verse: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathanna annahu alfiraqu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he will think that it was the parting;

29.verse: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wailtaffati alssaqu bialssaqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And one shank will be joined with another shank.

30.verse: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almasaqu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The drive will be on that Day to your Lord!

31.verse: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala saddaqa wala salla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, he neither believed nor prayed!

32.verse: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walakin kaththaba watawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But on the contrary, he denied and turned away!

33.verse: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma thahaba ila ahlihi yatamatta

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he walked in conceit to his family admiring himself!

34.verse: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Awla laka faawla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe to you! And then woe to you!

35.verse: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma awla laka faawla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Again, woe to you! And then woe to you!

36.verse: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ayahsabu alinsanu an yutraka sudan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does man think that he will be left neglected

37.verse: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Was he not a Nutfah of semen emitted

38.verse: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma kana AAalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he became an `Alaqah; then shaped and fashioned in due proportion.

39.verse: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAala minhu alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And made of him two sexes, male and female.

40.verse: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is it not so then, that He would be able to give life to the dead

1.verse: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئًا مَّذْكُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mentioning

2.verse: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah Amshaj, in order to try him, so, We made him hearer and seer.

3.verse: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We guided him to the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

4.verse: إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلَاسِلَ وَأَغْلَالًا وَسَعِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and Sa`ir.

5.verse: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the Abrar (righteous believers) shall drink of a cup mixed with Kafur.

6.verse: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A spring wherefrom the servants of Allah will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.

7.verse: يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They fulfill (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.

8.verse: وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they give food, inspite of their love for it, to the poor, the orphan and the captive,

9.verse: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allah's Face only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you."

10.verse: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day that is `Abus and Qamtarir."

11.verse: فَوَقَاهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, Allah saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadrah (a light of beauty) and joy.

12.verse: وَجَزَاهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.

13.verse: مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Reclining therein on raised couches, they will see there neither the excessive heat, nor the excessive cold.

14.verse: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.

15.verse: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And among them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal --

16.verse: قَوَارِيرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (Qawarir) Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof.

17.verse: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabil (ginger),

18.verse: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A spring there, called Salsabil.

19.verse: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.

20.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.

21.verse: عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوا أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and Istabraq. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

22.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavor has been accepted."

23.verse: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to you by stages.

24.verse: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ آثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore be patient with constancy to the command of your Lord, and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.

25.verse: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon.

26.verse: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And during the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him a long night through.

27.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, these love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day.

28.verse: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong build. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.

29.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.

30.verse: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But you cannot will, unless Allah wills. Verily, Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.

31.verse: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will admit to His mercy whom He wills and as for the wrongdoers -- He has prepared a painful torment.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalmursalati AAurfan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the Mursalat `Urfa.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaalAAasifati AAasfan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The `Asifat `Asfa.

3.verse: وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnashirati nashran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the Nashirat Nashra.

4.verse: فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalfariqati farqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Fariqat that separate.

5.verse: فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalmulqiyati thikran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Mulqiyat that remind,

6.verse: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAuthran aw nuthran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Excusing or warning.

7.verse: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama tooAAadoona lawaqiAAun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Surely, what you are promised will occur.

8.verse: فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha alnnujoomu tumisat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when the stars lose their lights.

9.verse: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alssamao furijat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when Furijat the heaven.

10.verse: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha aljibalu nusifat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the mountains are blown away.

11.verse: وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alrrusulu oqqitat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the Messengers are Uqqitat.

12.verse: لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liayyi yawmin ojjilat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For what Day are these signs postponed

13.verse: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyawmi alfasli

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).

14.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma yawmu alfasli

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out

15.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

16.verse: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam nuhliki alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Did We not destroy the ancients

17.verse: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْآخِرِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma nutbiAAuhumu alakhireena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So shall We make later generations to follow them.

18.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

19.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

20.verse: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّاءٍ مَّهِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam nakhluqkum min main maheenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Did We not create you from a despised water

21.verse: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAalnahu fee qararin makeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We placed it in a place of safety,

22.verse: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila qadarin maAAloomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For a known period

23.verse: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqadarna faniAAma alqadiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So We did measure; and We are the best to measure.

24.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

25.verse: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam najAAali alarda kifatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have We not made the earth Kifat (a receptacle)

26.verse: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ahyaan waamwatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For the living and the dead

27.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَّاءً فُرَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And have placed therein fixed towers, and have given you Furat water

28.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

29.verse: انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!"

30.verse: انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Intaliqoo ila thillin thee thalathi shuAAabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Depart you to a shadow in three columns,"

31.verse: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Neither shady nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."

32.verse: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innaha tarmee bishararin kaalqasri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr,

33.verse: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaannahu jimalatun sufrun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As if they were Sufr camels.

34.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

35.verse: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha yawmu la yantiqoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),

36.verse: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yuthanu lahum fayaAAtathiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.

37.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

38.verse: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatha yawmu alfasli jamaAAnakum waalawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!

39.verse: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fain kana lakum kaydun fakeedooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allah)!

40.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

41.verse: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna almuttaqeena fee thilalin waAAuyoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who had Taqwa, shall be amidst shades and springs.

42.verse: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafawakiha mimma yashtahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And fruits, such as they desire.

43.verse: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do."

44.verse: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinin.

45.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

46.verse: كُلُوا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kuloo watamattaAAoo qaleelan innakum mujrimoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while. Verily, you are criminals.

47.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

48.verse: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself!" They bow not down.

49.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

50.verse: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabiayyi hadeethin baAAdahu yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then in what statement after this will they believe

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAamma yatasaaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What are they asking about

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAani alnnabai alAAatheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: About the great news,

3.verse: الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee hum feehi mukhtalifoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: About which they are in disagreement.

4.verse: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla sayaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, they will come to know!

5.verse: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma kalla sayaAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, again, they will come to know!

6.verse: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam najAAali alarda mihadan
