Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have We not made the earth as a bed,

7.verse: وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaljibala awtadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the mountains as pegs

8.verse: وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakhalaqnakum azwajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have created you in pairs.

9.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna nawmakum subatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest.

10.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna allayla libasan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have made the night as a covering,

11.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna alnnahara maAAashan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have made the day for livelihood.

12.verse: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wabanayna fawqakum sabAAan shidadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have built above you seven strong,

13.verse: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WajaAAalna sirajan wahhajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have made (therein) a shining lamp.

14.verse: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanzalna mina almuAAsirati maan thajjajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We have sent down from the Mu`sirat water Thajjaj.

15.verse: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Linukhrija bihi habban wanabatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That We may produce therewith grains and vegetations,

16.verse: وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajannatin alfafan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And gardens that are Alfaf.

17.verse: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna yawma alfasli kana meeqatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

18.verse: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds.

19.verse: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafutihati alssamao fakanat abwaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates.

20.verse: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasuyyirati aljibalu fakanat saraban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.

21.verse: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna jahannama kanat mirsadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush

22.verse: لِّلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lilttagheena maaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A dwelling place for the Taghun,

23.verse: لَّابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Labitheena feeha ahqaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will abide therein Ahqab.

24.verse: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.

25.verse: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa hameeman waghassaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except Hamim, and Ghassaq

26.verse: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jazaan wifaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).

27.verse: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.

28.verse: وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakaththaboo biayatina kiththaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they denied Our Ayat Kidhdhaba.

29.verse: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakulla shayin ahsaynahu kitaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And all things We have recorded in a Book.

30.verse: فَذُوقُوا فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illa AAathaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So taste you. No increase shall We give you, except in torment.

31.verse: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna lilmuttaqeena mafazan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, for those who have Taqwa, there will be a success;

32.verse: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hadaiqa waaAAnaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Hada'iq and vineyards,

33.verse: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WakawaAAiba atraban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Kawa`ib Atrab,

34.verse: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakasan dihaqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a cup Dihaq.

35.verse: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No Laghw shall they hear therein, nor lying;

36.verse: جَزَاءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Rewarded from your Lord with a sufficient gift.

37.verse: رَّبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom th- ey cannot dare to speak.

38.verse: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day that Ar-Ruh and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom Ar-Rahman allows, and he will speak what is right.

39.verse: ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That is the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with His Lord!

40.verse: إِنَّا أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment -- the Day when man will see that which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalnnaziAAati gharqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By those who pull out, drowning.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnashitati nashtan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By those who free briskly.

3.verse: وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssabihati sabhan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the swimmers, swimming.

4.verse: فَالسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalssabiqati sabqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the racers, racing.

5.verse: فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalmudabbirati amran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by those who arrange affairs.

6.verse: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tarjufu alrrajifatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On the Day the Rajifah shakes,

7.verse: تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TatbaAAuha alrradifatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Followed by the Radifah.

8.verse: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Quloobun yawmaithin wajifatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Hearts that Day will tremble.

9.verse: أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Absaruha khashiAAatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Their vision humiliated.

10.verse: يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaqooloona ainna lamardoodoona fee alhafirati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They say: "Shall we indeed be brought back from Al-Hafirah"

11.verse: أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَّخِرَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aitha kunna AAithaman nakhiratan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Even after we are bones Nakhirah"

12.verse: قَالُوا تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"

13.verse: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But it will be only a single Zajrah.

14.verse: فَإِذَا هُم بِالسَّاهِرَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha hum bialssahirati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When behold, they are at As-Sahirah.

15.verse: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal ataka hadeethu moosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has there come to you the story of Musa

16.verse: إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When his Lord called him in the holy valley of Tuwa,

17.verse: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Go to Fir`awn; verily, he has transgressed all bounds.

18.verse: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself"

19.verse: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waahdiyaka ila rabbika fatakhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him"

20.verse: فَأَرَاهُ الْآيَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faarahu alayata alkubra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he showed him the great sign.

21.verse: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakaththaba waAAasa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But he denied and disobeyed.

22.verse: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma adbara yasAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he turned back, striving.

23.verse: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fahashara fanada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So he gathered and called out,

24.verse: فَقَالَ أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْأَعْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqala ana rabbukumu alaAAla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Saying: "I am your lord, most high."

25.verse: فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ نَكَالَ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faakhathahu Allahu nakala alakhirati waaloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So Allah seized him with punishing example for the Hereafter and the first (life).

26.verse: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In this is a lesson for whoever fears.

27.verse: أَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed

28.verse: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: RafaAAa samkaha fasawwaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He raised its hei- ght, and has perfected it.

29.verse: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaghtasha laylaha waakhraja duhaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Its night He covers and He brings out its forenoon.

30.verse: وَالْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And after that He spread the earth,

31.verse: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَاءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Akhraja minha maaha wamarAAaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.

32.verse: وَالْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaljibala arsaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the mountains He has fixed firmly,

33.verse: مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

34.verse: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ الْكُبْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha jaati alttammatu alkubra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when there comes the Greatest Catastrophe

35.verse: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yatathakkaru alinsanu ma saAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.

36.verse: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waburrizati aljaheemu liman yara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Hell shall be made apparent for whoever sees.

37.verse: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma man tagha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then for him who transgressed

38.verse: وَآثَرَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waathara alhayata alddunya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And preferred the life of this world,

39.verse: فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainna aljaheema hiya almawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, his abode will be the Hell;

40.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and forbade himself from desire.

41.verse: فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainna aljannata hiya almawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.

42.verse: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They ask you about the Hour when will be its appointed time

43.verse: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feema anta min thikraha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What do you have to mention of it.

44.verse: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ila rabbika muntahaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To your Lord it is limited.

45.verse: إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innama anta munthiru man yakhshaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it,

46.verse: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day they see it (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an (`Ashiyyah) afternoon or its (Duha) morning.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAabasa watawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He frowned and turned away.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An jaahu alaAAma

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Because there came to him the blind man.

3.verse: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And how can you know that he might become pure

4.verse: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu alththikra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him

5.verse: أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Amma mani istaghna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

6.verse: فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanta lahu tasadda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To him you attend;

7.verse: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama AAalayka alla yazzakka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure

8.verse: وَأَمَّا مَن جَاءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma man jaaka yasAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But as for him who came to you running,

9.verse: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa yakhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And is afraid.

10.verse: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanta AAanhu talahha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another.

11.verse: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla innaha tathkiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay; indeed it is an admonition.

12.verse: فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faman shaa thakarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, whoever wills, let him pay attention to Him (it).

13.verse: فِي صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee suhufin mukarramatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In Records held in honor,

14.verse: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MarfooAAatin mutahharatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Exalted, purified.

15.verse: بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Biaydee safaratin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In the hands of ambassadors (Safarah),

16.verse: كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kiramin bararatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Honorable and obedient.

17.verse: قُتِلَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا أَكْفَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qutila alinsanu ma akfarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Qutila mankind! How ungrateful he is!

18.verse: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min ayyi shayin khalaqahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: From what thing did He create him

19.verse: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min nutfatin khalaqahu faqaddarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: From a Nutfah He created him and then set him in due proportion.

20.verse: ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma alssabeela yassarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then He made the path easy for him.

21.verse: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma amatahu faaqbarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.

22.verse: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنشَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma itha shaa ansharahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when it is His will, He will resurrect him.

23.verse: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla lamma yaqdi ma amarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, but has not done what He commanded him.

24.verse: فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falyanthuri alinsanu ila taAAamihi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then let man look at his food:

25.verse: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Anna sababna almaa sabban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We pour forth water in abundance.

26.verse: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْأَرْضَ شَقًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma shaqaqna alarda shaqqan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We split the earth in clefts.

27.verse: فَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanbatna feeha habban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We cause therein Habb to grow,

28.verse: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAAinaban waqadban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And grapes and Qadb,

29.verse: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wazaytoonan wanakhlan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And olives and date palms,

30.verse: وَحَدَائِقَ غُلْبًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahadaiqa ghulban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Ghulb Hada'iq,

31.verse: وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wafakihatan waabban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And fruits (Fakihah) and herbage (Abb).

32.verse: مَّتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

33.verse: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha jaati alssakhkhatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then when there comes As-Sakhkhah

34.verse: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yafirru almaro min akheehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That Day shall a man flee from his brother.

35.verse: وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waommihi waabeehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And from his mother and his father.

36.verse: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasahibatihi wabaneehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And from his wife and his children.

37.verse: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Every man that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.

38.verse: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wujoohun yawmaithin musfiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Some faces that Day will be bright,

39.verse: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Dahikatun mustabshiratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

40.verse: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawujoohun yawmaithin AAalayha ghabaratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained.

41.verse: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tarhaquha qataratun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Darkness will cover them.

42.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika humu alkafaratu alfajaratu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Such will be the disbelieving, the wicked evil doers.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha alshshamsu kuwwirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When the sun is Kuwwirat.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the stars Inkadarat.

3.verse: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha aljibalu suyyirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the mountains are made to pass away;

4.verse: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alAAisharu AAuttilat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected;

5.verse: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alwuhooshu hushirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered together.

6.verse: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha albiharu sujjirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the seas become as blazing fire.

7.verse: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alnnufoosu zuwwijat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the souls are joined with their mates.

8.verse: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha almawoodatu suilat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the female infant (Al-Maw'udah) buried alive is questioned (Su'ilat):

9.verse: بِأَيِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Biayyi thanbin qutilat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For what sin was she killed

10.verse: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alssuhufu nushirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the pages are laid open.

11.verse: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alssamao kushitat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the heaven is Kushitat;

12.verse: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha aljaheemu suAAAAirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when Hell is Su`irat.

13.verse: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha aljannatu ozlifat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when Paradise is brought near.

14.verse: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا أَحْضَرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalimat nafsun ma ahdarat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Every person will know what he has brought.

15.verse: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala oqsimu bialkhunnasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But nay! I swear by Al-Khunnas.

16.verse: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aljawari alkunnasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Al-Jawar Al-Kunnas.

17.verse: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli itha AAasAAasa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the night when it `As`as.

18.verse: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssubhi itha tanaffasa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the day when it Tanaffas.

19.verse: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this is the Word a most honorable messenger.

20.verse: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Dhi Quwwah, with the Lord of the Throne -- Makin,

21.verse: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: MutaAAin thamma ameenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Obeyed there, trustworthy.

22.verse: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama sahibukum bimajnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And your companion is not a madman.

23.verse: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walaqad raahu bialofuqi almubeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed he saw him in the clear horizon.

24.verse: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.

25.verse: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is not the word of the outcast Shaytan.

26.verse: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faayna tathhaboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then where are you going

27.verse: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this is no less than a Reminder for the creatures.

28.verse: لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.

29.verse: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you cannot will unless that Allah wills -- the Lord of all that exists.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha alssamao infatarat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder (Infatarat).

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alkawakibu intatharat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the stars Intatharat.

3.verse: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha albiharu fujjirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the seas Fujjirat.

4.verse: وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alqubooru buAAthirat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the graves Bu`thirat.

5.verse: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalimat nafsun ma qaddamat waakhkharat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A person will know what he has sent forward and left behind.

6.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous

7.verse: الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee khalaqaka fasawwaka faAAadalaka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion.

8.verse: فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.

9.verse: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla bal tukaththiboona bialddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! But you deny (the Day of) Ad-Din.

10.verse: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna AAalaykum lahafitheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But verily, over you to watch you

11.verse: كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kiraman katibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Kiraman Katibin,

12.verse: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They know all that you do.

13.verse: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the Abrar (the righteous believers) will be in Delight;

14.verse: وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna alfujjara lafee jaheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, the wicked will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),

15.verse: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaslawnaha yawma alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,

16.verse: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَائِبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama hum AAanha bighaibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they will not be absent therefrom.

17.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is

18.verse: ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is

19.verse: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be with Allah.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun lilmutaffifeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe to Al-Mutaffifin.

2.verse: الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,

3.verse: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha kaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.

4.verse: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ala yathunnu olaika annahum mabAAoothoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected,

5.verse: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Liyawmin AAatheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On a Great Day

6.verse: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yaqoomu alnnasu lirabbi alAAalameena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of all that exists

7.verse: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Truly, the Record of the wicked is in Sijjin.

8.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma sijjeenun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what Sijjin is

9.verse: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kitabun marqoomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A Register inscribed.

10.verse: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.

11.verse: الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena yukaththiboona biyawmi alddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

12.verse: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, the sinner!

13.verse: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When Our Ayat are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the ancients!"

14.verse: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering) which they used to earn.

15.verse: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Surely, they will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

16.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُو الْجَحِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then verily, they will indeed enter the burning flame of Hell.

17.verse: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"

18.verse: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Verily, the Record of Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) is (preserved) in `Illiyyin.

19.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma AAilliyyoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what `Illiyyin is

20.verse: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kitabun marqoomun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A Register inscribed,

21.verse: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yashhaduhu almuqarraboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To which bear witness those nearest.

22.verse: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) will be in Delight.

23.verse: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On thrones, looking.

24.verse: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata alnnaAAeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You will recognize in their faces the brightness of delight.

25.verse: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoomin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will be given to drink of pure sealed Rahiq.

26.verse: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Sealed with musk, and for this let those strive who want to strive.

27.verse: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamizajuhu min tasneemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It will be mixed with Tasnim:

28.verse: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allah.

29.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

30.verse: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha marroo bihim yataghamazoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another.

31.verse: وَإِذَا انقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

32.verse: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily, these have indeed gone astray!"

33.verse: وَمَا أُرْسِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But they were not sent as watchers over them.

34.verse: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But this Day those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers

35.verse: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: On thrones, looking.

36.verse: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha alssamao inshaqqat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When the heaven is split asunder,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And listens to and obeys its Lord -- and it must do so.

3.verse: وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha alardu muddat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the earth is stretched forth,

4.verse: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqat ma feeha watakhallat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.

5.verse: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And listens to and obeys its Lord -- and it must do so.

6.verse: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions, a sure returning, and you will meet.

7.verse: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faama man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,

8.verse: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasawfa yuhasabu hisaban yaseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,

9.verse: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masrooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And will return to his family Masrur (in joy)!

10.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,

11.verse: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو ثُبُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasawfa yadAAoo thubooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will invoke destruction,

12.verse: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayasla saAAeeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and made to taste its burning.

13.verse: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu kana fee ahlihi masrooran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he was among his people in joy!

14.verse: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu thanna an lan yahoora

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, he thought that he would never return!

15.verse: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!

16.verse: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala oqsimu bialshshafaqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But no! I swear by Ash-Shafaq;

17.verse: وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli wama wasaqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the night and what it Wasaqa,

18.verse: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqamari itha ittasaqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the moon when it Ittasaq.

19.verse: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaqin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You shall certainly travel from stage

20.verse: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama lahum la yuminoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What is the matter with them, that they believe not

21.verse: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.

22.verse: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay, those who disbelieve deny.

23.verse: وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu aAAlamu bima yooAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah knows best what they gather,

24.verse: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, announce to them a painful torment.

25.verse: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Save those who believe and

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamai thati alburooji

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the heaven holding the Buruj.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalyawmi almawAAoodi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by by the Promised Day.

3.verse: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Washahidin wamashhoodin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the Witness and by the Witnessed.

4.verse: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qutila ashabu alukhdoodi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Cursed were the People of the Ditch.

5.verse: النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alnnari thati alwaqoodi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Of fire fed with fuel.

6.verse: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ith hum AAalayha quAAoodun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When they sat by it.

7.verse: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers.

8.verse: وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَن يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they had no fault except that they believed in Allah, the Almighty, Worthy of all praise!

9.verse: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness over everything.

10.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women, and then do not turn in repentance, then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.

11.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the supreme success.

12.verse: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna batsha rabbika lashadeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, the punishment of your Lord is severe and painful.

13.verse: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu huwa yubdio wayuAAeedu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, He it is Who begins and repeats.

14.verse: وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahuwa alghafooru alwadoodu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He is Oft-Forgiving, Al-Wadud.

15.verse: ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thoo alAAarshi almajeedi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Owner of the Throne, Al-Majid (the Glorious).

16.verse: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FaAAAAalun lima yureedu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Doer of what He intends.

17.verse: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal ataka hadeethu aljunoodi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has the story reached you of the hosts.

18.verse: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FirAAawna wathamooda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Of Fir`awn and Thamud

19.verse: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheebin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying.

20.verse: وَاللَّهُ مِن وَرَائِهِم مُّحِيطٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaAllahu min waraihim muheetun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Allah encompasses them from behind!

21.verse: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal huwa quranun majeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! This is a Glorious Qur'an,

22.verse: فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee lawhin mahfoothin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In Al-Lawh Al-Mahfuz!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamai waalttariqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the heaven, and At-Tariq;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma alttariqu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you to know what At-Tariq is

3.verse: النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alnnajmu alththaqibu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The star, Ath-Thaqib.

4.verse: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is no human being but has a protector over him.

5.verse: فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Falyanthuri alinsanu mimma khuliqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, let man see from what he is created!

6.verse: خُلِقَ مِن مَّاءٍ دَافِقٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khuliqa min main dafiqin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He is created from a water gushing forth,

7.verse: يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yakhruju min bayni alssulbi waalttaraibi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs.

8.verse: إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadirun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, He is Able to bring him back!

9.verse: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma tubla alssarairu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Day when all the secrets will be examined.

10.verse: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he will have no power, nor any helper.

11.verse: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the sky which gives rain, again and again.

12.verse: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalardi thati alssadAAi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the earth which splits.

13.verse: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahu laqawlun faslun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this is the Word that separates.

14.verse: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama huwa bialhazli

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And it is not a thing for amusement.

15.verse: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Innahum yakeedoona kaydan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, they are but plotting a plot.

16.verse: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waakeedu kaydan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And I am planning a plan.

17.verse: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sabbihi isma rabbika alaAAla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee khalaqa fasawwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has created, and then proportioned it.

3.verse: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee qaddara fahada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Who has measured; and then guided.

4.verse: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallathee akhraja almarAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Who brings out the pasturage,

5.verse: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAalahu ghuthaan ahwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And then makes it dark stubble.

6.verse: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sanuqrioka fala tansa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We shall make you recite, so you shall not forget,

7.verse: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except what Allah may will He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.

8.verse: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanuyassiruka lilyusra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And We shall make easy for you the easy.

9.verse: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathakkir in nafaAAati alththikra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore remind in case the reminder profits.

10.verse: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sayaththakkaru man yakhsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The reminder will be received by him who fears,

11.verse: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wayatajannabuha alashqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But it will be avoided by the wretched,

12.verse: الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee yasla alnnara alkubra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who will enter the great Fire.

13.verse: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There he will neither die nor live.

14.verse: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad aflaha man tazakka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed whosoever purifies himself shall achieve success.

15.verse: وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathakara isma rabbihi fasalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And remembers the Name of his Lord, and performs Salah.

16.verse: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bal tuthiroona alhayata alddunya

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Rather you prefer the life of this world.

17.verse: وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalakhiratu khayrun waabqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

18.verse: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna hatha lafee alssuhufi aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures

19.verse: صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Suhufi ibraheema wamoosa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Has there come to you the narration of Al-Ghashiyah (the overwhelming)

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Some faces that Day will be Khashi`ah.

3.verse: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAamilatun nasibatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Laboring, weary.

4.verse: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tasla naran hamiyatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will enter into Fire, Hamiyah.

5.verse: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They will be given to drink from a boiling (Aniyah) spring,

6.verse: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: No food will there be for them but from Dari`,

7.verse: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.

8.verse: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Faces that Day will be joyful,

9.verse: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: LisaAAyiha radiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Glad with their endeavor.

10.verse: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In a lofty Paradise.

11.verse: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood.

12.verse: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feeha AAaynun jariyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein will be a running spring.

13.verse: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feeha sururun marfooAAatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein will be thrones raised high.

14.verse: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waakwabun mawdooAAatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And cups set at hand.

15.verse: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanamariqu masfoofatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Namariq, set in rows.

16.verse: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Zarabi, spread out (Mabthuthah).

17.verse: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created

18.verse: وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And at the heaven, how it is raised

19.verse: وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waila aljibali kayfa nusibat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And at the mountains, how they are rooted

20.verse: وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waila alardi kayfa sutihat

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And at the earth, how it is outspread

21.verse: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So remind them -- you are only one who reminds.

22.verse: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: You are not a Musaytir over them.

23.verse: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa man tawalla wakafara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves.

24.verse: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

25.verse: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna ilayna iyabahum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, to Us will be their return;

26.verse: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalfajri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the dawn;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walayalin AAashrin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the ten nights,

3.verse: وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalshshafAAi waalwatri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the even and the odd.

4.verse: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli itha yasri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the night when it departs.

5.verse: هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is there (not) in them sufficient proofs for men of understanding!

6.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Saw you not how your Lord dealt with `Ad

7.verse: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Irama thati alAAimadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Iram of the pillars,

8.verse: الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The like of which were not created in the land

9.verse: وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Thamud, who hewed out rocks in the valley

10.verse: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ
