Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WafirAAawna thee alawtadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Fir`awn with Al-Awtad

11.verse: الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands.

12.verse: فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faaktharoo feeha alfasada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And made therein much mischief.

13.verse: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.

14.verse: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful.

15.verse: فَأَمَّا الْإِنسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honor and bounties, then he says: "My Lord has honored me."

16.verse: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"

17.verse: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But no! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity!

18.verse: وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And urge not one another on the feeding of the Miskin!

19.verse: وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you devour the Turath -- devouring with greed.

20.verse: وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you love wealth with love Jamma.

21.verse: كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! When the earth is flatened, Dakkan Dakka.

22.verse: وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.

23.verse: وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance avail him

24.verse: يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth for my life!"

25.verse: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.

26.verse: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And none will bind as He will bind.

27.verse: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "O tranquil soul!"

28.verse: ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Come back to your Lord, -- well-pleased and well-pleasing!"

29.verse: فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faodkhulee fee AAibadee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Enter then among My servants,"

30.verse: وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waodkhulee jannatee

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And enter My Paradise!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La oqsimu bihatha albaladi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! I swear by this city;

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waanta hillun bihatha albaladi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you are free in this city.

3.verse: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawalidin wama walada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And by the begetter and that which he begot.

4.verse: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee kabadin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have created man in Kabad.

5.verse: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does he think that none can overcome him

6.verse: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yaqoolu ahlaktu malan lubadan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He says: "I have wasted wealth in abundance!"

7.verse: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ayahsabu an lam yarahu ahadun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Does he think that none sees him

8.verse: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ عَيْنَيْنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam najAAal lahu AAaynayni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have We not made for him two eyes

9.verse: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walisanan washafatayni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And a tongue and two lips

10.verse: وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And shown him the two ways

11.verse: فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fala iqtahama alAAaqabata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But he has not attempted to pass on the path that is steep.

12.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know the path that is steep

13.verse: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakku raqabatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Freeing a neck

14.verse: أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or giving food in a day full of Masghabah,

15.verse: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yateeman tha maqrabatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: To an orphan near of kin.

16.verse: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or to a Miskin cleaving to dust.

17.verse: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then he became one of those who believed and recommended one another to patience, and recommended one another to compassion.

18.verse: أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Olaika ashabu almaymanati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: They are those on the Right,

19.verse: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat, they are those on the Left.

20.verse: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAalayhim narun musadatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Upon them Fire will Mu'sadah.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalshshamsi waduhaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the sun and Duhaha.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalqamari itha talaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the moon as it Talaha.

3.verse: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnahari itha jallaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the day as it Jallaha.

4.verse: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli itha yaghshaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the night as it Yaghshaha.

5.verse: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalssamai wama banaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the heaven and Ma Banaha.

6.verse: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalardi wama tahaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the earth and Ma Tahhaha.

7.verse: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wanafsin wama sawwaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By Nafs, and Ma Sawwaha (Who apportioned it).

8.verse: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then He showed it its Fujur and its Taqwa.

9.verse: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qad aflaha man zakkaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Indeed he succeeds who purifies it.

10.verse: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqad khaba man dassaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed he fails who Dassaha.

11.verse: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kaththabat thamoodu bitaghwaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Thamud denied through their trans- gression.

12.verse: إِذِ انبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ithi inbaAAatha ashqaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When their most wicked went forth.

13.verse: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "Be cautious! That is the she-camel of Allah! (Do not harm it) and (bar it not from having) its drink!"

14.verse: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, Fasawwaha!

15.verse: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He feared not the consequences thereof.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli itha yaghsha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the night as it envelops.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waalnnahari itha tajalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the day as it appears.

3.verse: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama khalaqa alththakara waalontha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By Him Who created male and female.

4.verse: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna saAAyakum lashatta

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse.

5.verse: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَاتَّقَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma man aAAta waittaqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: As for him who gives and has Taqwa,

6.verse: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasaddaqa bialhusna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And believes in Al-Husna.

7.verse: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We will make smooth for him the path of ease.

8.verse: وَأَمَّا مَن بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma man bakhila waistaghna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But he who is greedy and thinks himself self-sufficient,

9.verse: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wakaththaba bialhusna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And denies Al-Husna.

10.verse: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We will make smooth for him the path to evil.

11.verse: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down (in destruction)

12.verse: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna AAalayna lalhuda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Truly, on Us is (to give) guidance.

13.verse: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).

14.verse: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faanthartukum naran talaththa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore I have warned you of a Fire Talazza.

15.verse: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La yaslaha illa alashqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: None shall enter it save the most wretched.

16.verse: الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee kaththaba watawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who denies and turns away.

17.verse: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wasayujannabuha alatqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And those with Taqwa will be far removed from it.

18.verse: الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee yutee malahu yatazakka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He who gives of his wealth for self-purification.

19.verse: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And who has (in mind) no favor from anyone to be paid back.

20.verse: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْأَعْلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihi alaAAla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except to seek the Face of his Lord, the Most High.

21.verse: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walasawfa yarda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He, surely, will be pleased.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaldduha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the forenoon.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waallayli itha saja

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the night when it darkens.

3.verse: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Your Lord has neither forsaken you nor hates you.

4.verse: وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walalakhiratu khayrun laka mina aloola

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present.

5.verse: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walasawfa yuAAteeka rabbuka fatarda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, your Lord will give you so that you shall be well-pleased.

6.verse: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yajidka yateeman faawa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Did He not find you an orphan and gave you a refuge

7.verse: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawajadaka dallan fahada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He found you unaware and guided you

8.verse: وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wawajadaka AAailan faaghna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He found you poor and made you rich

9.verse: فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma alyateema fala taqhar

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression.

10.verse: وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma alssaila fala tanhar

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And repulse not the one who asks.

11.verse: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma biniAAmati rabbika fahaddith

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And proclaim the grace of your Lord.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam nashrah laka sadraka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have We not opened your breast for you

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WawadaAAna AAanka wizraka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And removed from you your burden.

3.verse: الَّذِي أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee anqada thahraka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which weighed down your back

4.verse: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WarafaAAna laka thikraka

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And have We not raised high your fame

5.verse: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fainna maAAa alAAusri yusran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, along with every hardship is relief,

6.verse: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna maAAa alAAusri yusran

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, along with every hardship is relief.

7.verse: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faitha faraghta fainsab

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So when you have finished, devote yourself to Allah's worship.

8.verse: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waila rabbika fairghab

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to your Lord turn intentions and hopes.

1.verse: بِّسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waaltteeni waalzzaytooni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By At-Tin and Az-Zaytun.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watoori seeneena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By Tur Sinin.

3.verse: وَهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahatha albaladi alameeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By this city of security.

4.verse: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We created man in the best form.

5.verse: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma radadnahu asfala safileena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low.

6.verse: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Save those who believe and do righteous deeds. Then they shall have a reward without end.

7.verse: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fama yukaththibuka baAAdu bialddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then what causes you to deny after this the Recompense

8.verse: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alaysa Allahu biahkami alhakimeena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Is not Allah the best of judges

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Iqra biismi rabbika allathee khalaqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Read! In the Name of your Lord Who created.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Khalaqa alinsana min AAalaqin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has created man from a clot.

3.verse: اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Iqra warabbuka alakramu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.

4.verse: الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee AAallama bialqalami

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has taught by the pen.

5.verse: عَلَّمَ الْإِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAallama alinsana ma lam yaAAlam

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He has taught man that which he knew not.

6.verse: كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَيَطْغَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla inna alinsana layatgha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Verily, man does transgress.

7.verse: أَن رَّآهُ اسْتَغْنَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: An raahu istaghna

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Because he considers himself self-sufficient.

8.verse: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna ila rabbika alrrujAAa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Surely, unto your Lord is the return.

9.verse: أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Araayta allathee yanha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you seen him who prevents

10.verse: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AAabdan itha salla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A servant when he prays

11.verse: أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Araayta in kana AAala alhuda

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you seen if he is on the guidance

12.verse: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Aw amara bialttaqwa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Or enjoins Taqwa

13.verse: أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Araayta in kaththaba watawalla

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you seen if he denies and turns away

14.verse: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yaAAlam bianna Allaha yara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Knows he not that Allah sees

15.verse: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! If he ceases not, We will scorch his forehead --

16.verse: نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Nasiyatin kathibatin khatiatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A lying, sinful forehead!

17.verse: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FalyadAAu nadiyahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then let him call upon his council.

18.verse: سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: SanadAAu alzzabaniyata

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: We will call out the guards of Hell!

19.verse: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِب ۩

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla la tutiAAhu waosjud waiqtarib

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! Do not obey him. Fall prostrate and draw near (to Allah)!

1.verse: بِّسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna anzalnahu fee laylati alqadri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have sent it down in the Night of Al-Qadr.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma laylatu alqadri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what the Night of Al-Qadr is

3.verse: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The Night of Al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.

4.verse: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therein descend the angels and the Ruh by their Lord's permission with every matter.

5.verse: سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Salamun hiya hatta matlaAAi alfajri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: There is peace until the appearance of dawn.

1.verse: لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who disbelieve from among the People of the Scripture and the idolators, were not going to leave until there came to them the Bayyinah.

2.verse: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A Messenger from Allah reciting purified pages.

3.verse: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Feeha kutubun qayyimatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Wherein are upright Books.

4.verse: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the People of the Scripture differed not until after there came to them the Bayyinah.

5.verse: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And they were commanded not, but that they should worship Allah, making religion purely for Him alone, Hunafa', and that they perform Salah and give Zakah, and that is the right religion.

6.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who disbelieve from among the People of the Scripture and idolators, will abide in the fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures.

7.verse: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures.

8.verse: جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Their reward with their Lord is Eternal Gardens, underneath which rivers flow. They will abide therein forever, Allah will be pleased with them, and they well-pleased with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha zulzilati alardu zilzalaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When the earth quakes with its Zilzal.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waakhrajati alardu athqalaha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And when the earth throws out its burdens.

3.verse: وَقَالَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا لَهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waqala alinsanu ma laha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And man will say: "What is the matter with it"

4.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawmaithin tuhaddithu akhbaraha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That Day it will declare its information.

5.verse: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Bianna rabbaka awha laha

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Because your Lord will inspire it.

6.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.

7.verse: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, whosoever does good equal to the weight of a speck of dust shall see it.

8.verse: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of a speck of dust shall see it.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalAAadiyati dabhan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By the `Adiyat (steeds), snorting.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalmooriyati qadhan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Striking sparks of fire.

3.verse: فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faalmugheerati subhan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And scouring to the raid at dawn.

4.verse: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faatharna bihi naqAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And raise the dust in clouds the while.

5.verse: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawasatna bihi jamAAan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst.

6.verse: إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alinsana lirabbihi lakanoodun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, man is ungrateful to his Lord.

7.verse: وَإِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu AAala thalika lashaheedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And to that He bears witness.

8.verse: وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wainnahu lihubbi alkhayri lashadeedun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.

9.verse: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth

10.verse: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wahussila ma fee alssudoori

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And that which is in the breasts shall be made known

11.verse: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna rabbahum bihim yawmaithin lakhabeerun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, that Day their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: AlqariAAatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Al-Qari`ah.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma alqariAAatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: What is Al-Qari`ah

3.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma alqariAAatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what Al-Qari`ah is

4.verse: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yawma yakoonu alnnasu kaalfarashi almabthoothi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.

5.verse: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنفُوشِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni almanfooshi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And the mountains will be like wool, carded.

6.verse: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faamma man thaqulat mawazeenuhu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then as for him whose Balance will be heavy,

7.verse: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will live a pleasant life.

8.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waamma man khaffat mawazeenuhu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But as for him whose Balance will be light,

9.verse: فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Faommuhu hawiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: His mother will be Hawiyah.

10.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا هِيَهْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma hiyah

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what it is

11.verse: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Narun hamiyatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: A fire Hamiyah!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alhakumu alttakathuru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The mutual increase diverts you,

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Hatta zurtumu almaqabira

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Until you visit the graves.

3.verse: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! You shall come to know!

4.verse: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Again nay! You shall come to know!

5.verse: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla law taAAlamoona AAilma alyaqeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge.

6.verse: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Latarawunna aljaheema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, you shall see the blazing Fire!

7.verse: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma latarawunnaha AAayna alyaqeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!

8.verse: ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Thumma latusalunna yawmaithin AAani alnnaAAeemi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights!

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WaalAAasri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: By Al-`Asr.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna alinsana lafee khusrin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, man is in loss.

3.verse: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and recommend one another to the truth, and recommend one another to patience.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Woe to every Humazah Lumazah.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee jamaAAa malan waAAaddadahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has gathered wealth and counted it.

3.verse: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Yahsabu anna malahu akhladahu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!

4.verse: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنبَذَنَّ فِي الْحُطَمَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Kalla layunbathanna fee alhutamati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: But no! Verily, he will be thrown into Al-Hutamah.

5.verse: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wama adraka ma alhutamatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And what will make you know what Al-Hutamah is

6.verse: نَارُ اللَّهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Naru Allahi almooqadatu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: The fire of Allah, Al-Muqadah,

7.verse: الَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْأَفْئِدَةِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatee tattaliAAu AAala alafidati

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Which leaps up over the hearts.

8.verse: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: lnnaha AAalayhim musadatun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, it shall Mu'sadah upon them,

9.verse: فِي عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee AAamadin mumaddadatin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In pillars stretched forth.

1.verse: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the Owners of the Elephant

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Alam yajAAal kaydahum fee tadleelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Did He not make their plot go astray

3.verse: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waarsala AAalayhim tayran ababeela

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He sent against them birds, in flocks (Ababil).

4.verse: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tarmeehim bihijaratin min sijjeelin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Striking them with stones of Sijjil.

5.verse: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FajaAAalahum kaAAasfin makoolin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And He made them like `Asf, Ma'kul.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lieelafi qurayshin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For the Ilaf of the Quraysh.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Eelafihim rihlata alshshitai waalssayfi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Their Ilaf caravans, in winter and in summer.

3.verse: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَـٰذَا الْبَيْتِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: FalyaAAbudoo rabba hatha albayti

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, let them worship the Lord of this House.

4.verse: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Have you seen him who denies Ad-Din

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fathalika allathee yaduAAAAu alyateema

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: That is he who repulses the orphan,

3.verse: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And urges not the feeding of Al-Miskin.

4.verse: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fawaylun lilmusalleena

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, woe unto those performers of Salah,

5.verse: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena hum AAan salatihim sahoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who with their Salah are Sahun.

6.verse: الَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَاءُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allatheena hum yuraoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Those who do good deeds only to be seen,

7.verse: وَيَمْنَعُونَ الْمَاعُونَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: WayamnaAAoona almaAAoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And withhold Al-Ma`un.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Verily, We have granted you Al-Kawthar.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasalli lirabbika wainhar

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice.

3.verse: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Inna shaniaka huwa alabtaru

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: For he who hates you, he will be cut off.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul ya ayyuha alkafiroona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "O disbelievers!"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: La aAAbudu ma taAAbudoona

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "I worship not that which you worship."

3.verse: وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Nor will you worship whom I worship."

4.verse: وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala ana AAabidun ma AAabadtum

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping."

5.verse: وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Nor will you worship that which I worship."

6.verse: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lakum deenukum waliya deeni

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "To you be your religion, and to me my religion."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Itha jaa nasru Allahi waalfathu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: When there comes the help of Allah and the Conquest.

2.verse: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And you see that the people enter Allah's religion in crowds.

3.verse: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: So, glorify the praises of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and Who forgives.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Perish the two hands of Abu Lahab and perish he!

2.verse: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: His wealth and his children will not benefit him!

3.verse: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Sayasla naran thata lahabin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: He will enter a Fire full of flames!

4.verse: وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Waimraatuhu hammalata alhatabi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: And his wife too, who carries wood.

5.verse: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Fee jeediha hablun min masadin

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad.

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul huwa Allahu ahadun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "He is Allah, One."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allahu alssamadu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Allah As-Samad."

3.verse: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Lam yalid walam yooladu

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "He begets not, nor was He begotten."

4.verse: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And there is none comparable to Him."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alfalaqi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "I seek refuge with the Lord of Al-Falaq,"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min sharri ma khalaqa

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "From the evil of what He has created,"

3.verse: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqaba

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And from the evil of the Ghasiq when Waqab,"

4.verse: وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin sharri alnnaffathati fee alAAuqadi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And from the evil of the blowers in knots,"

5.verse: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasada

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alnnasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: Say: "I seek refuge with the Lord of An-Nas,"

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Maliki alnnasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The King of An-Nas,"

3.verse: إِلَـٰهِ النَّاسِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Ilahi alnnasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "The God of An-Nas,"

4.verse: مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws."

5.verse: الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoori alnnasi

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Who whispers in the breasts of An-Nas."

6.verse: مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ

Translations.author: transliteration
Translations.translation: Mina aljinnati wa alnnasm

Translations.author: mubarakpuri
Translations.translation: "Of Jinn and An-Nas."
